  • AI/subjective quality claims include eval spec and rerun result.
  • Coverage is tied to critical paths, not only global percentage.
  • Flaky tests are classified and not silently hidden by retries.
  • CI gates list command, job, trigger, permissions, artifacts and exit code.
  • Manual QA names charter, environment, reviewer and result.
  • Test/eval data contains no secrets or private customer data.
  • Final response carries current evidence, accepted gaps and residual risks.

docs.title: Типовые сбои
docs.text:
• Tests are listed after implementation without proving behavior.
  • Unit tests mock away the real risk while integration/contract behavior is untested.
  • E2E suite becomes slow, flaky and ignored.
  • Coverage threshold becomes a proxy for quality.
  • Regression scope is selected by habit, not impact analysis.
  • Contract compatibility is inferred from generated clients only.
  • Visual tests run in unstable environments and produce noisy diffs.
  • Retries hide intermittent failures without owner or expiry.
  • CI status is assumed from an old run.
  • Manual QA has no charter, criteria, environment or reviewer.
  • AI evals have no baseline, threshold, rerun command or failed-case analysis.
  • Test fixtures, traces or eval datasets leak secrets or private data.
  • Final answer claims "works" from inspection only while runtime verification was available.

docs.title: Unsupported claims not adopted
docs.text:
• "More tests always means better quality." Useful signal is risk coverage, fast feedback and failure usefulness.
  • "100 percent line coverage proves correctness." It does not prove assertions, behavior, contracts or outcomes.
  • "E2E tests are most realistic, so they should dominate." They are valuable but slower and more brittle.
  • "Manual QA is not evidence." It can be evidence with charter, criteria, environment and captured result.
  • "AI evals are optional for AI behavior changes." Prompt/model/retrieval/tool changes need baseline or explicit baseline gap.

docs.title: Open questions for future implementation
docs.text:
• Which stack-specific templates should be generated first: pytest, Vitest/Jest, Playwright, JUnit, Storybook, Pact, Promptfoo or Ragas?
  • What default test portfolio should apply by project type: backend/API, frontend, database, native, desktop, AI/RAG or docs-only?
  • How should flaky tests be classified, quarantined and expired without hiding failures?
  • Which mutation/property-based testing triggers should become readiness gates?
  • How should CI evidence distinguish local command evidence, remote job evidence, artifacts, logs and rerun commands?
  • Which eval failure labels should be standardized: data, prompt, model, retrieval, tool, grader, threshold or product expectation?

docs.title: Requirements & Domain
docs.text:
Source status: official + verified methodology + local implementation evidence + tool-assisted + experiment

Источники: Agile Alliance ATDD, Agile Alliance BDD, Agile Alliance User Stories, Cucumber Gherkin Reference, Cucumber Example Mapping, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018, IEEE 29148 overview, IIBA BABOK, Martin Fowler: Domain-Driven Design, Martin Fowler: Bounded Context, Martin Fowler: Ubiquitous Language, Domain Language, EventStorming, Domain Storytelling, C4 model, OpenAPI Specification v3.2.0, Context7 research, research dossier.

docs.title: Deep research цель
docs.text:
Requirements & Domain слой переводит business intent в проверяемые behavior contracts, domain language, domain boundaries и downstream evidence до того, как engineer, agent или subagent начинает менять поведение системы.

Для большого проекта это защита от silent scope drift: разные teams, services, agents, API, UI, database и tests должны одинаково понимать пользователей, термины, business rules, boundaries, acceptance criteria и owner review.

docs.title: Главный принцип
docs.text: Не начинайте с folder structure, фреймворка или реализации. Начинайте с requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner, а затем уже трассируйте это в architecture, API, UI, database, tests, evals, docs и release notes.

docs.title: Поддержанные факты
docs.text:
• ATDD and BDD support writing acceptance behavior before implementation and using shared language between product, development and testing.
  • User stories are useful work items, but story title alone is not a complete requirement without acceptance criteria, examples, business rules and non-goals.
  • Gherkin gives executable specification syntax, but BDD is a conceptual practice and can use equivalent behavior tables.
  • ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 and IEEE descriptions support requirements engineering attributes, traceability and iterative requirements processes.
  • BABOK is a recognized business analysis reference for stakeholder collaboration, elicitation and solution value.
  • Domain-Driven Design, Bounded Context and Ubiquitous Language are useful when domain complexity, workflow risk or vocabulary conflicts make informal requirements unsafe.
  • EventStorming and Domain Storytelling support domain discovery through events, actors, policies, hotspots and shared process language.
  • C4 and OpenAPI provide downstream traceability surfaces from domain boundaries and requirements to architecture and API contracts.

docs.title: Assumptions
docs.text:
• Behavior-changing work should not start from folder structure or implementation tasks.
  • Gherkin is optional; equivalent behavior formats are valid when they preserve actor, context, trigger, observable outcome and evidence mapping.
  • DDD is conditional: required for complex domains and risky workflow-heavy systems, but not forced onto trivial CRUD.
  • Ubiquitous language must trace into requirements, API/event/schema, UI labels, code/tests and owner review.
  • Accepted gaps are valid only with owner, reason, scope, review date and downstream risk.
  • AI-generated domain claims require source, owner confirmation or explicit accepted-gap status.

docs.title: Инструкции применения на проекте
docs.text:
1. Классифицируйте работу: new requirement, behavior change, bug with behavior risk, domain model change, API contract change, data model change, UI flow/copy change или AI/agent behavior change.
  2. Зафиксируйте business intent: пользователь/стейкхолдер, проблема, ожидаемый outcome, value signal, scope и non-goals.
  3. Дайте requirement stable ID и owner. Owner может быть product, domain expert, technical owner или explicit accepted gap.
  4. Запишите constraints: compliance, privacy, security, operational, performance, platform, accessibility, data retention, localization, cost, rollout.
  5. До implementation напишите acceptance scenarios. Минимальный trace: requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner.
  6. Используйте конкретные examples, а не абстрактное описание. Для важного business rule нужен happy path и хотя бы один edge/negative path.
  7. Gherkin полезен, когда сценарии должны быть executable или понятны domain experts. Equivalent behavior table допустим, если сохраняет actor, context, trigger, observable outcome и evidence.
  8. Сценарии должны быть declarative: без UI selectors, database internals, function names и test harness деталей.
  9. User story title не считается requirements. Story готова только с acceptance criteria, business rules, examples, open questions, deferred slices и non-goals.
  10. Если story спорная, крупная или размытая, используйте Example Mapping: story -> rules -> examples -> questions.
  11. Для сложных процессов используйте EventStorming или Domain Storytelling, чтобы достать domain events, actors, commands, policies, hotspots и candidate boundaries.
  12. DDD включайте условно: complex domain, workflow-heavy, enterprise, data-heavy, multi-service, multi-context или AI/agent domain decision work.
  13. Для simple CRUD/MVP допустим accepted gap: domain_model_not_required, owner, reason, scope и review date.
  14. Если DDD включен, фиксируйте bounded contexts, key aggregates/entities/value objects, domain services, invariants, domain events и integration relationships.
  15. Каждый bounded context должен мапиться в architecture/team/API/data boundary или иметь explicit accepted gap.
  16. Ubiquitous language не равен glossary. Термин должен трассироваться к requirement, API/event/schema, UI label, code/test и owner.
  17. Unresolved domain conflicts храните как open decisions/questions, а не как скрытые assumptions.
  18. Domain event, который пересекает boundary, должен иметь meaning, producer, consumers, schema link, ordering/idempotency assumptions и privacy classification.
  19. При изменении requirement после planning запускайте change impact review: tests/evals, API, DB, UI, docs, rollout, rollback.
  20. Для business-critical, compliance, finance/legal или AI-generated domain claims нужен domain expert / owner review.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS routing
docs.text:
• requirements-author: пишет requirements, non-goals, constraints, acceptance criteria и scenario packets.
  • implementation-planner: блокирует implementation, если behavior scenarios, traceability или complex-domain gates отсутствуют.
  • agent-team-designer: использует bounded contexts и ownership boundaries для team/subagent split.
  • test-eval-designer: превращает acceptance scenarios в test/eval plan и evidence requirements.
  • risk-reviewer: проверяет source-backed domain claims, accepted gaps, owner review и impact на API/UI/data/security/release.
  • docs-maintainer: поддерживает requirement IDs, source registry, methodology pages, glossary/ubiquitous language и traceability docs.

docs.title: Candidate eval fields
docs.text:
• Requirements scope, user/stakeholder, non-goals and owner are present.
  • Stable requirement IDs exist for multi-slice, regulatory or long-lived work.
  • Acceptance scenarios include observable outcomes, checks and evidence owner.
  • Business rules include source, owner, exceptions and enforcement layer.
  • Open questions are recorded with owner and next action.
  • Example Mapping or equivalent clarification exists for unclear/large/disputed stories.
  • Complex domain work has domain model, context map or explicit accepted gap.
  • Bounded contexts trace to architecture/team/API/data boundary or accepted gap.
  • Ubiquitous language terms trace to source, artifacts, implementation and owner.
  • Domain events crossing boundaries have meaning, schema, producer/consumer, ordering/idempotency and privacy notes.
  • Requirement changes include downstream impact review for tests, API, DB, UI, docs, evals, rollout and rollback.
  • accepted_gap_recorded exists when methodology gate is intentionally skipped.

docs.title: Что ещё включить в deep research
docs.text:
• Requirement taxonomy: functional, non-functional, compliance, operational, AI behavior, data/privacy, release/rollback.
  • Requirement quality criteria: atomicity, clarity, testability, feasibility, traceability, source and owner.
  • Product discovery connection: opportunity, outcome, metric, user segment, value/risk.
  • Domain discovery playbooks: Example Mapping, EventStorming, Domain Storytelling, domain expert interview.
  • Domain-to-architecture mapping: bounded context -> C4 boundary -> team/subagent ownership -> API/data contract.
  • Domain-to-AI mapping: AI-generated domain claims, eval datasets, reviewer rubric, hallucination/grounding risk.
  • Conflict resolution process for overloaded terms.
  • Accepted gap policy for simple CRUD/MVP.
  • Domain review checklist for human owner.
  • Change impact matrix from requirement to tests, API, database, UI, docs, evals and release.

docs.title: Unsupported claims not adopted
docs.text:
• "BDD replaces testing." BDD clarifies behavior, but does not replace unit, integration, contract, exploratory, performance, security or eval checks.
  • "Gherkin is mandatory for BDD." Gherkin is one useful notation, not the concept itself.
  • "A user story template is a complete requirement." A template without criteria, examples, business rules and evidence owner is incomplete.
  • "A glossary is ubiquitous language." Ubiquitous language must be used in conversations, models, code/API/UI and owner review.
  • "DDD is the right default for every project." It has coordination cost and is most useful for complex domains.
  • "OpenAPI is the requirements source of truth." OpenAPI is a contract artifact and does not replace business intent.

docs.title: Open questions for future implementation
docs.text:
• Which requirement quality fields should become mandatory for all behavior-changing work?
  • When should accepted domain_model_not_required be allowed for simple CRUD/MVP work?
  • Should requirements-traceability-matrix.md be generated for every project or only risky/multi-team work?
  • How should Product-Agent OS detect overloaded domain terms automatically?
  • Which event discovery method should be recommended first: EventStorming, Domain Storytelling, interviews or Example Mapping?

docs.title: Проверки
docs.text:
• Every behavior change maps requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner.
  • Complex domain work has domain_model_when_complex_domain or explicit accepted gap.
  • Every bounded context maps to architecture/team/API/data boundary or accepted gap.
  • Ubiquitous language terms trace to project artifacts, not only definitions.
  • Domain events that cross boundaries have schema, producer/consumer, ordering/idempotency and privacy notes.
  • Requirement changes trigger impact review across tests/evals, API, DB, UI, docs and rollout.
  • Business-critical, compliance, finance/legal and AI-generated domain claims have owner review.

docs.title: Типовые сбои
docs.text:
• Implementation starts from folders or framework choices, not behavior.
  • User story title is treated as complete requirements.
  • Критерии приемки describe implementation details instead of observable outcomes.
  • BDD/Gherkin becomes test automation boilerplate unreadable to domain experts.
  • Example Mapping creates questions without owner or next action.
  • DDD is forced onto simple CRUD and slows delivery.
  • DDD is skipped for complex domain because no one owns the model.
  • Bounded contexts exist only in workshop notes and do not map to architecture/API/data/team boundaries.
  • Glossary exists, but code/API/UI use different terms.
  • Domain events are technical messages without business meaning or contract.
  • AI infers domain rules from memory/chat without source or owner confirmation.

docs.title: Security, Privacy & Compliance
docs.text:
Source status: official + legal/regulatory reference + vendor documentation + tool-assisted + experiment

Источники: NIST SSDF SP 800-218, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST Privacy Framework, NIST Privacy Framework 1.1 usage guidance, OWASP SAMM, OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security, OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, OWASP Secrets Management, OWASP Logging, Codex agent approvals and security, OpenAI data controls, OpenAI safety best practices, OpenAI production best practices, SLSA, OpenSSF Scorecard, SPDX, CycloneDX, GitHub Actions secure use, GitHub secret scanning, CCPA, GDPR, Context7 research, research dossier.

docs.title: Deep research цель
docs.text:
Security, Privacy & Compliance слой определяет gates для authn, authz, permissions, secrets, PII, sensitive data, payments, billing, abuse controls, audit logging, supply chain, CI security, AI/agent security and regulated delivery.

Главный принцип: security-sensitive work сначала планируется и классифицируется, потом реализуется. Нельзя менять auth, permissions, production data, payments, secrets, policy, external systems или agent tool permissions без threat surface, approval boundary, rollback and current evidence.

docs.title: Поддержанные факты
docs.text:
• NIST SSDF and NIST Cybersecurity Framework provide security lifecycle and risk-management vocabulary for secure development.
  • NIST Privacy Framework and usage guidance support privacy profiles, SDLC alignment, accountability and data-processing ecosystem roles.
  • OWASP SAMM, ASVS, Top 10, API Security and LLM Top 10 provide security practice, verification and risk catalogs for web/API/AI systems.
  • OWASP Secrets Management and Logging cheat sheets support no-secrets and redaction policies for prompts, logs, traces, screenshots and artifacts.
  • Codex agent approvals and security treats sandbox, approvals and external-write boundaries as security controls for Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, subagents, skills, MCP and automations.
  • OpenAI data controls, safety and production best practices support AI product data handling, monitoring, abuse and operational readiness concerns.
  • SLSA, OpenSSF Scorecard, SPDX, CycloneDX and GitHub Actions security docs support supply-chain, SBOM, provenance and CI-permission review.
  • GDPR and CCPA are legal references; project docs must not claim compliance without applicability, qualified owner and evidence.

docs.title: Assumptions
docs.text:
• Security-sensitive work starts read-only until threat surface, data classification, approval boundary, rollback and verification plan are explicit.
  • Security readiness is not proven by code inspection; it requires tests, review, scan, owner evidence or explicit gap.
  • Compliance claims require applicability matrix and qualified owner review.
  • Secrets/private data can leak through prompts, screenshots, traces, logs, fixtures and docs even when code is clean.
  • Codex Security scan should be explicit: run with evidence, not requested or blocked.

docs.title: Инструкции применения на проекте
docs.text:
1. Классифицировать slice до реализации. Security-sensitive triggers: authn, authz, permissions, payment, billing, secrets, PII, sensitive data, audit logs, rate limits, abuse controls, CI permissions, package release, external writes, agent tool permissions.
  2. Для security-sensitive work держать workflow read-only, пока threat surface, data classification, approval boundary, rollback and verification plan не стали explicit.
  3. Зафиксировать actors, assets, entry points, trust boundaries, privileged operations, data exposed, external systems and abuse cases.
  4. Classify data before examples, fixtures, evals, logs, traces, screenshots or docs.
  5. Не хранить raw secrets, credentials, private keys, raw PII, payment data, raw private chats, access tokens или private customer data в docs, prompts, memory, fixtures, examples, logs or templates.
  6. Для auth/authz changes описать allowed behavior, forbidden behavior, role/scope matrix, object ownership checks and negative tests.
  7. Для API/security scheme changes обновить OpenAPI/equivalent contract: scheme, scopes, error behavior, negative examples.
  8. Для web app technical controls использовать versioned ASVS mapping, если ASVS применим.
  9. Для public APIs, webhooks and integrations использовать OWASP API Security risks в threat review.
  10. Для AI/RAG/agent workflows проверять prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, excessive agency and overreliance.
  11. Для Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, subagents, skills, MCP and automations считать sandbox, approvals and external-write boundaries security controls.
  12. Для CI/release workflows фиксировать least-privilege permissions, secret use, artifacts, cache, external action pinning and approval boundary.
  13. Для dependencies/releases фиксировать vulnerability status, update path, SBOM/provenance status and release integrity evidence where applicable.
  14. Для privacy-impacting work фиксировать purpose, data minimization, retention, deletion/export expectations, access, sharing and legal/regulatory owner.
  15. Для compliance-sensitive work создать applicability matrix. Не заявлять GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2 или enterprise compliance из code inspection alone.
  16. Требовать tests or explicit gaps для touched authn, authz, permission, secret handling, PII handling, abuse control, rate limit, audit logging and external writes.
  17. Требовать owner review для security-sensitive changes и explicit approval для production data, payment/billing, secret rotation, policy changes and external security systems.
  18. Фиксировать rollback/mitigation: feature flag, kill switch, permission rollback, secret rollback, payment disable path, data access rollback or release revert.
  19. Security readiness claim требует current tests, review evidence, scan evidence, owner evidence или explicit gap.
  20. Codex Security scan использовать только когда пользователь явно попросил scan/security review; не подразумевать scan из одного факта security workflow.

docs.title: Применяемые методологии разработки
docs.text: Методология Когда применять Как выглядит в проекте Secure SDLC / SSDF Production/shared software Security practices integrated into requirements, design, implementation, tests, release and vulnerability response. Security-sensitive planning-first workflow Auth, data, payment, secrets, audit, CI, agents Read-only inventory, threat surface, approval boundary, rollback and verification plan before implementation. Threat modeling New trust boundary, external integration, privileged operation Actors, assets, entry points, trust boundaries, abuse cases, mitigations, residual risk. ASVS-driven verification Web application security controls Versioned ASVS controls mapped to tests, owner evidence and explicit gaps. API security review APIs, webhooks, integrations, generated clients Auth scheme, object/function authorization, rate limits, unsafe consumption, negative tests. Privacy-by-design PII, sensitive data, analytics, telemetry, user content Classification, minimization, purpose, retention, deletion/export, access, sharing. Secrets management Tokens, keys, credentials, signing material Storage, rotation, access scope, scanning, incident path, no raw secrets in artifacts. Least privilege and approval-bound operations CI, MCP, tools, agents, external writes Scoped permissions, human approvals, staged drafts and audit-ready evidence. Abuse-control design Public endpoints, signup, payments, AI tools, uploads Abuse cases, rate limits, monitoring, escalation and kill switch. Audit logging and monitoring Sensitive/admin/payment/data-access actions Event taxonomy, redaction, retention, alerting and investigation path. Supply chain security Dependencies, packages, containers, CI actions SBOM, dependency review, provenance, pinned actions, vulnerability workflow, release integrity. AI/LLM security review Prompts, tools, RAG, agents, model outputs Prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, excessive agency, red-team/eval cases. Compliance overlay mapping Regulated domain or contract obligation Applicable source, owner, evidence, non-goals, review cadence. Vulnerability response Security bug, advisory, leaked secret, abuse incident Triage, severity, containment, fix evidence, disclosure path, post-incident lessons.

  • threat-model.md: actors, assets, trust boundaries, entry points, abuse cases, mitigations, residual risk.
  • data-classification-register.md: field/data class, sensitivity, purpose, retention, access, deletion/export, storage.

  • supply-chain-review.md: dependencies, licenses, vulnerabilities, SBOM, provenance, CI action pinning, release signing.
  • sbom-manifest.md: format/version, generation command, validation command, release artifact, storage policy.
  • ci-permissions-review.md: workflow triggers, token permissions, secrets, external actions, artifacts, approvals.
  • ai-security-review.md: prompt injection, tool permissions, RAG data exposure, model output handling, red-team cases, links to llm-ai-rag behavior/eval evidence.
  • compliance-applicability-matrix.md: regulation/contract, applicability, owner, evidence, non-goals, review cadence.
  • vulnerability-response-record.md: finding, severity, affected versions, containment, fix, verification, disclosure.
  • approval-record.md: production data, external write, payment/billing, secret rotation or policy change approval.

docs.title: Что еще включить в deep research
docs.text:
• Maturity levels: baseline, team, production, regulated.
  • Domain overlays: finance, healthcare, minors, enterprise, public sector, marketplace, AI agent tooling.
  • ASVS level selection policy: when Level 1 is enough and when Level 2/3 should be considered.
  • API security negative test templates: BOLA, BFLA, object property authorization, rate limits, unsafe consumption.
  • Secret scanning and redaction policy across prompts, logs, screenshots, traces, eval datasets and docs.
  • SBOM/provenance decision policy: internal app vs package/plugin/release artifact.
  • Agent security model: MCP allow/deny, tool permissions, shell approvals, external writes, data exposure.
  • Privacy lifecycle: data discovery, classification, minimization, retention, deletion/export, incident response.
  • Compliance evidence model: source, applicability, owner, review date, current evidence, gaps, non-goals.
  • Vulnerability response workflow: triage, containment, disclosure, patch release, postmortem.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS routing
docs.text:
• workspace-discovery-auditor detects auth, permissions, secrets, CI, payments, PII, sensitive data, security docs, SBOM/provenance, ASVS/SSDF/OWASP signals and agent tool permissions.
  • requirements-author records privacy constraints, security-sensitive scope, compliance overlays, approval boundaries and forbidden behavior.
  • implementation-planner blocks plan-ready status when security-sensitive classification, threat surface, data classification, rollback, owner review or approval boundary is missing.
  • test-eval-designer defines authz negative tests, abuse/rate-limit tests, audit logging checks, privacy fixture policy and AI/agent red-team cases.
  • risk-reviewer owns security/privacy quality verdict, missing evidence, unsupported compliance claims and residual risk.
  • release-operator carries security notes, license notes, SBOM/provenance notes, owner approvals and rollback into release readiness.
  • Codex Security plugin workflows are used only when explicitly requested; otherwise scan status is not requested.

docs.title: Candidate readiness gates
docs.text:
• security_sensitive_classification_present: sensitive boundary impact is classified before implementation.
  • security_risk_review_present: threat surface, owner review, tests, rollback and residual risk are present.
  • threat_surface_present: actors, entry points, assets, trust boundaries and abuse cases are explicit.
  • data_classification_present: data class, purpose, retention, access and no-secrets status are present.
  • privacy_impact_record_present: PII/telemetry/user-content/customer-data changes include minimization, retention, deletion/export, sharing and legal owner.
  • secrets_policy_present: secrets/tokens/keys/webhooks/signing material have storage, rotation, access scope, scanning and no-artifact-secrets policy.
  • authz_negative_tests_present: auth/authz/role/scope/resource ownership changes include denied actions and privilege escalation tests.
  • api_security_scheme_present: API/integration auth change has contract security scheme, scopes, error behavior and negative examples.
  • asvs_mapping_present: web security controls have ASVS version, applicable controls, evidence and gaps.
  • abuse_rate_limit_review_present: public endpoint/payment/AI/tool/upload/messaging path has abuse cases, limits, monitoring and fallback.
  • audit_logging_review_present: sensitive/admin/payment/data-access action has event taxonomy, redaction, retention and alerting.
  • supply_chain_review_present: dependency/package/container/CI action/release change has vulnerability status, SBOM/provenance or update path.
  • ci_permission_review_present: CI/workflow/action change has token permissions, secrets, triggers, artifacts and approval boundary.
  • ai_security_review_present: prompt/RAG/tool/agent/model-output security change covers prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse and excessive agency.
  • compliance_overlay_present: regulated/contractual claim has applicable source, owner, evidence and non-goals.
  • external_write_approval_present: production data, payment/billing, secret rotation, policy change or external security-system mutation has approval and rollback.
  • security_evidence_before_completion: security readiness claim has current tests/review/scan/owner evidence or explicit gap.

docs.title: Candidate eval fields
docs.text:
• Security-sensitive classification exists before implementation.
  • Threat surface includes actors, assets, entry points, trust boundaries, privileged operations and abuse cases.
  • Data classification covers purpose, retention, access, sharing and no-secrets status.
  • Privacy-impacting work includes minimization, retention, deletion/export and legal owner.
  • Auth/authz changes include allowed behavior, forbidden behavior, object ownership and negative tests.
  • API security change has contract security scheme, scopes, error behavior and negative examples.
  • ASVS mapping includes version, applicable controls, evidence and gaps where applicable.
  • Abuse/rate-limit review covers public endpoints, payments, uploads, messaging and AI/tool actions.
  • Audit logging review includes event taxonomy, redaction, retention and alerting.
  • Supply-chain review includes vulnerability status, pinned actions, SBOM/provenance or update path.
  • AI security review covers prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse and excessive agency.
  • Security readiness claim cites current tests/review/scan/owner evidence or explicit gap.

docs.title: Tooling candidates
docs.text: Tooling area Candidate Notes Secure development NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM Lifecycle practices and maturity model. Web/API verification OWASP ASVS, OWASP API Security Controls, negative tests, auth/authz and API risk mapping. AI security OWASP LLM Top 10, OpenAI safety/production guidance Prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse and overreliance cases. Privacy governance NIST Privacy Framework, GDPR, CCPA Applicability, owner and evidence, not generic compliance claim. Secrets/logging OWASP Secrets Management, OWASP Logging Storage, rotation, redaction, retention and no-artifact-secrets policy. Supply chain SLSA, OpenSSF Scorecard, SPDX, CycloneDX Provenance, SBOM, dependency review and release integrity. CI security GitHub Actions secure use, dependabot.yml Permissions, pinned actions, secret boundaries, update automation. Codex security boundary Codex sandbox and approvals External writes, MCP, hooks, automations and privileged actions.

docs.title: Проверки
docs.text:
• Security-sensitive scope is classified before implementation.
  • Threat surface includes actors, assets, entry points, trust boundaries, privileged operations, data exposed and abuse cases.
  • Docs, prompts, fixtures, evals, logs and screenshots contain no raw secrets or private data.
  • Auth/authz changes include allowed behavior, forbidden behavior and negative tests.
  • Privacy-impacting work includes purpose, minimization, retention, deletion/export and owner review.
  • API security changes include contract security scheme and negative examples.
  • Supply chain review includes vulnerability status, SBOM/provenance status and release integrity notes where applicable.
  • CI changes include least-privilege permissions and staged external-write policy.
  • AI/agent security review covers prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse and excessive agency.
  • Compliance claims cite applicable legal/regulatory/contract source and qualified owner evidence.
  • Rollback/mitigation path is explicit.
  • Codex Security scan status is explicit: run with evidence, not requested, or blocked.

docs.title: Типовые сбои
docs.text:
• Security review is only a checklist after coding.
  • Threat model omits actors, trust boundaries or abuse cases.
  • Authorization tests cover happy path only.
  • API docs list auth scheme but omit scopes, error behavior or negative examples.
  • Secrets are absent from code but leak through prompts, logs, traces, screenshots, fixtures or generated docs.
  • Privacy review records data fields but omits purpose, retention, deletion/export or sharing.
  • Compliance claim is made without applicability matrix and qualified owner evidence.
  • SBOM is generated once but not tied to release, vulnerability triage or provenance.
  • CI workflow uses broad permissions or unpinned actions without review.
  • AI/agent workflow ignores prompt injection, tool misuse, data leakage or excessive agency.
  • Codex Security scan is implied but not explicitly requested or evidenced.
  • External security systems, production policy, customer data, payment/billing or secret rotation are changed without approval.

docs.title: Unsupported claims not adopted
docs.text:
• "Security review can happen after coding." Security-sensitive work needs planning, classification and approval boundary before implementation.
  • "No secrets in code means no secret leakage." Prompts, logs, traces, screenshots, fixtures and docs can leak secrets too.
  • "ASVS/OWASP mapping proves compliance." It supports verification, but compliance needs applicability, owner and evidence.
  • "SBOM generated once means supply chain is handled." SBOM must connect to release, vulnerability triage and provenance.
  • "Codex Security scan happened because the topic is security." Scan status must be explicit.

docs.title: Open questions for future implementation
docs.text:
• Which maturity labels should security methodology use: baseline, team, production, regulated?
  • Which domain overlays should ship first: finance, healthcare, minors, enterprise, public sector, marketplace or AI agent tooling?
  • How should ASVS level selection be encoded for small versus regulated projects?
  • Which API security negative test templates should Product-Agent OS generate by default?
  • When should SBOM/provenance be required for internal apps, packages, plugins or release artifacts?
  • How should vulnerability response records connect to release and postmortem workflows?

docs.title: Solution Architecture
docs.text:
Source status: official + verified methodology + local implementation evidence + tool-assisted + experiment

Источники: C4 model, arc42, ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022, SEI Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method, MADR, Structurizr DSL, Mermaid syntax reference, Thoughtworks: Fitness function-driven development, AWS Well-Architected Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, OpenTelemetry Documentation, OpenAPI Specification v3.2.0, AsyncAPI Specification, Product-Agent OS architecture, Context7 research, research dossier.

docs.title: Deep research цель
docs.text:
Solution Architecture слой описывает, как business capabilities, requirements, bounded contexts, services, data stores, APIs, UI surfaces, LLM/AI components, security boundaries и operations собираются в одну проверяемую систему.

Для большого проекта этот слой должен быть достаточно конкретным, чтобы engineer, agent или subagent понимал architecture boundary, ownership, public contracts, data ownership, quality attributes, runtime topology и rollback impact до изменения файлов.

docs.title: Главный принцип
docs.text: Architecture artifact должен отвечать на практический вопрос: какое решение принимается, какая boundary затрагивается, какие качества и риски меняются, чем это проверяется и кто владеет последствиями. Диаграмма без owner, decision, contract или verification быстро становится декоративной.

docs.title: Поддержанные факты
docs.text:
• C4 model provides a hierarchy of System Context, Container, Component and Code diagrams, with additional dynamic/deployment views when useful.
  • arc42 provides structured architecture communication around goals, constraints, context, solution strategy, building blocks, runtime, deployment, concepts, decisions, quality and risks.
  • ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 frames architecture description around stakeholders, concerns, viewpoints and model kinds.
  • SEI ATAM supports tradeoff analysis when quality attributes conflict.
  • MADR gives a lightweight Markdown ADR format for significant architecture decisions.
  • Structurizr DSL and Mermaid support architecture-as-code paths where diagrams should survive diff, review and build.
  • AWS and Azure Well-Architected frameworks provide workload review vocabulary for reliability, security, cost, operations, performance and provider-specific concerns.
  • OpenTelemetry, OpenAPI and AsyncAPI provide downstream traceability surfaces for runtime observability and public contract architecture.

docs.title: Assumptions
docs.text:
• Architecture docs are useful only when tied to decisions, boundaries, ownership, contracts, quality attributes, verification and rollback.
  • C4 context/container views are the normal minimum for complex systems; component/code views are conditional.
  • Architecture-as-code is preferred when diagrams must be reviewed, built or kept current, but early prototypes can record accepted gaps.
  • ADR is required for significant or irreversible architecture decisions; trivial local choices can stay in RUNLOG.md.
  • Quality attributes must become scenarios, measurable targets or explicit owner-approved gaps.
  • AI-generated architecture is a draft until checked against repository evidence, source-backed standards and owner review.

docs.title: Инструкции применения на проекте
docs.text:
1. Классифицируйте architecture impact: new boundary, service split, public API/event, data ownership, runtime topology, security model, integration, dependency rule, migration, platform choice, AI/agent route или quality attribute.
  2. Назовите stakeholders and concerns: users, product owner, domain owner, service owner, security/privacy, operations, support, data owner, release owner.
  3. Сформулируйте architecture question. Не рисуйте диаграмму "про всё"; укажите decision, risk или onboarding question, на который она отвечает.
  4. Для complex system, public contract, data/security-sensitive work, multi-service, multi-team или unclear ownership обновляйте architecture-overview.md.
  5. Начинайте с C4 System Context: users, external systems, external APIs, trust boundaries, major data flows.
  6. Затем фиксируйте C4 Container view: UI, services, workers, queues, storage, integration adapters, AI/LLM components, deployable/runtime units.
  7. Component view добавляйте только для containers, где internal structure risky, non-obvious или owned by multiple teams/agents.
  8. Code view добавляйте только когда source navigation недостаточен и diagram реально помогает review.
  9. Для каждой boundary фиксируйте responsibility, owner, public contract, data ownership, runtime evidence и mapped bounded context, если он есть.
  10. Для каждого implementation slice называйте architecture boundary, files in scope, files out of scope, contract impact, data impact, runtime impact и rollback path.
  11. ADR/MADR обязателен для significant decisions: architecture boundary, public contract, persistent data, security/privacy model, quality attributes, runtime topology, migration, technology choice или irreversible cost.
  12. В ADR записывайте alternatives and consequences. Decision без alternatives обычно является assertion, а не architecture reasoning.
  13. Vague quality attributes переводите в scenarios или measurable targets: latency, throughput, availability, recovery, durability, consistency, security, privacy, accessibility, maintainability, observability, cost.
  14. Если quality attributes конфликтуют, записывайте tradeoff. Не прячьте cost/reliability/performance/security compromise в implementation details.
  15. Используйте architecture-as-code там, где диаграммы должны жить в diff, review и build. Mermaid достаточно для lightweight Markdown docs; Structurizr DSL лучше, когда один model должен генерировать несколько C4 views.
  16. Проверяйте diagram render или явно записывайте missing render check. Stale diagram хуже, чем отсутствующая диаграмма.
  17. Трассируйте public contracts к architecture: OpenAPI operations, AsyncAPI channels, SDK interfaces, generated clients, event schemas, consumer/versioning impact.
  18. Трассируйте data ownership: source of truth, read replicas, derived data, analytics, retention, deletion, migration/backfill, privacy classification.
  19. Трассируйте runtime topology к evidence: environments, deployment units, config/secrets, health checks, observability, dashboards, alerts, rollback, runbook links.
  20. Для повторяющегося drift добавляйте architecture fitness functions: dependency direction, forbidden imports, public contract drift, missing observability, security gates, cost budgets, docs freshness, eval thresholds.
  21. Accepted gaps записывайте явно: owner, reason, residual risk, review date, follow-up condition.
  22. AI-generated architecture считайте draft. Проверяйте against repository files, source-backed standards, runtime evidence и owner review.

docs.text:
• workspace-discovery-auditor: detects architecture docs, ADR, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, DB docs, CI, docs tooling and runtime clues as present_unverified until verified.
  • requirements-author: names product/domain constraints and architecture-significant requirements before planning.

  • risk-reviewer: reviews public contract, data, security, migration, release and rollback impact.
  • docs-maintainer: keeps architecture docs, ADRs, diagrams, contracts and source registry aligned with behavior changes.

docs.title: Candidate eval fields
docs.text:
• Architecture scope, stakeholders, concerns, non-goals and decision question are present.
  • Context view or equivalent boundary map covers users, external systems and trust boundaries.
  • Container/runtime view names UI, services, workers, queues, storage, integrations and deployable units where relevant.
  • Boundary responsibility, owner, public contract and data ownership are documented.
  • Bounded context maps to architecture/team/API/data boundary or accepted gap.
  • Public contract changes trace to OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/contracts, consumers and versioning.
  • Data ownership includes source of truth, retention, deletion, migration/backfill and privacy classification.
  • Trust boundary review exists for auth, PII, payments, external writes or untrusted input.
  • Quality attributes have measurable scenarios, owner and evidence path.
  • Tradeoff record exists for conflicting qualities or irreversible decisions.
  • Diagram render/build/validate check exists when diagram changes.
  • Migration/rollback path exists for service split or architecture migration.
  • Owner review or explicit risk acceptance exists for high-impact architecture change.

docs.title: Что ещё включить в deep research
docs.text:
• Stakeholder concern map: кто читает architecture docs и какие decisions они принимают.
  • Viewpoint catalog: какие views обязательны для web, backend, data, AI, desktop/native, plugin/agent workflows.
  • Quality attribute scenario templates and examples.
  • Architecture decision trigger policy: когда ADR обязателен, когда достаточно RUNLOG note.
  • Tradeoff review checklist for performance/security/cost/reliability/privacy.
  • Architecture fitness functions catalog for dependency rules, contract drift, docs freshness, observability, security gates, AI eval thresholds.
  • Boundary-to-agent ownership rules for parallel subagents/worktrees.
  • Cloud-neutral well-architected review matrix.
  • Runtime evidence packet: health checks, traces, metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, rollback/runbook links.
  • Architecture docs lifecycle: owner, render check, review cadence, stale-doc detection.

docs.title: Проверки
docs.text:
• Complex system work has architecture-overview.md or accepted gap.
  • Every non-trivial slice names architecture boundary and files in/out of scope.
  • Significant architecture decisions have ADR/MADR or accepted gap.
  • Context/container diagrams exist where users, external systems, services, stores or queues matter.
  • Diagrams render or missing render check is explicit.
  • Public contracts map to OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/SDK/event schemas.
  • Data ownership, trust boundaries and runtime topology are visible for sensitive or persistent systems.
  • Quality attributes have measurable scenarios or explicit owner-approved gap.
  • Architecture claims cite current tests, contract checks, runtime evidence, diagram build, owner review or explicit gaps.

docs.title: Типовые сбои
docs.text:
• Architecture page becomes decorative and not tied to decisions.
  • Diagrams are stale because no owner or build/render check exists.
  • "Solution architecture" is treated as role title, not reviewable artifact.
  • C4 code-level diagrams are overused where context/container would be enough.
  • Context view omits external systems, trust boundaries or data flows.
  • ADR records chosen option but omits alternatives, consequences, verification and rollback.
  • Quality attributes are vague slogans: scalable, secure, reliable.
  • Public contracts or data ownership change without architecture trace.
  • Runtime topology omits config/secrets, health checks, observability, rollback or runbook.
  • AI-generated architecture is accepted without repository evidence and owner review.

docs.title: Unsupported claims not adopted
docs.text:
• "Architecture means diagrams." Architecture artifacts must answer decisions, boundaries, quality, verification and ownership questions.
  • "C4 code diagrams are always better because they are detailed." Context/container views are often more useful for product and team coordination.
  • "ADR is bureaucracy." ADR is required when decision impact is significant or hard to reverse.
  • "Well-Architected review proves architecture quality." It is a review lens, not evidence by itself.
  • "Architecture-as-code is always required." It is required when diagrams must survive review/build; otherwise accepted gaps are allowed.
  • "AI can design architecture from chat alone." Repository evidence, source-backed standards and owner review are required.

docs.title: Open questions for future implementation
docs.text:
• Which view catalog should be mandatory by project type: web, backend, data, AI, desktop/native or plugin/agent workflow?
  • What exact trigger should require ADR versus RUNLOG.md decision note?
  • Which architecture fitness functions should ship first: dependency rules, contract drift, docs freshness, observability, security or eval thresholds?
  • How should boundary-to-agent ownership rules be encoded for parallel subagents and worktrees?
  • Should Mermaid remain default, with Structurizr DSL only when one model must generate many C4 views?
  • How should stale architecture docs be detected automatically?

docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Building an AI-Native Engineering Team, Codex use cases, Agent Skills.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Спроектировать набор агентных ролей и повторяемых workflows для команды или проекта.

docs.title: Карта ролей
docs.text: Роль Workflow Артефакт Researcher Сбор источников и требований source cards, brief Planner План реализации implementation plan Builder Scoped implementation diff, tests Reviewer Review по рискам findings Maintainer Обновление docs и changelog docs update

docs.title: Вопросы дизайна
docs.text:
• Какие задачи повторяются чаще трех раз?
  • Какие правила должны жить в AGENTS.md?
  • Какие workflows стоит вынести в skills?
  • Какие задачи read-heavy и подходят для subagents?
  • Где нужна память, а где достаточно checked-in docs?
  • Какие verification commands считаются обязательными?

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Спроектируй AI-native operating model для проекта "{project}".

Верни:
- повторяемые workflows;
- какие из них оформить как skills;
- какие роли агентов нужны;
- какие правила положить в AGENTS.md;
- какие memory boundaries нужны;
- какие проверки доказывают качество.

docs.title: Playbook: build full feature with agents
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: How OpenAI uses Codex, Codex workflows, Codex best practices, A practical guide to building agents.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Провести feature от идеи до PR с управляемыми агентными ролями и проверками.

docs.title: Procedure
docs.text:
1. Создать REQUIREMENTS.md.
  2. Попросить Codex подготовить PLAN.md, не меняя код.
  3. Разделить work по ownership: backend, frontend, tests, docs, release.
  4. Запустить builder tasks в отдельных worktrees или с непересекающимися write scopes.
  5. Запустить test/review agents.
  6. Запустить evals или visual/manual QA.
  7. Подготовить PR body и release notes.
  8. Перенести повторяемый метод в skill или AGENTS.md.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Build this feature as a product-agent workflow.

Read:
- AGENTS.md
- REQUIREMENTS.md

Before changing files:
- produce PLAN.md;
- name ownership boundaries;
- identify required tests and evals;
- list risks and rollback.

During implementation:
- make one focused slice at a time;
- run verification after each meaningful slice;
- update RUNLOG.md.

Final output:
- changed files;
- commands run;
- test/eval result;
- PR summary;
- release notes draft;
- lessons for AGENTS.md or skills.

docs.title: Критерии приемки
docs.text:
• Requirements, plan, tests and run log are explicit.
  • No agent edits outside its ownership without approval.
  • PR summary includes verification evidence.
  • Reusable lessons are captured.

docs.title: Playbook: code review через Codex
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex workflows, Codex subagents, Agent approvals and security.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Использовать Codex как reviewer, который ищет bugs, regressions, test gaps, security risks и maintainability issues.

docs.title: Prompt для одного агента
docs.text:
Review current changes as a code reviewer.

Prioritize:
1. Bugs and behavioral regressions.
2. Security or data-safety risks.
3. Missing tests for changed behavior.
4. Professional coding failures that create real debt: unnecessary custom code, missing existing-capability scan, needless dependency, weak abstraction, brittle refactor or low-signal comments.
5. Maintainability issues only if they affect correctness.

Output findings first.
Each finding must include file, line, severity, and why it matters.
Do not rewrite code unless asked.

docs.title: Профессиональный review кода
docs.text:
Для не механических изменений кода reviewer проверяет Professional Code Authoring standards, .codex/workflows/coding-standards.md и .codex/artifact-templates/coding-standard-checklist.md, если они есть в пакете задачи. Замечания должны указывать:

  • самописный код, где удаление, конфигурация, стандартная библиотека, фреймворк, текущая зависимость или проектный helper решают ту же задачу;
  • новую зависимость без negative_dependency_rule, отклоненных альтернатив, совместимости и доказательств отката или удаления;
  • refactor, который меняет legacy seams без characterization tests или явного accepted gap;
  • поверхностный wrapper, clever abstraction или комментарии, которые пересказывают код вместо объяснения намерения, invariant, риска или trade-off;
  • неподтвержденные claims вроде clean, simple, senior, safe или minimal без доказательств.

Предпочтения только по стилю не являются blockers, если они не создают behavioral, operational, security или maintainability risk.

docs.title: Parallel review
docs.text:
Для больших PR можно явно попросить subagents:

Use one parallel subagent per review track:
- Security risks
- Correctness bugs
- Test gaps
- Maintainability

Wait for all agents and return a consolidated review.
Do not include duplicate findings.

docs.title: Verification
docs.text:
• Проверить, что findings ссылаются на реальные файлы и строки.
  • Запросить reproduction или failing test для каждого high-severity bug.
  • Не принимать stylistic comments как blockers без behavioral risk.
  • Отсутствие доказательств профессионального кодирования считать review gap, а не доказательством runtime behavior.

docs.title: Playbook: Context7 deep research
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Context7 results for OpenAI docs, Source registry.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Использовать Context7 как быстрый retrieval layer для расширения базы знаний, но сохранять official-source discipline.

docs.title: Процедура
docs.text:
1. Сформулировать research question как список capabilities, а не как общий запрос.
  2. Resolve library ID для каждой библиотеки.
  3. Query docs не более чем по трем самым важным направлениям за один проход.
  4. Разделить результаты на:
  5. official facts;
  6. examples/recipes;
  7. architecture implications;
  8. claims that need direct source verification.
  9. Добавить или обновить source cards.
  10. Внести изменения в docs.
  11. Запустить проверки.

docs.title: Хороший запрос
docs.text:
Extract authoritative design details for the OpenAI Agents SDK:
Agent, Runner, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing,
context, multi-agent orchestration, and recommended architecture patterns.
Focus on concepts useful for documenting multi-agent systems with memory.

docs.title: Плохой запрос
docs.text:
Tell me everything about agents.

Он слишком широкий: результат будет трудно проверить и перенести в source registry.

docs.title: Output contract
docs.text:
context7_libraries:
  - library_id: ""
    source_reputation: "High | Medium | Low"
findings:
  - claim: ""
    source_url: ""
    target_doc: ""
    action: "add | update | reject | verify_directly"
risks:
  - ""
verification:
  - "python tools/check_docs.py"
  - "python -m mkdocs build --strict"

docs.title: Playbook: обновление документации
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex changelog, Codex workflows.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Поддерживать базу знаний актуальной при изменениях Codex, Agents SDK и связанных workflows.

docs.title: Trigger
docs.text:
• Новая запись в Codex changelog.
  • Изменение официальной страницы.
  • Новый verified insight.
  • Пользователь просит обновить раздел.

docs.title: Procedure
docs.text:
1. Откройте docs/sources/registry.md.
  2. Найдите source cards, связанные с темой.
  3. Сверьте официальные страницы.
  4. Обновите checked_at.
  5. Измените только затронутые разделы.
  6. Если появляется новая спорная практика, добавьте insight card, а не основную инструкцию.
  7. Запустите:
python tools/check_docs.py
python -m mkdocs build --strict

docs.title: Documentation closure order
docs.text:
Для Product-Agent OS docs closure используйте порядок: source docs -> registry -> docs tests -> check_docs.py -> strict MkDocs -> optional full closure. Этот порядок нужен, чтобы source-backed claims, navigation, generated site и final package evidence не расходились.

Step Что проверить Исходные docs Обновлены только затронутые страницы, каждая non-index page имеет Source status:. Registry Новые или измененные source-backed claims отражены в docs/sources/registry.md. Тесты docs Сфокусированные проверки покрывают новые required pages, route terms или правила структуры. check_docs.py Structure checks pass до claiming documentation closure. Strict MkDocs Запускается, когда могут измениться nav, MkDocs config, Mermaid, Markdown extensions или generated site. Опциональная полная closure Full unittest/fixture/transcript/compatibility/diff checks нужны только при изменении plugin contracts или route logic.

Docs closure не запускает live server, browser automation, provider calls, canonical graph mutation или git stage/commit/push/PR. Пересобирайте site/ только в dedicated site/nav slice или когда пользователь явно просит для generated HTML output.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Обнови раздел "{section}" по официальным источникам.

Constraints:
- Official docs являются source of truth.
- Update source registry checked_at values для touched sources.
- Put community claims в docs/insights/.
- Keep Russian prose и English OpenAI terms.

Verification:
- Запустите python tools/check_docs.py.
- Запустите python -m mkdocs build --strict.

docs.title: Выход
docs.text:
Итоговый отчет должен содержать:

  • измененные файлы;
  • источники;
  • что устарело;
  • что добавлено;
  • команды проверки и их результат.

docs.title: Playbook: Doubt / verifier loop
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment

Источники: Grounded answering, Hallucination Control, Artifact Contracts, Behavioral evals, Batch 40 source-transfer packet.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Doubt / verifier loop превращает ручной запрос "проверь еще раз" в проверяемый completion gate. Рабочая форма: worker_output -> doubt_verification_packet -> completion-skeptic -> revise_or_pass.

Цель не в том, чтобы агент нервно переписал ответ. Цель в том, чтобы извлечь проверяемые claims, требования, evidence gaps и approval boundaries, а затем изменить только те части, где verifier нашел подтвержденный дефект или missing evidence.

docs.title: Trigger
docs.text:
Используйте completion-skeptic, когда есть хотя бы один сигнал:

  • пользователь просит "проверь еще раз", "мы ничего не забыли", "перед финалом проверь";
  • агент собирается сказать "done", "ready", "works", "fixed", "verified" или эквивалент;
  • изменен код, docs/source registry, архитектурный контракт, security/release/eval слой;
  • ответ опирается на current facts, source-sensitive docs, tool output или generated views;
  • есть риск false pass, false rewrite, stale evidence или approval bypass.

Не запускайте loop для простого deterministic вывода, если нет completion claim, risk class или user-trigger.

docs.title: Workflow
docs.text:
1. Сохранить artifact under review: worker output, diff summary, doc draft, plan row или final answer candidate.
  2. Извлечь claim ledger: каждое проверяемое утверждение получает claim_type, status, evidence_refs и residual_risk.
  3. Извлечь requirement ledger: user request, acceptance criteria, non-goals, approval constraints и missing context.
  4. Заполнить evidence ledger: source registry, local files, current commands, eval runs, owner decisions, approved browser/runtime/web checks или explicit missing check.
  5. Запустить skeptic pass: completion-skeptic возвращает verdict pass | revise | needs_more_context | blocked_by_approval | accepted_risk.
  6. Reviser меняет только confirmed gaps. Rule: do not rewrite first.
  7. Финальный ответ называет что проверено, что исправлено, что осталось accepted_gap или residual risk.

docs.title: Packet Excerpt
docs.text:
doubt_verification_packet_v1:
  artifact_under_review: "final answer candidate"
  claim_ledger:
    - id: "C1"
      claim: "The docs navigation includes the new playbook."
      claim_type: "docs_behavior"
      status: "supported"
      evidence_refs: ["mkdocs_nav_current_run"]
  requirement_ledger:
    - id: "R1"
      requirement: "Document architecture, diagrams and examples."
      status: "covered"
  evidence_ledger:
    - id: "mkdocs_nav_current_run"
      provider: "current_command"
      provenance_kind: "command"
      status: "available"
  verdict:
    status: "revise"
    reason: "One example category is missing."
  accepted_gaps:
    - owner: "Product owner"
      reason: "Manual pilot evidence is B40-S5 scope."
      residual_risk: "Usefulness is not proven by docs alone."
      follow_up: "Run B40-S5 pilot ledger."

docs.title: Examples
docs.text: Example id Task type Trigger Packet focus Safe final style docs_research_example docs/research answer "Проверь источники" source registry, official/community split, needs_fresh_check Separate supported facts, assumptions and unsupported claims. code_check_example code change "Готово?" current command evidence, lint/test gaps, approval boundary Name commands run and missing checks; avoid works claim without run evidence. architecture_review_example architecture/spec "Ничего не упустили?" requirements, non-goals, dependency and rollback gaps Revise only confirmed architecture gaps. product_planning_example feature plan "Проверь матрицу" acceptance criteria, user value, dependencies, stop conditions Return missing tasks and accepted scope cuts. security_release_example release/security "Можно выпускать?" approval gates, source status, rollback, no-unapproved-actions proof Block or accepted_risk instead of release claim. ai_eval_example AI/eval work "Проверь качество" baseline, current eval, scorecard thresholds, false pass/rewrite Keep manual-only until pilot and owner review.

docs.title: Failure Modes
docs.text:
• False pass: packet says pass while evidence is stale, generated-only or approval-blocked.
  • False rewrite: skeptic rewrites correct content without a confirmed gap.
  • Fake evidence: command output, source IDs or tool traces are invented.
  • Context leak: raw private chat logs, secrets or local absolute paths enter packet examples.
  • Automation drift: manual success is skipped and the loop becomes an active hook, MCP server, Agents SDK runner or automation.

docs.title: Boundaries
docs.text: No active hook, automation, MCP server, Agents SDK runner or provider call is created by this playbook. It documents the manual and plugin-local path only. Future guardrail or runtime integration requires a separate approval packet, privacy review, scorecard evidence and rollback/disable path.

docs.title: Next Artifact
docs.text: For one task, produce a doubt_verification_packet and a short final answer update. For repeated success, record failure examples, eval cases and owner review, then consider the normal promotion chain: manual -> playbook -> skill -> plugin -> automation candidate.

docs.title: Playbook: eval-driven improvement loop
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Iterate on difficult problems, Model optimization, OpenAI Cookbook, Responses API.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Решать hard tasks через scored improvement loop, а не через одноразовый prompt.

docs.title: Loop
docs.text:
1. Run baseline eval.
  2. Identify the biggest failure mode.
  3. Make one focused change.
  4. Re-run eval.
  5. Inspect generated artifacts.
  6. Log scores and decision.
  7. Continue until deterministic score and LLM-judge average meet thresholds.

docs.title: Eval matrix
docs.text: Check type Что проверяет Пример Deterministic Формальные constraints tests pass, lint, broken links, schema LLM-as-judge Subjective quality usefulness, readability, visual quality Artifact inspection Реальный output screenshot, report, generated page Regression Старые сценарии no previous pass regressed

docs.title: Stopping rule
docs.text:
overall_score_min: 0.90
llm_judge_average_min: 0.90
no_blocking_regressions: true
artifact_review_required: true

docs.title: RUNLOG rule
docs.text:
Каждая итерация должна записывать:

  • baseline or previous best;
  • change made;
  • score before/after;
  • artifact inspected;
  • bottleneck;
  • next attempt.

docs.title: Playbook: grounded answering
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Prompting, Structured Outputs, Model optimization, OpenAI Cookbook.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Дать ответ GPT-моделью с минимальным риском hallucinations: retrieve, constrain, answer, cite, verify, escalate uncertainty.

docs.title: Procedure
docs.text:
1. Определите тип вопроса: factual, design, coding, current data, opinion.
  2. Соберите context из разрешенных источников.
  3. Упакуйте context с source IDs.
  4. Сформулируйте prompt contract.
  5. Потребуйте citations или structured output.
  6. Пропустите ответ через verifier.
  7. Если context недостаточен, верните missing context вместо догадки.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
# Role
You are a grounded answer generator.

# Goal
Answer the user question using only the provided sources.

# Context
<source id="S1" type="official" url="...">
...
</source>

# Rules
- Every factual claim must cite a source ID.
- If a claim is not supported, put it in unsupported_claims.
- If sources conflict, describe the conflict.
- If context is insufficient, do not guess.

# Output
Return:
- answer
- citations
- assumptions
- unsupported_claims
- missing_context
- confidence: high | medium | low

docs.title: Verifier prompt
docs.text:
Check the answer against the provided sources.

For each factual claim:
- supported
- unsupported
- contradicted
- needs_fresh_check

Return verdict: pass | fail | needs_more_context.

docs.title: Критерии приемки
docs.text:
• Нет factual claims без citation.
  • Нет invented source IDs.
  • Missing context явно назван.
  • Если confidence ниже high, ответ объясняет почему.
  • Для текущих фактов выполнена fresh verification или указана невозможность проверки.

docs.title: Playbook: maintain agent operating docs
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: AGENTS.md docs, Codex best practices, AGENTS.md open format.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Поддерживать AGENTS.md, skills, playbooks и templates как живую операционную систему проекта.

docs.title: Update triggers
docs.text:
• Agent repeatedly asks the same clarification.
  • Test command changed.
  • Workflow repeated three or more times.
  • New failure mode appears in review.
  • Automation failed due to missing setup.
  • Team adds new package, service, or deployment path.

docs.title: Maintenance loop
docs.text:
1. Collect recurring friction from RUNLOG and review notes.
  2. Decide destination:
  3. always-on rule -> AGENTS.md;
  4. task method -> skill;
  5. one-off lesson -> insight;
  6. source-backed fact -> source registry and docs.
  7. Keep instructions short and scoped.
  8. Run docs checks.
  9. Verify a sample Codex prompt can follow the updated instructions.

docs.title: Anti-patterns
docs.text:
• Put every possible rule into root AGENTS.md.
  • Hide task-specific workflows in persistent instructions.
  • Create broad skills that overlap.
  • Automate before manual workflow is stable.
  • Keep run logs only in chat history.

docs.title: Playbook: product-ready PR with Codex
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: How OpenAI uses Codex, Codex GitHub integration, Codex best practices.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Подготовить PR, который reviewer может оценить без повторного расследования.

docs.title: PR packet
docs.text:
## Summary
- What changed
- Why it changed
- Product/user impact

## Verification
- Command:
- Result:
- Manual/visual QA:
- Evals:

## Risks
- ...

## Rollback
- ...

## Agent notes
- Sources:
- Assumptions:
- Follow-ups:

docs.title: Review gates
docs.text:
• Tests and evals run after final diff.
  • No unresolved unsupported claims.
  • No broad permissions hidden in automation.
  • Risky behavior has rollback note.
  • Release notes are written if user-facing behavior changes.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Prepare this branch for a product-ready PR.

Read AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PLAN.md, TEST.md and RUNLOG.md.
Return:
- PR title;
- PR body;
- verification evidence;
- risks and rollback;
- release notes draft.
Do not claim tests pass unless you ran them in this turn.

docs.title: Playbook: multi-agent research loop
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex subagents, Codex workflows, Agent Skills.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Создать управляемый research loop для обновления базы знаний: поиск источников, отделение официальных фактов от community signals, проверка claims и выпуск документационного изменения.

docs.title: Когда использовать
docs.text:
• Появился новый Codex changelog entry.
  • Нужно добавить раздел по новой возможности.
  • Есть community trick, который может быть полезен, но требует проверки.

docs.title: Single-agent режим
docs.text:
Исследуй тему "{topic}" для базы знаний Codex.

Сделай:
1. Найди официальные источники OpenAI.
2. Составь source cards.
3. Отдели community claims от official claims.
4. Предложи изменения в docs.
5. Укажи verification commands.
Не смешивай неподтвержденные tricks с официальными инструкциями.

docs.title: Parallel режим
docs.text:
Используйте только когда явно хотите subagents:

Use parallel subagents for this research task.

Agent 1: official Codex docs.
Agent 2: Agents SDK docs for memory/orchestration.
Agent 3: community insight backlog.

Each agent returns verified claims, uncertain claims, and source cards.
Wait for all agents. Then synthesize one update plan and do not include raw logs.

docs.title: Критерии приемки
docs.text:
• Новые official claims имеют source cards.
  • Community claims лежат только в docs/insights/.
  • Каждый proposed edit имеет verification status.
  • MkDocs build проходит.

docs.title: Context7 enrichment
docs.text: Когда тема связана с OpenAI SDK, Responses API, Codex или Agents SDK, добавьте отдельный проход по Context7 deep research. Его цель - найти SDK-level details: primitives, method contracts, tool types, structured output examples и observability patterns. После retrieval все равно обновляйте source registry, а не вставляйте неподписанные claims напрямую.

docs.title: Playbook: перевод использовать case в plugin
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex use cases, Save workflows as skills, Create a CLI Codex can use, Codex plugins, Build plugins.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Превратить официальный Codex использовать case или повторяемый workflow команды в plugin, который можно применять в реальных проектах: с узкими skills, понятными inputs/outputs, безопасной политикой записи, проверками, eval cases и документированным lifecycle.

docs.title: Когда использовать
docs.text:
• Вы нашли официальный использовать case, который часто повторяется в проектах.
  • У вас уже есть удачный Codex thread, runbook, PR, Slack thread, checklist или script.
  • Workflow требует нескольких capabilities: skills, CLI, MCP, GitHub, Slack, Figma, Playwright, Sentry, Spreadsheet, Documents и Computer Use.
  • Команда хочет не длинный prompt, а переносимый plugin.

docs.title: Step 1: выберите archetype
docs.text:
Сначала классифицируйте workflow по официальной таксономии.

official_archetype: "Build responsive front-end designs"
category: "Front-end"
team: "Design / Engineering"
task_type: "Design"
runtime_surface: "Codex App + Playwright skill"
time_horizon: "1h"

Если прямого использовать case нет, выберите ближайший:

  • analysis workflow -> понимание больших codebases, изучение новой концепции, анализ datasets.
  • code workflow -> Refactor codebase, Запустите code migrations, Create CLI.
  • testing workflow -> добавление evals, QA через Computer Use и отладка iOS simulator.
  • workflow automation -> Bug triage, Verified operations, Set up teammate.
  • design/product workflow -> Figma-to-code, PRD drafts и user-stories-to-UI-mocks.

docs.title: Step 2: извлеките workflow contract
docs.text:
Заполните короткую карту.

Поле Вопрос Outcome Что пользователь получает в конце? Входы Какие источники нужны? Read-only phase Что агент обязан проверить до правок? Allowed changes Что можно менять? Forbidden actions Что нельзя делать без approval? Skills/tools Какие skills, plugins, MCP или CLI нужны? Проверка Какие команды, screenshots, evals, logs или review checks доказывают результат? Output format Как агент должен завершить работу?

docs.title: Step 3: запишите manual playbook
docs.text:
Не начинайте со skill. Сначала опишите ручной маршрут.

Goal:
Inputs:
Official archetype:
Constraints:
Read-only inventory:
Smallest useful plan:
Implementation или staged draft:
Verification:
Evidence:
Risks:
Следующий action:

В этом состоянии workflow можно запустить обычным Codex prompt. Цель - получить один удачный runlog.

docs.title: Step 4: создайте source-backed prompt packet
docs.text:
Prompt packet должен ссылаться на официальный использовать case и локальные правила.

Используйте workflow pattern from: <official использовать case URL>.

Work item:
<specific job>

Before editing:
- Read AGENTS.md и target files/sources.
- Inventory inputs и name missing access.
- Propose smallest useful plan.

Constraints:
- Keep first pass focused.
- Не change source-of-truth systems.
- Separate evidence из guesses.
- Остановиться если required credentials или approvals являются missing.

Verification:
- Запустите <command/check/eval>.
- Capture <screenshots/logs/artifacts>.

Return:
- Files changed или staged artifacts.
- Checks run.
- Evidence.
- Risks и open questions.
- Recommended next step.

docs.title: Step 5: решите, нужен ли CLI
docs.text:
Создавайте CLI, если агенту нужны:

  • paged search;
  • exact reads через ID;
  • predictable JSON;
  • downloads из service;
  • local indexing;
  • draft-before-write commands;
  • reusable operation around logs, exports, databases или internal APIs.

CLI не нужен, если достаточно прочитать локальные файлы или один раз вызвать существующий script.

docs.title: Step 6: создайте skill
docs.text:
Skill должен делать одну работу. Не упаковывайте весь product lifecycle в один skill.

Минимальный состав:

  • SKILL.md с trigger, scope, workflow, verification, failure modes.
  • references/ только для длинных runbooks или style guides.
  • scripts/ только для deterministic commands.
  • assets/ для templates, fixtures, examples.

Проверка skill:

Test Ожидание Should trigger Skill вызывается на правильный prompt. Should не trigger Skill не перехватывает соседние задачи. Missing input Skill просит только блокирующий input. Unsafe писать Skill останавливается или создает draft. Ошибка проверки Skill сообщает failure evidence и следующий action.

docs.title: Step 7: упакуйте plugin
docs.text:
Plugin нужен, когда workflow больше одного skill или требует shared distribution.

Plugin blueprint должен включать:

  • target пользователи и teams;
  • official archetypes;
  • included skills;
  • MCP servers или app integrations;
  • CLI commands;
  • model/reasoning policy;
  • permissions и писать policy;
  • eval cases;
  • packaging/update process;
  • owner и maintenance cadence.

Используйте шаблон: Plugin blueprint.

docs.title: Step 8: добавьте eval loop
docs.text:
Для plugin недостаточно "работает на моем prompt". Нужны eval cases.

Case type Пример Успешный путь Вход полный, workflow возвращает правильный artifact. Missing access Slack/GitHub/Figma источник недоступен, plugin называет проблему. Unsafe request Пользователь просит отправить сообщение без approval, plugin делает draft. Wrong scope Prompt просит слишком широкий backlog, plugin сужает до одной job. Ошибка проверки Build/eval/Playwright падает, plugin возвращает evidence и не объявляет успех.

docs.title: Step 9: продвигайте только стабильное
docs.text:
Promotion path:

flowchart LR
    A["Successful manual thread"] --> B["Playbook"]
    B --> C["Skill"]
    C --> D["Failure log"]
    D --> E["Refined skill"]
    E --> F["Plugin"]
    F --> G["Fixture evals"]
    G --> H["Team rollout"]
    H --> I["Automation candidate"]

Automation появляется только после того, как plugin стабильно работает вручную и имеет понятный audit artifact.

docs.title: Review checklist
docs.text:
• Есть официальный source или статус experiment.
  • Есть один ясный job.
  • Входы и выходы зафиксированы.
  • Read-only phase есть до edits.
  • Создайте policy явно указана.
  • Проверку нельзя заменить словами "looks good".
  • Skill не требует приватных данных в примерах.
  • Plugin не смешивает unrelated workflows.
  • Есть failure log и update loop.
  • Есть владелец, который обновляет sources и eval cases.

docs.title: Playbook: workflow to skill
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Agent Skills, Codex best practices, Codex automations.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text:
Превратить повторяемый workflow в Codex skill, который можно использовать вручную, затем тестировать и при необходимости автоматизировать.

Если workflow должен стать plugin, используйте Playbook: use case to plugin после того, как первый skill прошел реальную проверку.

docs.title: Когда workflow готов к skill
docs.text:
• Выполнялся вручную минимум несколько раз.
  • Inputs и outputs стабильны.
  • Есть понятный trigger.
  • Есть verification command или checklist.
  • Риски и forbidden actions известны.

docs.title: Skill rubric
docs.text: Критерий Требование Scope Один job, не "делай все" Trigger Описание содержит явные trigger words Inputs Перечислены required inputs Outputs Формат результата фиксирован Progressive disclosure SKILL.md краткий, references по необходимости Scripts Только для deterministic behavior или external tooling Evals Есть cases: should trigger, should not trigger

docs.title: Lifecycle
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    M["Manual workflow"] --> D["Draft skill"]
    D --> T["Trigger tests"]
    T --> U["Use in real tasks"]
    U --> F["Failure log"]
    F --> R["Refine"]
    R --> P["Package as plugin"]
    P --> A["Automation candidate"]

Для completion-skeptic обязателен тот же путь: manual -> playbook -> skill -> plugin -> automation candidate. Failure log должен фиксировать false pass, false rewrite, fake evidence, missing checks, accepted gaps и owner review. Eval cases должны покрывать trigger и non-trigger behavior до promotion любого automation candidate.

Automation blockers: schedule, hook, MCP server, Agents SDK runner, provider call или external write недопустимы без отдельного approval, rollback/disable path и scorecard evidence.

Use lowercase contract labels in handoffs when needed: eval cases and automation blockers.

docs.title: Candidate product skills
docs.text:
• product-spec-writer
  • implementation-planner
  • test-gap-finder
  • release-note-writer
  • eval-loop-runner
  • ui-visual-reviewer
  • workspace-readiness-auditor

docs.title: Playbook: workspace readiness audit
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex best practices, AGENTS.md docs, Agent approvals and security, Codex automations.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Проверить, готов ли workspace к product-agent workflows.

docs.title: Audit checklist
docs.text: Area Pass condition Instructions AGENTS.md exists и names setup/test commands Политика источников Правила official/community/experiment явно записаны Build Build command documented Tests Test command documented Evals Для subjective outputs есть eval или review rubric Sandbox Правила approval и network известны Worktrees Parallel work strategy exists Skills Повторяемые workflows имеют skill candidates Automation Только stable workflows получают schedule Runtime evidence RUNLOG.md или аналог существует для long запускается

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Audit эта workspace для Codex product-agent readiness.

Не edit files.
Check:
- AGENTS.md;
- setup/build/test commands;
- evals;
- skills candidates;
- automation candidates;
- sandbox/approval risks;
- missing control-plane files.

Return:
- readiness score 0-100;
- blockers;
- recommended docs или skill additions;
- first workflow к automate.

docs.title: Control-plane files
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex best practices, AGENTS.md docs, AGENTS.md open format, Iterate на difficult problems.

docs.title: Почему нужны control-plane files
docs.text: Длинная сессия не должна быть единственным местом, где живут требования и решения. Control-plane files делают работу resumable, reviewable и пригодной для skills/automations.

docs.title: Набор файлов
docs.text: Файл Назначение Обновляется AGENTS.md Постоянные правила проекта Когда правило должно жить между задачами REQUIREMENTS.md Scope, users, acceptance criteria Перед планированием PLAN.md Decomposition, ownership, sequence До implementation TEST.md Deterministic checks, manual QA, visual QA До review EVALS.md LLM-as-judge, score thresholds, artifacts Для subjective/long-horizon задач RUNLOG.md Iterations, scores, decisions, текущий best Во время длинного цикла

docs.title: Что идет в AGENTS.md
docs.text:
