Owner consent must name owner, target class, data policy, allowed commands, blocked commands, evidence destination and stop condition. A pilot target is not approved by being listed in this matrix; the owner still approves the exact run.

docs.title: Success Criteria And Metrics
docs.text:
Pilot success is measured with reviewable criteria rather than a single score.

Metric Passing signal Counter-metric time_to_first_route Operator receives lifecycle state, risk map and safe next action quickly enough for the project context. Fast answer that misses approval or data policy boundaries fails. route_accuracy Suggested route matches repo type, current lifecycle and owner intent. Generic methodology lecture or wrong runtime route fails. artifact_usefulness Proposed artifacts are few, reviewable and tied to source files or verification. Artifact sprawl or internal ledger dumping fails. methodology_selection_precision DDD, TDD, eval, architecture or release gates appear only when relevant. Methodology forced without project evidence fails. owner_question_usefulness Questions are few, blocking and tied to a decision the owner can make. Broad intake questionnaire fails. false_positive_rate Generated claims are marked source-backed, proposal, accepted gap or unsupported. Generated views treated as source of truth fail. evidence_sufficiency Each readiness claim names command evidence, source evidence or owner review. Completion claim without fresh evidence fails.

Accepted-gap rules: each gap needs owner, reason, reduced evidence path, residual risk, follow-up condition and review date. An accepted gap cannot authorize a live server, browser automation, provider call, canonical mutation, external write or git action.

docs.title: Pilot Harness And Evidence Ledger
docs.text:
The harness is a dry-run plan, not active automation.

Required ledger fields:

Field Required content pilot_id Stable id for the pilot run. target_class Archetype and target class from the consent matrix. read_only_pilot_commands Commands that only inspect source, docs, tests, config or generated staged outputs. staged_output_locations Relative destinations for proposed artifacts and evidence. runlog_evidence_schema Time, command, exit code, files inspected, files proposed, approvals checked, residual risks and next action. screenshot_log_redaction Rule for redacting screenshots, logs and console output when visual/runtime evidence is separately approved. cleanup_steps How staged outputs, generated caches and pilot evidence can be removed. approval_checks Confirmation that no approval-bound action is performed by default.

The harness must not become active automation, a live server launcher, a provider gateway, a browser runner, a canonical graph writer, an external writer or a git release tool. It may propose those actions only as separate approval packets.

docs.title: Rollback And Cache Recovery Procedure
docs.text:
Перед production pilot должен быть понятный rollback/remove path для plugin и local cache. Эта процедура не дает approval на deletion, cache mutation, global config mutation, hook activation/deactivation, automation, publication или git action. Она описывает, что должно быть подтверждено до отдельного owner approval.

Step Required boundary pre_rollback_read_only_inspection Проверить installed plugin cache path, package name/version, expected file count, skill count, manifest, .mcp.json, backup path, staged source digest и active hook/automation status. rollback_evidence_preservation Сохранить approval text, inspected paths, before/after counts, command transcript, backup pointer, moved-aside path и residual risks в staged evidence destination. installed_plugin_remove_path Любой remove выполняется через move-aside/quarantine только для exact approved version path; silent delete не допускается. stale_cache_restore_path Restore допустим только из named backup, привязанного к evidence; после restore нужны file/skill count и manifest checks. cache_clear_recovery_path Cache clear/replace допустим только для exact cache root и version id; path должен быть resolved и проверен до write. disable_hooks_automations_if_ever_approved Если hooks или automations когда-либо были активированы, disable path должен назвать exact surface, owner, command boundary, evidence target и rollback owner. post_restore_verification После approved mutation нужны cache inspection, Codex compatibility smoke, docs/test checks when docs changed, diff hygiene и recorded residual risks.

Stop immediately on missing owner approval, unresolved path outside the approved cache root, missing backup, digest/count mismatch, request for destructive delete, active automation without owner, secret/customer data in evidence, external write request, provider/API call, live server/browser request, canonical mutation or git stage/commit/push/PR request.

docs.title: What Not To Expect
docs.text:
• No automatic installation, publication or plugin-cache refresh.
  • No production data access.
  • No live server launch.
  • No browser automation.
  • No provider/API calls.
  • No canonical graph mutation.
  • No external writes or active automation.
  • No git stage/commit/push/PR.

docs.title: Private Sample Pilot Evidence
docs.text:
Первый owner-approved docs-only pilot был выполнен read-only на private sample workspace. Reader-facing docs не раскрывают internal execution labels, private target labels или absolute user-specific paths; точные labels и staged evidence paths остаются только в source-owned ledgers.

Field Evidence target_class docs-only / legacy onboarding staged_evidence_root recorded in source-owned ledger usage_mode legacy_onboarding после clean docs-only intent complexity_profile guided-small source_policy_status blocked staged_outputs infrastructure, status dashboard and project graph validated outside the target target_apply_status blocked until target source-policy/control-plane cleanup target_workspace_mutation_performed false

Что это доказывает: Product-Agent OS после local cache refresh способен выполнить read-only discovery, methodology audit, runtime routing, staged artifact rendering and static content checks на реальном docs-only target. Что это не доказывает: production readiness, public/team release readiness, target apply safety или product success. Следующий безопасный target step: добавить или принять gaps для Source status, source registry/control-plane ownership и smallest local verification contract в самом target.

docs.title: Verification
docs.text: For docs-only pilot design changes, use docs contract tests, documentation structure checks, strict MkDocs when navigation/search/sitemap changes and diff hygiene. For any future real pilot execution, add target-specific command evidence, owner approval, rollback proof and redaction review before claiming readiness.

docs.title: Next Action
docs.text: Use the first-run operator packet, then choose one pilot archetype and prepare a target-specific approval packet. The safe default remains read-only inventory plus staged artifacts.

docs.title: Residual follow-up and site freshness
docs.text:
Source status: project evidence

Эта страница закрывает G5 residual routing: какие G1.1 follow-ups остаются approval-required, как summarise real-target static comparison без раскрытия private targets и почему final DOC-M25 не выполняется автоматически.

docs.title: Residual Routing
docs.text: Residual Owning row Current state Root site, search и sitemap freshness DOC-M25 approval_required_not_run после G2-G5 source updates. Browser Mermaid/HTML proof DOC-M08, DOC-M23, DOC-M29 Approval-required; static smoke не доказывает browser rendering. Broad lint/format/Vale enforcement DOC-M21, DOC-M26, DOC-M30 Advisory или scoped-only до owner thresholds. Link/secret scans и raw report retention DOC-M24, DOC-M30 Не запускать broad scans и не хранить raw reports без approval. Python audit, full SBOM, Node remediation DOC-M24, DOC-M30 Не заявлять remediation или complete SBOM без commands и rollback. Docusaurus, Storybook, Structurizr DOC-M21, DOC-M30 Deferred trigger governance; no install.

docs.title: Static Comparison Summary
docs.text: Для private или real-target comparison храните только redacted target class, run ids, digest deltas, page/key deltas, unsupported claims preserved, actions performed и explicit no-unapproved-actions. Не публикуйте target names, raw paths, private screenshots, raw source excerpts или private data.

docs.title: Final DOC-M25
docs.text: Final DOC-M25 может rebuild root site только после отдельного approval. До этого source docs могут быть current, а generated site, search index и sitemap остаются stale/unsupported для новых G2-G5 pages.

docs.title: DOC-M25 Closure Update
docs.text: DOC-M25 закрыт через documentation_refresh_DOC-M25-A01 со статусом implemented_root_site_search_sitemap_freshness; documentation_refresh_DOC-M25-A02 обновляет generated root site, search index и sitemap после T15 source docs/control-plane sync. Root site, search index и sitemap включают former DOC_M25_PENDING_SITE_PAGES; browser proof, broad scans, dependency remediation, raw report retention, publication, release, deploy и git actions остаются вне этого closure.

docs.title: Closure Rule
docs.text: G5 может закрыть source docs, nav, tests, registry и control-plane sync без root site freshness claim. Полная generated-site freshness требует current strict MkDocs build to root site, search/sitemap evidence и git diff --check в том же approved slice.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS scenarios
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment

Источники: Codex workflows, Codex use cases, Agent approvals and security, Product-Agent OS plugin, Behavioral evals, Codex compatibility.

Эта страница отвечает на практический вопрос: какой route должен выбрать Product-Agent OS plugin, когда Codex App, CLI или IDE extension видит реальный workspace и пользователь просит не просто "написать код", а довести работу до проверяемого результата.

Scenario не заменяет lifecycle. Он выбирает первый малый шаг, minimum artifacts, approval boundary и verification gates. Если evidence нет, route должен вернуть gap, а не готовность.

docs.title: Operator Route Map
docs.text:
Scenarios являются route decisions, а не permission на запуск live systems. Каждый route должен назвать source context, ожидаемые доказательства, approval boundary и stop condition до передачи work в subagent, skill или implementation slice.

Route Когда выбирать Minimum evidence Остановиться condition code_graph_orientation Нужно понять code/docs topology до build или review. Existing source files plus generated graph/cockpit packet labeled как orientation evidence. Не claim source truth из generated graph; read source до implementation claims. live_runtime_read_only Нужно проверить local runtime contract или graph-only API fallback. Governance packet и disabled runtime contract. Остановиться до live server launch пока separate approval packet exists. provider_retrieval_eval Нужно оценить embedding/reranker/LLM provider benefit. Redaction, cache, budget, baseline и threshold fallback packet. Остановиться до any provider/live external model/API call без explicit approval. canonical_graph_mutation_review Нужно проверить proposal acceptance и mutation readiness. Human review ledger, proposal diff, mutation dry-run plan и rollback proof. Остановиться до canonical graph mutation пока owner accepted proposal и rollback evidence является current. real_testing_approval Нужно перейти от staged evidence к controlled real testing. Target/data owner approval, runtime/browser/provider/mutation/git action packet и rollback plan. Остановиться пока specific action является approved; approvals являются не bundled.

docs.title: G4 Operator Flows
docs.text:
G4 routes добавляют четыре системных маршрута. Они не дают approval на cache refresh, global config write, live runtime, browser automation, provider/API calls, target mutation, git, release или automation.

Route Когда применять Evidence boundary instruction_tool_use_compliance Нужно проверить, когда Product-Agent OS skill/plugin route можно выбрать implicitly, а когда нужен explicit user request. Использует официальные Codex docs, allow_implicit_invocation, explicit_only, narrow_implicit и blocked_implicit; fresh-session proof остается отдельным. operator_command_matrix Нужно выбрать безопасную команду для first-run analysis, graph/cockpit или docs-tooling smoke. Использует help/current command evidence, stage только для generated artifacts и оставляет широкие scans/root site rebuild внутри approval-boundary. guided_question_answer_ledger Нужно задать вопрос без превращения intake в длинную анкету. Ограничивает blocking question одной штукой; answers_require_staged_ledger_and_owner_review действует до source promotion. source_cache_session_state Нужно понять, почему source, installed cache и active session могут расходиться. Требует read-only comparison fields и fresh-session proof до любого claim fixed или ready. professional_code_authoring Нужно ограничить custom code, dependency debt, shallow wrappers или risky refactor в не механической coding task. Использует Professional Code Authoring standards, checklist evidence и shortcut evals; остается source contract пока нет runtime или owner-pilot proof.

docs.title: Входы
docs.text:
• цель пользователя или intent_hint, если он передан в Codex runtime runner;
  • read-only workspace audit: files, stack, test/build commands, docs, CI, contracts и control-plane files;
  • текущие AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PLAN.md, TEST.md, EVALS.md, RUNLOG.md;
  • политика источников, sandbox, approvals и known external-system boundaries;
  • previous failure notes, если already recorded в RUNLOG.md.

Key routing fields включают finish_options и safe_next_action; they tell next worker следует ли к answer, stage proposal, request approval, запуск focused verification или stop на evidence gap.

docs.title: Выходы
docs.text:
• usage_mode.primary, secondary mode, confidence и routing reasons;
  • first response: один ближайший полезный шаг без широкого scaffold, rewrite или external mutation;
  • minimum artifacts: concrete files или packets needed до build/review/release;
  • approval boundary: what является read-only, staged-only или approval-required;
  • verification gates: commands, evals, screenshots, logs, owner review или accepted gap;
  • residual risk когда route является based на detection rather than verified evidence.

docs.title: Guided Question Protocol And Status Dashboard
docs.text:
Guided question protocol использует typed question_queue packets so first response может show только next_blocking_question, question_counts и question_summary. Это asks один blocking question maximum, keeps recommended и optional questions в packet, и routes answers в artifacts или accepted gaps. Guided questions являются не workspace evidence и не replace read-only audit, текущий command evidence, runtime evidence, owner review или accepted gaps.

Этот status snapshot является JSON source для generated dashboard view. Этот dashboard stages .codex/product-agent-os/status.html и .codex/product-agent-os/status.json через existing approval flow. status.html является generated view only: underlying artifacts остаются source material, dashboard является не editable database, и stale или inspection-only evidence не может produce success claim.

docs.title: Self-verification и modernization loop
docs.text:
agent_skill_metrics_loop route reviews agents, skills, prompt/policy packs, router/tool policy и harness-version behavior. Он начинается с read-only target registry, explicit запуск evidence, trace intake, dataset quality checks, local grader summaries и grader/judge calibration. Это может stage scorecard ledger records, daily или weekly packets, agent-skill-evaluation-report.html и modernization candidates, но every output является staged evidence only.

Этот route использует политика канонического источника: control-plane artifacts, запуск records, trace/eval packets и accepted gaps может support metrics loop; dashboard HTML, report HTML, memory, raw chat logs и unsupported community claims не могут. Этот report является не является каноническим источником и не может turn stale или generated evidence в completion claim.

Этот approval boundary stays strict. Product-Agent OS records cadence recommendation values L0, L1, L2 и L3, но это creates нет active schedules. Это performs нет live eval/model/API calls, makes нет external writes, applies нет modernization candidates через itself и allows нет self-applied updates. Owner review, rollback target и explicit approval state являются required до any proposed update moves beyond staged review.

docs.title: Project Code Graph And Cockpit
docs.text:
Этот graph route provides read-only project graph foundation и generated cockpit для route orientation. Это может produce staged graph JSON/JSONL с file-level nodes, Python AST overlays, conservative import/call/test edges, structured Markdown/OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/DBML/SQL/JSON/YAML/Mermaid/PlantUML overlays, controlled ontology/schema validation, manifest freshness/provenance, observation lineage, temporal edge helpers, partition scopes и canonical aliases.

Этот cockpit renderer может stage offline .codex/product-agent-os/project-cockpit.html и .codex/product-agent-os/project-cockpit.json review surfaces с top-level pages, Code Flow, static projection, local vendor boundary, graph filters, focused subgraphs, selected-node evidence, fallback tables, mobile layout и нет external assets. Эта helps routes point agents toward source files и stale graph gaps без treating generated artifacts как канонический источник.

Этот boundary остается conservative: generated graph artifacts, runtime graph summaries, analysis reports и HTML cockpit views являются только review evidence. Scanner и cockpit renderer не мутируют target workspaces. Live database/server, live external model/API embedding или cross-encoder providers, LLM semantic extraction, rationale/comment extraction и canonical graph mutation остаются approval-bound future actions, пока explicit approval не задаст redaction, cache, token budget, eval threshold и rollback path.

docs.title: G5 evidence-quality routes
docs.text:
Эти маршруты применяются, когда пользователь спрашивает не о новом поведении plugin, а о качестве и границах generated evidence.

route_id Когда применять Минимальный результат Граница generated_artifact_ux_criteria HTML/report выглядит слишком диагностическим или готовится owner review. Checklist качества, claim ceilings, Vale advisory status, Storybook trigger status. Browser proof и Storybook install остаются approval_required. graph_intelligence_contract Используются graph packets, ontology, rejected links, freshness или query packets. Orientation summary, stale/rejected-link handling, source-read-before-edit reminder. Graph packet не заменяет source read и не разрешает mutation. privacy_supply_chain_retention Обсуждаются cache/session evidence, SBOM, vulnerability audit, remediation или raw reports. Redaction and retention boundary, approval gates, unsupported claims. Broad scans, remediation и raw report retention требуют отдельного approval. local_html_interaction_boundary Generated HTML содержит tabs, search, filters или diagrams. Local-only interaction rules, no-network policy, fallback и browser-proof packet fields. Static check не равен browser proof. residual_follow_up_site_freshness Нужно закрыть G1.1 residuals или понять final DOC-M25. Residual routing table, private-target redaction policy, site freshness gate. Root site, search и sitemap свежие после documentation_refresh_DOC-M25-A01; documentation_refresh_DOC-M25-A02 обновляет их после T15 source sync; browser proof отдельно.

docs.title: Scenario Matrix
docs.text: usage_mode Когда применять first response minimum artifacts approval boundary verification gates first-run-intake Empty workspace, broken verification, existing control-plane или complex first launch. Name mode, confidence, next smallest action и evidence gaps. Intake summary, текущий lifecycle state, следующий action. Нет scaffold, broad fix или parallel work до route является accepted. Read-only audit, control-plane check, политика источников. bug_rescue User reports broken behavior, failing tests или regression. Reproduce или isolate до changing code. bug-rescue-report.md, failure evidence, root-cause hypothesis. Нет fix claim без reproduction evidence. Failing command/log, focused regression check, текущий evidence. greenfield_idea Idea-stage или empty product direction. Shape один vertical slice до scaffold. greenfield-idea-brief.md, selected direction, non-goals. Scaffold требует explicit approval. Acceptance scenarios, first slice plan, lightweight-mode decision. complex_system_acceleration Existing multi-surface app, integrations, multiple services или unclear ownership. Build map до parallelization. integration-catalog.md, ownership split, release gates. Нет parallel work с overlapping files или unclear external-system owners. Integration inventory, ownership review, release risk gates. pr_review Review или merge-readiness request. Stay read-only и review changed files. PR review readiness, changed-files map, pr-risk-review.md. Нет push, PR creation, merge или external comment без approval. Two-stage review: spec compliance до quality/risk. legacy_onboarding Old, undocumented или unknown repository. Orient до refactor. onboarding-map.md, entry points, запуск commands, docs debt. Нет cleanup/refactor пока map и verification status являются explicit. Present-unverified labels, source map, запуск command evidence. api_migration HTTP API, event contract, generated client или consumer change. Plan compatibility до implementation. migration-plan.md, api-contract-review.md, consumers, rollout. Release или breaking change требует owner review и approval. Contract check, backward compatibility, deprecation и rollout evidence. ai_eval_regression AI/RAG quality, prompt, model, retrieval, dataset или judge changes. Baseline first. ai-eval-spec.md, dataset policy, rubric, thresholds. Нет quality claim из inspection-only evidence. Baseline, rerun command, latency/cost/grounding и failure examples. native_mobile_feature iOS, Android или native mobile behavior. Record platform assumptions до implementation. Platform runtime check, permissions, offline/device plan. Permission, signing или store changes требуют approval. Build command, simulator/emulator или device logs, screenshots, manual gap. desktop_local_first Desktop app, filesystem, local DB, indexing или packaging. Map local data и OS assumptions first. Local data risk note, runtime log check, recovery path. Filesystem access, packaging, signing и distribution требуют approval. App logs, build/run command, privacy и rollback evidence. data_migration Schema, backfill, sensitive data, retention или production data risk. Plan migration и rollback до execution. migration-plan.md, database-dictionary.md, data quality checks. Production DB/data access и migration execution требуют approval. Dry run, backup, validation, owner review, rollback evidence. security_sensitive_change Authn/authz, payment, billing, secrets, PII, abuse controls или permissions. Threat surface и owner review до build. security-risk-review.md, approval boundary, rollback plan. Security scans или external security mutations только когда explicitly requested. Tests, audit logging, rate limit, privacy и owner review evidence. ci_stabilization Failing, flaky или unstable CI. Gather failure evidence до changing code. ci-stabilization-report.md, failing job, local reproduction. Remote CI reruns, settings и branch rules требуют approval. Logs, deterministic/flaky classification, isolation plan, rerun evidence. release_packaging Package, SDK, plugin, app, mobile, desktop или open-source release. Build release readiness до publish. release-readiness.md, package metadata, changelog, artifacts. Publishing, tagging, release creation, upload или package registry mutation требуют approval. Build/test/docs evidence, security/license notes, rollback и owner review. docs_only Documentation update без behavior change. Update source-backed docs и запуск docs checks. Source status, affected docs, registry entry когда source-backed claims changed. Hosted docs, CI activation и sharing changes требуют approval. python tools\check_docs.py, strict MkDocs когда nav/build-sensitive. standard_feature Bounded feature work без special scenario risk. Используйте normal lifecycle route. Requirements, plan, test/eval evidence. Writes follow sandbox и project approval policy. Unit/integration/contract checks, влияние на docs, review. professional_code_authoring Не механическая работа с кодом, где важна самая маленькая безопасная реализация. Проверить reuse до custom code. Coding-standard checklist, existing-capability scan, one-line/native candidate, dependency и legacy-seam decisions. Выбор route не активирует hook, runtime или automation. Focused tests/evals/review evidence плюс unsupported-claim ledger. maintenance Small upkeep, formatting или status sync. Keep scope mechanical и evidence explicit. RUNLOG note или control-plane sync. Нет unrelated refactor. Focused command или explicit inspection-only gap.

docs.title: Database & Data Methodology Routing
docs.text:
Database/data work keeps data_migration как route name и adds dedicated Database & Data methodology packet когда schema, migration, ORM, warehouse, data quality, lineage, retention, backup/restore или production-data signals appear.

Minimum staged artifacts включают database-inventory.md, database-dictionary.md, database-migration-plan.md, database-data-contract.md, database-backup-restore-evidence.md, database-lineage-map.md, database-query-performance-review.md, database-retention-deletion-policy.md, database-synthetic-fixtures-policy.md и database-production-access-approval.md когда production data, production DB access, backup restore или destructive migration является involved.

Approval boundary stays explicit: DB introspection, production DB access, production data access, migration execution, destructive cleanup, backup restore и retention mutation являются не automatic actions.

docs.title: Backend Methodology Routing
docs.text: Backend methodology routing applies когда service behavior, background jobs, queues, auth, error handling, observability, deployment или rollback behavior changes. Minimum staged artifacts включают backend-service-overview.md, backend-runtime-behavior.md, runtime/failure evidence, observability evidence, security evidence и rollback evidence.

docs.title: LLM / AI / RAG Methodology Routing
docs.text:
AI/RAG work keeps ai_eval_regression как route name и adds dedicated LLM / AI / RAG methodology packet когда prompts, models, eval configs, structured outputs, tool/function/MCP calls, RAG corpora, retrieval, vector stores, embeddings, grounding, agent traces, guardrails или latency/cost signals appear.

Minimum staged artifacts включают ai-behavior-spec.md, prompt-contract.md, model-decision-record.md, eval-run-report.md, ai-dataset-manifest.md, structured-output-schema.md, ai-tool-contract.md, rag-source-inventory.md, rag-retrieval-config.md, rag-eval-report.md, grounding-rubric.md, agent-task-packet.md, agent-workflow-map.md, guardrail-matrix.md, trace-evidence-packet.md, ai-cost-latency-budget.md и existing ai-eval-spec.md когда user-visible AI behavior changes. agent-handoff-contract.md является legacy/source alias к agent-task-packet.md, не duplicate generated contract.

Eval tooling остается conditional: Promptfoo, OpenAI Evals, pytest/Jest app-backed evals, Ragas и LangSmith являются recorded как selected, rejected или deferred choices based на stack/privacy/CI fit. Model migration records snapshot или approved alias, prompt migration impact, compatibility checks, rollback, minimum threshold и sampling parameter rationale. RAG evidence records deletion path, retention, source exclusion, stale-source pruning, privacy owner, vector store lifecycle и deletion propagation. Failed evals, hallucination reports, unsafe outputs, tool misuse или data exposure route к AI incident workflow с severity, mitigation, follow-up eval и Security/Privacy handoff.

AI/RAG route evidence должен reject filename-only diffs как quality proof.

Approval boundary stays explicit: live model calls, external eval services, vector DB access, raw prompts/traces/customer text, tool writes, shell/money/data exposure и irreversible side effects являются не automatic actions.

docs.title: API & Integrations Methodology Routing
docs.text:
API & Integrations methodology routing applies когда HTTP APIs, event contracts, webhooks, generated SDKs или external providers change. Minimum staged artifacts включают api-inventory.md, api-contract-review.md, api-consumer-map.md, api-contract-test-matrix.md, external-integration-approval.md и compatibility/security/error/event/SDK evidence.

External пишет являются не automatic actions; they требуют explicit approval boundary.

docs.title: Security, Privacy & Compliance Methodology Routing
docs.text:
Security-sensitive work keeps security_sensitive_change как route name и adds dedicated Security, Privacy & Compliance methodology packet когда authn/authz, permissions, secrets, PII, sensitive data, payment/billing, abuse controls, audit logging, supply chain, SBOM/provenance, CI permissions, AI/tool security, external writes, production data, policy changes или compliance overlays appear.

Minimum staged artifacts включают security-risk-review.md, threat-surface.md, asvs-ssdf-mapping.md, authz-negative-test-matrix.md, secrets-policy.md, data-classification-register.md, privacy-impact-record.md, api-security-review.md, abuse-rate-limit-plan.md, supply-chain-review.md, sbom-manifest.md, ci-permissions-review.md, audit-logging-review.md, ai-security-review.md, compliance-overlay.md, vulnerability-response-record.md и approval-record.md когда corresponding risk applies. Source-era names such как threat-model.md, asvs-mapping.md, secrets-inventory.md, authz-matrix.md, audit-log-policy.md и compliance-applicability-matrix.md являются aliases, не duplicate generated contracts.

Codex Security scans остаются explicit opt-in: route may recommend scan или record not requested, но это должен не imply который scan ran из security terminology alone. Compliance overlays record applicability, owner, evidence, non-goals, gaps и review cadence без claiming legal compliance или certification.

Approval boundary stays explicit: payment/billing, production data, secret rotation, policy changes, external security-system mutations, external writes, publish actions и Codex Security scans являются не automatic actions.

docs.title: Delivery, Release & Operations Methodology Routing
docs.text:
Release packaging keeps release_packaging как route name и adds dedicated Delivery, Release & Operations methodology packet когда release, deploy, publish, package, versioning, changelog, artifact, rollout, rollback, CI/CD environment, release mode policy, build-release-run boundary, platform distribution evidence, release communication, versioning tooling, GitHub environment controls, SLO/observability, observability/on-call tooling, runbook, incident, postmortem, DORA, release integrity или automation promotion signals appear.

Minimum staged artifacts включают versioning-policy.md, release-readiness.md, release-artifact-manifest.md, rollout-plan.md, rollback-recovery-plan.md, environment-matrix.md, deployment-plan.md, ci-cd-workflow-inventory.md, observability-map.md, slo-spec.md, operations-runbook.md, incident-record.md, postmortem.md, post-release-review.md, approval-record.md и automation-candidate.md когда automation promotion является proposed.

Approval boundary stays explicit: publish, tag, release creation, artifact upload, deploy, package registry mutation, marketplace/store submission, CI/CD environment mutation и active automation остаются approval_required. Automation candidates требуют manual success evidence, stable inputs/outputs, owner, verification, approval requirements, value evidence и rollback/disable path.

Final release/operations depth also требует owner-reviewed release evidence sufficiency для real risk. Mobile signing, DORA dashboard notes, release tooling config, generated заметки к release или single observability tool остаются present_unverified пока platform owner evidence, team/process measurement design, selected/rejected/deferred tooling decisions, alert path и accepted gaps являются recorded.

docs.title: Проверка
docs.text:
• Route selection является covered через discovery tests, usage_mode fixture checks и false-positive fixtures для selected methodology/tooling gates.
  • Scenario behavior является covered через behavioral-workflows.json и run_fixture_eval.py.
  • Frontend methodology routing является covered через frontend_contract_present и synthetic frontend-ui-app fixture.
  • Backend methodology routing является covered через backend_contract_present и synthetic backend-service-app fixture.
  • API & Integrations methodology routing является covered через api_integrations_contract_present и synthetic API fixtures.
  • Database & Data methodology routing является covered через database_data_contract_present и synthetic database fixtures.
  • LLM / AI / RAG methodology routing является covered через llm_ai_rag_contract_present и synthetic AI/RAG fixtures.
  • Security, Privacy & Compliance methodology routing является covered через security_privacy_compliance_contract_present и synthetic security fixtures.
  • Delivery, Release & Operations methodology routing является covered через delivery_release_operations_contract_present и synthetic release fixtures.
  • Docs и source claims являются checked через tools/check_docs.py, политика источников и strict MkDocs когда navigation changes.
  • Completion language должен pass evidence-before-completion: текущий command evidence, текущий eval evidence, текущий runtime evidence, owner evidence или explicit inspection-only gap.

docs.title: Риски
docs.text:
• Workspace signals может identify likely scenario но не может prove readiness через themselves.
  • A scenario may быть correct while selected minimum artifacts являются low quality; owner review still matters.
  • Approval boundaries являются project-specific. Product-Agent OS может mark them, но пользователь или workspace policy decides следует ли к proceed.
  • Transcript/session eval runner replays synthetic или redacted session fixtures с deterministic expected/forbidden term checks и privacy/no-secrets guards; semantic judgment still требует reviewer или future calibrated judge coverage.

Следующий artifact: используйте Behavioral evals, чтобы проверить, что scenario route resists shortcuts, и Professional Code Authoring standards, чтобы проверить code-writing gates.

docs.title: Self-Learning Loop
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment

Self-Learning Loop - это ручной контур улучшения Product-Agent OS по локальным доказательствам, очищенной обратной связи владельца, журналу метрик и кандидатам на изменение. Он не является автономной системой обучения: режим default не запускает вызовы provider / model / API, не создает Codex App automations, не включает hooks, не пишет в целевой рабочий каталог и не применяет кандидатов автоматически.

Главная цель контура - превращать повторяющиеся сбои и обратную связь владельца в ограниченные артефакты: состояние, проверку срока запуска, отчет о ходе, eval cases, таксономию сбоев, staged repair task и recommendation packets для ревью владельца.

docs.title: Быстрый Старт
docs.text:
Первый запуск больше не должен упираться в state_file:missing. Создайте предложение состояния вне целевого рабочего каталога:

python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\init_self_learning_state.py . --stage <stage-dir-outside-workspace> --installed-at 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z

Проверьте срок запуска без записи в рабочий каталог:

python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\check_self_learning_due.py . --dry-run --state-file <stage-dir-outside-workspace>\.codex\product-agent-os\self-learning-state.json

Запустите ручной контур как staged evidence:

python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\run_self_learning_loop.py . --stage <stage-dir-outside-workspace> --state-file <state-file> --metrics-ledger <redacted-metrics.jsonl> --feedback-ledger <redacted-feedback.jsonl>

Экспортируйте необязательные review packets для Promptfoo и HALO без запуска поставщика:

python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\export_self_learning_promptfoo.py . --stage <stage-dir-outside-workspace>

Все команды выше локальные и staged. Каталог --stage должен быть вне целевого рабочего каталога; результат является предложением и доказательством, а не примененным состоянием.

docs.title: Архитектура
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    A["Owner approval for manual pilot"] --> B["init_self_learning_state.py --stage"]
    B --> C["Staged self-learning-state.json proposal"]
    C --> D["check_self_learning_due.py --state-file"]
    D --> E{"Due?"}
    E -->|"due"| F["run_self_learning_loop.py --stage"]
    E -->|"not_due / disabled / invalid"| G["Report blocker, no analysis"]
    F --> H["Local scope packet"]
    F --> I["Metrics ledger summary"]
    F --> J["Redacted feedback summary"]
    I --> K["Review-only candidate summary"]
    J --> K
    K --> L["Progress JSON/HTML and run packet"]
    K --> M["Owner review gate"]
    M -->|"separate approval only"| N["Future staged repair or target update"]
    M -->|"default"| O["No auto-apply, no target write"]

docs.title: Модель Состояния
docs.text:
Целевой файл состояния:

.codex/product-agent-os/self-learning-state.json

Схема: self_learning_state_v1.

Поле Смысл installed_at Базовая дата для ручной или недельной проверки срока запуска. last_analysis_at / last_success_at / last_failure_at История запусков; initializer оставляет их null. next_due_at Явное переопределение следующего запуска, если оно задано. cadence_level manual_only, weekly, on_change, disabled. approval_state manual_only, candidate_only, approval_required, disabled. last_metrics_digest / last_report_id Связка с последним принятым доказательством.

Initializer создает только предложение состояния как staged artifact. Запись в рабочий каталог остается отдельным действием с approval владельца; сам initializer сообщает state_written: false.

docs.title: Статусы
docs.text: Статус Где появляется Смысл Безопасное следующее действие state_invalid due-check State отсутствует, поврежден или не проходит проверку схемы. Запустить init_self_learning_state.py --stage; не писать state без approval. disabled due-check / runner Владелец выключил контур или cadence равен disabled. Зафиксировать blocker; владелец явно меняет state. not_due due-check State валиден, но cadence еще не требует запуска. Ничего не применять; можно сохранить due packet. due due-check Ручной запуск доступен. Запустить runner в --dry-run или --stage. blocked initializer / runner / export Scope, state, stage или проверка контракта не прошли. Исправить конкретный blocker; не заявлять readiness. ready_for_owner_review runner / export Evidence packet сформирован; candidates остаются review-only. Owner review; любое применение, автоматизация или provider run требуют нового approval.

docs.title: Входы
docs.text:
Разрешенные входы:

  • локальный scope packet для Product-Agent OS;
  • self_learning_state_v1 из рабочего каталога или явный staged --state-file;
  • очищенный owner feedback JSONL с redaction_status: redacted;
  • metrics JSONL с privacy_status: synthetic_only или redacted_summary_only;
  • checked-in docs, plans, eval summaries и accepted gaps.

Запрещенные входы:

  • raw chat logs, raw transcripts, private payloads, secrets, credentials, unredacted PII;
  • hidden app telemetry;
  • generated dashboard/report как единственный источник истины;
  • provider/model output без отдельного approval и eval packet.

docs.title: Выходы
docs.text: Артефакт Создатель Роль Граница .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning-state.json init_self_learning_state.py --stage Предложенное начальное состояние. Только stage до approval владельца на запись. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/state-initializer-packet.json init_self_learning_state.py --stage Scope, proposed state, validation и approval boundary. Без schedule, provider и target write. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/progress.jsonl run_self_learning_loop.py --stage События фаз: scope, due, evidence, metrics, feedback, candidates, owner review. Сгенерированное доказательство, не proof completion. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/runs/<run_id>/self-learning-run-packet.json run_self_learning_loop.py --stage Полный run packet со сроком запуска, summaries, unsupported claims и candidate summary. Candidate-only; auto-apply disabled. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/evals/eval-cases.json export_self_learning_promptfoo.py --stage Долговечные eval cases для маршрутизации сбоев. Synthetic/redacted; без claim запуска Promptfoo. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/evals/failure-taxonomy.json export_self_learning_promptfoo.py --stage Таксономия сбоев для evals и recommendations. Таксономия является routing evidence, не proof всех сбоев. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/evals/promptfooconfig.yaml export_self_learning_promptfoo.py --stage Необязательный config, совместимый с Promptfoo. Provider run требует отдельного approval. .codex/product-agent-os/self-learning/evals/halo-recommendation-packet.json export_self_learning_promptfoo.py --stage Recommendation packet в стиле HALO. Только локальная рекомендация; без вызова сервиса HALO.

docs.title: Таксономия Сбоев
docs.text:
Текущая таксономия группирует повторяющиеся сбои в такие классы:

  • state_or_scope_blocker: отсутствующее состояние, невалидное состояние, выключенный cadence или out-of-scope workspace.
  • missing_evidence_before_completion: claim ready/fixed/complete/release без текущего доказательства.
  • wrong_skill_or_surface_not_invoked: matching skill/plugin/runtime surface не был вызван.
  • unsafe_tool_or_approval_boundary: нарушена граница provider, hook, automation, GitHub/release или target write.
  • stale_docs_or_source_registry: docs, registry, plan, tests или evals расходятся с поведением.
  • weak_eval_or_no_baseline: нет baseline, rerun, holdout или false-pass audit.
  • raw_private_context_risk: private raw content, absolute path или PII попали в артефакт.
  • candidate_without_rollback: candidate не содержит rollback, tests, evidence refs или owner review.
  • repair_validation_failure: staged repair изменил файл вне allowlist или не имеет validation evidence.

docs.title: Адаптер Promptfoo
docs.text:
Интеграция Promptfoo по умолчанию является только export. Adapter формирует:

  • prompt text;
  • tests из eval cases контура;
  • assertions contains / not-contains для expected route и запрета auto_apply_enabled;
  • отсутствие выполненных provider results.

provider_calls остается not_performed. Запуск Promptfoo против LLM provider является отдельным approval-bound eval slice с baseline, cost/latency, privacy и решением о хранении отчета.

docs.title: Пакет В Стиле HALO
docs.text:
Пакет в стиле HALO переводит eval cases и классы сбоев в записи рекомендаций:

flowchart LR
    A["Failure class"] --> B["Hypothesis"]
    B --> C["Recommended action"]
    C --> D["Learning objective"]
    D --> E["Expected metric delta"]
    E --> F["Guardrails and rollback"]
    F --> G["Owner decision: pending"]

Пакет не вызывает сервис HALO и не утверждает рекомендацию. Его продуктовая ценность - приоритизация: почему сбой важен, какой артефакт улучшать, какая метрика должна измениться и какие guardrails остаются обязательными.

docs.title: Контракт Staged Repair Worker
docs.text:
self_learning_repair.py задает контракт Codex staged repair worker без auto-apply:

  • task contract: candidate id, objective, allowed files, forbidden files, change surface, expected behavior, validation commands, rollback target и privacy boundary;
  • result packet: changed files, validation results, summary, unsupported claims и owner-review gate;
  • validators блокируют absolute paths, private refs, out-of-allowlist changes, auto_apply, provider calls и target workspace writes.

Рекомендуемый поток:

sequenceDiagram
    participant Owner
    participant Loop as Self-Learning Loop
    participant Worker as Codex staged repair worker
    participant Review as Owner review
    Owner->>Loop: approves candidate review
    Loop->>Worker: staged repair task contract
    Worker->>Worker: local allowed-file patch proposal
    Worker->>Review: staged repair result packet
    Review-->>Loop: approve / reject / request changes

Repair contract может помочь будущему implementation slice, но сам никогда не сливает и не применяет изменения.

docs.title: Доказательства B44-S7
docs.text:
Текущее доказательство approved manual pilot:

  • evidence packet: docs/superpowers/specs/batch44-self-learning-loop-approved-manual-pilot-summary.json;
  • redacted feedback input: docs/superpowers/specs/batch44-self-learning-loop-approved-manual-pilot-feedback.jsonl;
  • metrics input: docs/superpowers/specs/batch44-self-learning-loop-approved-manual-pilot-metrics.jsonl.

Результаты, записанные в packet:

  • initializer достиг ready_for_owner_review;
  • runner достиг ready_for_owner_review;
  • due-check использовал state_source: explicit_state_file;
  • feedback rows: 1;
  • metrics rows: 1;
  • candidate count: 2;
  • Promptfoo eval case count: 8;
  • failure class count: 9;
  • HALO-style recommendation count: 6;
  • provider/model/API calls, browser automation, target workspace mutation, git, release, deploy, publish и active automation не выполнялись.

Принятые gaps:

  • один manual pilot, без promotion denominator;
  • Promptfoo export создан, Promptfoo не запускался;
  • HALO-style packet создан локально, сервис HALO не вызывался;
  • generated HTML/report остается review evidence.

docs.title: Проверка
docs.text:
Focused checks:

python -m unittest tests.product_agent_os.test_self_learning_extensions -v
python -m unittest tests.product_agent_os.test_self_learning_state -v

Docs/control-plane checks после изменения этой страницы или registry:

python -m unittest tests.product_agent_os.test_product_agent_os_docs -v
python tools\check_docs.py
git diff --check

Используйте strict MkDocs, когда меняются navigation, Mermaid, Markdown extensions, generated site evidence или MkDocs config.

docs.title: Типовые Сбои
docs.text:
• Staged state ошибочно считается applied state.
  • Generated HTML ошибочно считается proof качества или completion.
  • Raw owner sessions импортируются вместо redacted summaries.
  • Promptfoo/provider/HALO запускаются через export adapter без explicit approval.
  • Candidate продвигается после одного manual pilot без baseline и holdout.
  • Active schedules или auto-apply создаются только потому, что есть cadence recommendation.
  • Docs readiness заявляется без текущих docs checks.

docs.title: Следующее Действие
docs.text: Используйте эту страницу, когда Self-Learning Loop должен восстановиться после отсутствующего state, упаковать redacted feedback, экспортировать eval cases или передать candidate в staged repair. Следующий безопасный артефакт после ready_for_owner_review - решение владельца: approve bounded staged repair, request more evidence или record a no-op.

docs.title: Диагностика execution-loop
docs.text: Ручной контур дополнительно измеряет время до первого target diff, число агентов, review/repair cycles, повторы неизменившихся команд, записи control plane до acceptance, target/test churn, compaction, stale lifecycle marker, смешивание skill sources и projection conflicts. Превышение бюджета формирует intervention_required и рекомендацию остановить или сузить slice; оно не меняет prompts, skills, config, hooks или automation автоматически. Отсутствующие записи означают insufficient_evidence, а не успешный run.

docs.title: Source, cache and active-session state
docs.text:
Source status: official + project evidence

Источники: Agent Skills, Plugins, Build plugins, Skill exposure and invocation boundary, docs/superpowers/specs/batch42-instruction-tool-use-compliance-matrix.json.

Product-Agent OS разделяет три похожих, но разных состояния: source tree, installed cache и active Codex session. Ошибка диагностики часто начинается там, где наличие файла принимается за runtime exposure.

docs.title: State Model
docs.text: State Example evidence Allowed conclusion Source tree plugins/product-agent-os/skills/*/SKILL.md, scripts, templates, docs. Capability exists in repository source. Packaged plugin .codex-plugin/plugin.json, plugin metadata, bundled skills/apps/MCP/hook config. Capability can be packaged or installed through plugin route. Installed cache Local installed plugin copy and skill files. Capability may be available to Codex after install/restart, subject to enablement. Active session Current session skill list, plugin/app/tool exposure, loaded instructions. Capability is visible in this session. Route evidence Prompt fixture, transcript eval, current response or runtime route packet. Capability was selected for this prompt class.

docs.title: Read-only comparison packet
docs.text:
Before any cache refresh or global config change, create a read-only packet:

Field Meaning source_skill_count Count and names from repository source. cache_skill_count Count and names from installed cache, or not_inspected. active_session_exposure Skills/plugins/tools visible in the current or fresh session. policy_flags allow_implicit_invocation, explicit-only gates and forbidden automatic surfaces. restart_boundary Whether a new thread, app restart or CLI restart is required for proof. unsupported_claims Claims that remain unproved. next_safe_action Smallest non-mutating action or exact approval needed.

Do not store local absolute user paths, raw private prompts, raw logs, secrets, tokens or unredacted sensitive findings in public docs or examples.

docs.title: No Auto-Repair
docs.text:
The comparison packet does not authorize:

  • plugin cache write or refresh;
  • global Codex config write;
  • project .codex/config.toml mutation;
  • hook trust change;
  • MCP/app connector install;
  • active automation creation;
  • fresh-session proof claim without actually starting a fresh session.

If repair is needed, route it as a separate approval with owner, target surface, rollback, verification and no-unapproved-actions proof.

docs.title: Fresh-session proof
docs.text:
A fresh-session proof should record what changed between old and new context:

  1. Source evidence used.
  2. Cache/install evidence used.
  3. Session start or restart boundary.
  4. Visible skills/plugins/tools.
  5. Prompt used for route smoke.
  6. Resulting route and unsupported claims.
  7. Residual risk if current session remains stale.

Until this exists, use present_unverified, planned-only or approval_required instead of fixed/ready language.

docs.title: Технические особенности и установка
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
Для оператора эта страница отвечает на вопрос "какие локальные surfaces есть у plugin и где искать команду". Если нужна полная карта flags и approval boundaries, используйте CLI Reference; если нужно понять generated outputs, используйте Artifact Contracts.

Задача Стартовая команда или страница Boundary Проверить staged infrastructure без пишет render_infrastructure.py <workspace> --dry-run Read-only plan; target workspace не меняется. Сгенерировать proposal outside target workspace render_infrastructure.py <workspace> --stage <stage-dir> Stage directory должен быть явным. Построить static graph/cockpit Project Code Graph Generated graph/cockpit являются orientation evidence only. Проверить live/runtime/provider gates Live Runtime Governance Нет live server, provider calls или canonical graph mutation. Применить Professional Code Authoring Professional Code Authoring standards Source contract only; не доказывает real agent behavior или runtime enforcement. Подготовить docs и packaging closure Packaging And Closure Исходные docs -> registry -> docs tests -> check_docs.py -> strict MkDocs -> optional full closure.

Эта quick-start таблица не является полной command-policy матрицей. Широкий перечень docs tooling commands, install/runtime variants и approval-state cases относится к later DOC-M26; финальная свежесть root site/ относится к DOC-M25 после G2-G5.

docs.title: Capability status
docs.text:
Product-Agent OS ships local, approval-bound capabilities для staged infrastructure, lifecycle routing, project code graph navigation, generated cockpit views, offline search, runtime governance, provider gates, review ledgers, mutation dry-runs, audit packets, real-testing readiness, runtime QA и packaging closure.

Default contract консервативен:

  • generated outputs являются staged evidence только и не является каноническим источником;
  • real project testing требует owner-approved target и data policy;
  • Codex App, CLI и IDE extension smoke является recorded как planning или evidence, не live browser automation через itself;
  • provider surfaces keep provider_call_allowed: false и external_call_performed: false пока separate approval packet enables specific call;
  • canonical graph mutation требует accepted review evidence, dry-run plan, journal и rollback proof;
  • live server launch, browser automation, provider/live external model/API calls, canonical graph mutation и git stage/commit/push/PR остаются explicit-only.

Implemented graph и runtime surfaces include:

  • offline static search index at .codex/product-agent-os/project-code-graph-search-index.json;
  • disabled-by-default local query backend store at .codex/product-agent-os/project-code-graph-backend.json;
  • local deterministic semantic retrieval cache at .codex/product-agent-os/project-code-graph-semantic-index.json;
  • deterministic LLM-style proposal packets at .codex/product-agent-os/project-code-graph-llm-proposals.json;
  • extension verification и rollback/data deletion proof через project_graph_extension_closure.py;
  • approval, data classification, redaction, credentials, cache и budget governance через project_graph_live_governance.py;
  • local read-only runtime contract через project_graph_live_runtime.py;
  • embedding, reranker и LLM proposal provider gates через their provider-specific scripts;
  • human review ledger, proposal diff preview, mutation dry-run, mutation journal и rollback proof;
  • redacted audit log, security/privacy packet, observability packet и agent/skill handoff routing;
  • real-testing readiness, target consent, dry-run pilot harness, Codex surface smoke и use-case pilot matrix;
  • runtime browser QA expectations, performance budget и stabilization ledger.

docs.title: Operator contract
docs.text:
Этот operator contract separates base workspace audit profile и methodology audit complexity. Первый слой читает stack, files, control-plane state и route inputs; второй слой классифицирует methodology risk, maturity, recommendations и owner questions. --intent-hint может помочь routing, но не переопределяет политика источников, approvals, sandbox, писать guards или external-action boundaries.

Текущие machine-readable surfaces: renderer JSON включает renderer_file_count, stage manifest и status fields; runtime JSON включает codex_runner_result, methodology_packet, finish_options, compact first-response fields и schema v1 additive compatibility; audit/report tooling включает run_methodology_audit.py; behavioral evidence включает run_transcript_eval.py и fixture eval checks. Docs следует describe implemented commands и fields, не planned features. Additional sources: Codex MCP, Context7 MCP clients. Источники: Codex plugins, Build plugins, Agent Skills, Subagents, Codex hooks, Agent approvals and security, Codex automations, Product-Agent OS plugin.

docs.title: Package layout
docs.text:
Реализация находится в plugins/product-agent-os/.

plugins/product-agent-os/
  .codex-plugin/plugin.json
  skills/
  scripts/
  assets/
    templates/
    fixtures/

Официальный contract Codex plugin требует .codex-plugin/plugin.json; остальные bundled components лежат в plugin root. В текущем package manifest указывает на bundled skills и .mcp.json, а пользовательская логика lives в local scripts и templates.

docs.title: Bundled MCP
docs.text:
.mcp.json registers Context7 как bundled MCP server:

{
  "context7": {
    "command": "npx",
    "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp"],
    "startup_timeout_sec": 20
  }
}

Эта keeps plugin package free из API keys и follows Codex MCP Context7 example. Projects который нужны higher Context7 limits или private sources следует provide credentials через their own trusted Codex MCP configuration, не через эта repository.

docs.title: Packaged skills
docs.text:
Skill Назначение project-lifecycle-orchestrator Определяет lifecycle state и следующий bounded step workspace-discovery-auditor Делает read-only audit workspace requirements-author Готовит requirements packet implementation-planner Готовит executable plan agent-team-designer Проектирует project-scoped roles и handoffs test-eval-designer Определяет deterministic checks и quality gates risk-reviewer Проверяет diff, risks, source fidelity и missing tests pr-release-operator Готовит PR или release packet learning-loop-maintainer Переносит устойчивые lessons в durable artifacts automation-promoter Делает candidate-only automation readiness analysis

Каждый skill задает trigger, inputs, outputs, failure modes и final response contract. Source-sensitive skills не должны превращать community claims в project rules без verification status.

docs.title: Generated infrastructure
docs.text:
Renderer может создать или предложить:

  • AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PLAN.md, TEST.md, EVALS.md, RUNLOG.md;
  • .codex/config.toml;
  • .codex/agents/*.toml;
  • .codex/hooks/*;
  • .codex/workflows/*.md;
  • .codex/artifact-templates/*.md;
  • .codex/evals/*.json;
  • .codex/pr/*;
  • .codex/automation-candidates/automation-candidate.md;

docs.title: Self-verification metrics loop
docs.text:
Product-Agent OS включает local, read-only agent_skill_metrics_loop contract для reviewing agents, skills, prompt/policy packs, router/tool policies и harness versions после real work leaves evidence. Цикл collects target registry, проверяет trace intake, checks dataset quality, records local grader summaries, blocks uncalibrated grader/judge calibration, builds cadence recommendation values L0, L1, L2 и L3, и пишет staged scorecard ledger или report packets.

Main files и commands:

  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/agent_skill_metrics.py - source priority, target registry, trace intake, dataset quality, grader/judge calibration, metrics, scorecards, cadence recommendation и run-record contracts.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/agent_skill_metrics_report.py - redacted offline report rendering для agent-skill-evaluation-report.html.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/render_agent_skill_metrics_report.py - dry-run или stage-only report CLI.
  • .codex/artifact-templates/agent-skill-scorecard-ledger.md, .codex/artifact-templates/agent-skill-metrics-daily.md, .codex/artifact-templates/agent-skill-metrics-weekly.md и .codex/artifact-templates/agent-skill-update-candidate.md - generated review artifacts.

Политика канонического источника остается explicit: control-plane artifacts, run records, trace/eval packets и accepted gaps могут поддерживать metrics; generated dashboard/report HTML, memory, raw chat logs и unsupported community claims не могут. Report не является источником истины. Все metrics outputs являются только staged evidence, а не proof того, что real project является semantically ready.

Approval boundary: Product-Agent OS не выполняет live eval/model/API calls, не создает active schedules, не делает external writes, не applies modernization candidates и не allows self-applied updates. Modernization candidate требует owner review, rollback target и explicit approval state до изменений target workspace, skill, prompt/policy pack, router/tool policy или harness configuration.

docs.title: System file hygiene audit
docs.text:
Product-Agent OS включает read-only контракт system_file_hygiene_audit, чтобы системные файлы проекта оставались компактными и source-owned. Проверка использует hybrid triggers: weekly full review, monthly deep ownership review, on-change review после правок системных файлов, size-threshold review и release/automation approval review.

Поддерживаемые поверхности: root control-plane files, README.md, nested AGENTS.md, .codex/config.toml, MCP config, .codex/agents, .codex/skills, .codex/workflows, .codex/artifact-templates, .codex/automation-candidates, .codex/hooks, .codex/evals, .codex/pr, docs source-control files, .github/workflows, CODEOWNERS, SECURITY.md и checked-in plugin package control files. Audit reports покрывает size limits, duplicate headings, mojibake/BOM markers, secret-like literals, historical ledger leakage и active schedule markers внутри automation candidates.

Audit не сокращает файлы самостоятельно и не создает schedule. Результат: JSON плюс staged system-file-hygiene-report.md; любая правка, hook activation, GitHub workflow, Codex App automation, MCP change или external write остается отдельным owner-approved slice.

JSON пакет содержит audit_trigger, finding_type, compaction_decision, approval_boundary, no_secrets_status и active_schedule_markers. CLI --trigger записывает причину запуска, печатает JSON, возвращает 0 для ok или review_required и возвращает 1 только для blocked; workspace остается read-only.

Status dashboard projection показывает file_statuses, mtime_utc, age_days, content_digest и top_finding как generated review evidence. Даты берутся из filesystem metadata: это подсказки свежести для review, а не семантическое доказательство, что содержимое файла корректно или достаточно актуально для completion claim.

docs.title: Project code graph и cockpit
docs.text:
Local read-only graph foundation и generated cockpit поддерживают project navigation. Scanner inventories files, emits stable file-level graph nodes и contains edges, adds Python AST package/module/class/function/method overlays, adds conservative import/call/test edges, builds structured overlays для parseable Markdown, OpenAPI/Swagger, AsyncAPI, DBML, SQL, JSON, YAML, Mermaid и PlantUML inputs, проверяет controlled ontology, records manifest freshness/provenance, stores observation records с relative paths/spans/fingerprints и поддерживает temporal edge invalidation/supersession helpers. Query mode читает existing JSON/JSONL graph artifacts и produce bounded neighbors, path, trace, impact, affected_tests, changed_since, why_changed, read_order, hotspots, node, status и search packets. Это исключает raw source bodies через default и redacts local absolute paths или secret-like values из returned packets.

Cockpit surface группирует эти данные в reader-facing views:

  • Project Map для graph/file surface, selected-node evidence, filters и static fallback table.
  • Code Intelligence для hotspots, guided read_order, trace/impact packets и Code Flow.
  • Contracts для API/schema/diagram overlays и explicit contract pointers.
  • Quality & Metrics, Operations & Risk и Proposal Ledger для affected-test hints, stale/ambiguous signals, visual QA hints и proposal-only boundaries.

Рекомендуемый read path: сначала graph, затем guided read order, затем source files, затем tests/evidence. Cockpit и query packets не доказывают runtime behavior, browser behavior, source freshness, contract correctness, test pass status или release readiness.

Main files и commands:

  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_code_graph.py - graph JSON/JSONL packet builder.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_adapters.py - Python AST scanner и unsupported-language adapter boundary.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_chunking.py - structured docs/contracts/schema/diagram overlays, partitions, aliases и readiness summaries.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_manifest.py - file fingerprints, freshness и provenance.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_observations.py - observation records и edge delta lineage.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_ontology.py - controlled ontology и graph schema validation.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_queries.py - bounded graph-only query packets.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_analysis.py - source-free graph analysis report.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_cockpit_model.py - eight-page cockpit information architecture и Code Flow section model.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_visual_model.py - Graphology-compatible static projection, large-graph bounds, selected evidence и local Graphology/Sigma vendor boundary.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/project_graph_renderer.py - offline stage-only cockpit HTML/JSON renderer с нет external assets.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/scan_project_code_graph.py - dry-run, stage-only scanner и graph query CLI.
  • plugins/product-agent-os/assets/templates/project-graph/ - local cockpit, graph, Code Flow и CSS templates.
python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\scan_project_code_graph.py <workspace> --dry-run
python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\scan_project_code_graph.py <workspace> --stage C:\tmp\product-agent-os-graph-stage
python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\scan_project_code_graph.py <workspace> --query neighbors --graph C:\tmp\product-agent-os-graph-stage\.codex\product-agent-os\project-code-graph.json --node-id function:app.main.main

Stage mode должен использовать output directory outside target workspace. Query mode reads existing graph artifact и не scan source text. Existing graph artifacts в target workspace являются не modified. Этот graph остается conservative: dynamic dispatch, framework wiring, runtime routes и semantic/rationale extraction являются не verified dependency proof. Runtime/status summaries и graph analysis reports являются orientation evidence only.

Cockpit rendering использует render_project_graph_cockpit_plan() для dry-run plans и stage_project_graph_cockpit() для explicit stage directories outside target workspace. Это stages .codex/product-agent-os/project-cockpit.html и .codex/product-agent-os/project-cockpit.json. Этот staged HTML exposes exactly eight top-level pages, keeps Code Flow inside Code Intelligence, embeds safe JSON, использует static local CSS/JS, имеет filter/reset/copy/select commands, selected-node evidence, fallback static table, mobile layout и generated-view-only wording. Graphology и Sigma являются recorded как local Graphology/Sigma vendor-only capabilities; нет vendored assets являются currently bundled, so verified renderer использует static fallback path с Graphology-compatible static projection data.

Cosmos.gl/WebGL rendering находится вне supported proof boundary этой страницы. Current implementation evidence поддерживает local static fallback, а не interactive WebGL, browser screenshots, canvas performance или WCAG visual proof.

Fixture structural fields, search-quality evals, local backend gates и semantic gates keep graph features bounded. Fixture eval records graph contract, нет external assets, redaction, scale bounds, generated-view-only, eight-page cockpit structure, section preservation, cockpit generated-view boundary, project_graph_search_quality_present и project_graph_future_backend_semantic_gates_present. Search-quality evals являются local и deterministic: they record symbol recall, top-k/MRR, trace success или failure labels, affected-test precision, edge density и explicit thresholds. Этот approved static index, local backend gate и local deterministic semantic retrieval gate являются implemented; live database/server, live external model/API embedding или cross-encoder providers, LLM semantic extraction и rationale/comment extraction stay outside approved surface пока explicit approval defines redaction, cache, token budget, eval threshold и rollback path.

Focused и full verification следует cover graph/cockpit/search, status/runtime и fixture/lifecycle/docs suites до claiming readiness. Этот explicit-only git boundary остается в force. Approved extensions являются limited к staged proposals, generated extension closure evidence, rollback/data deletion proof и graph-only fallback. Live production server, live external model/API extraction и canonical graph mutation still требуют separate explicit approval.

docs.title: Codex installation boundary
docs.text:
Для Codex installation plugin должен быть доступен через plugin marketplace или curated plugin list, а package root должен содержать .codex-plugin/plugin.json. В этом репозитории package уже подготовлен локально в рамках plugins/product-agent-os/; подключение к конкретной Codex App installation остается отдельным environment step и следует follow текущий official Codex plugin docs.

Этот project intentionally keeps runtime code Codex-only:

  • нет separate OpenAI API key;
  • нет standalone Agents SDK application;
  • нет background MCP server started через plugin scripts; Context7 является declared как bundled Codex MCP server и начинается только когда Codex enables который MCP configuration;
  • нет active automation created из templates;
  • нет plugin-root hook activation без explicit approval.

docs.title: Guardrails
docs.text: Guardrail Enforcement Политика источников validate_source_policy.py blocks unsupported OpenAI/Codex claims и secret-like content Automation policy validate_automation_candidate.py требует manual success evidence, owner, cadence, verification, rollback и approval Staged manifest stage paths должен stay inside stage root и target paths inside workspace Approval record approved пишет требуют explicit decisions и matching plan digest Rollback apply может produce rollback manifest для later rollback Runtime runner проверяет lifecycle route, approval boundary, политика источников, handoff shape и redaction Transcript/session eval runner run_transcript_eval.py replays synthetic или redacted sessions against behavioral-workflows.json без external model calls Redaction secret assignments, local absolute paths и private data markers являются redacted из runner result Engineering standards templates требуют product metrics, architecture boundary, test/eval gates, влияние на docs и measurement notes Methodology discovery workspace audit reports architecture docs, ADR, domain model, architecture context maps, optional fsd_structure, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Storybook, DB docs, CODEOWNERS, CI, evals и metrics signals Scenario routing usage_mode distinguishes completed workflows, partial methodology gates, и base modes; это returns minimum artifacts plus evidence gaps
