docs.title: Non-goals
docs.text:
• Не устанавливать внешние инструменты автоматически.
  • Не превращать Product-Agent OS в multi-harness adapter. Track 8 проверяет только Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, .codex-plugin, bundled skills, Context7 MCP config и staged hook templates.
  • Не включать CI, hooks, CODEOWNERS, hosted docs, GitHub Actions или automations без explicit approval.
  • Не включать aggressive always-on skill triggers или session-start hooks без staged proposal и explicit approval.
  • Не делать Docusaurus, PlantUML, DBML, Storybook или любой другой инструмент обязательным для каждого проекта.
  • Не заменять runtime verification checklist простым наличием документа.
  • Не переносить community claims в core guidance без source status и verification status.
  • Не запускать широкое исправление багов без reproduction evidence, ownership boundary и rollback notes.
  • Не scaffold-ить пустой проект до явного approval выбранного product/architecture direction.
  • Не обращаться к внешним интеграциям, production DB, hosted docs, CI settings или secret-bearing configs без explicit approval.
  • Не публиковать packages, releases, tags, docs sites, GitHub changes или external tickets без explicit approval.
  • Не считать найденные logs, folders, package scripts или docs evidence проверенными без команды, exit code и owner/reviewer evidence.

docs.title: Applicability model
docs.text:
Каждая методология, стандарт или tool должны получать не boolean present/missing, а один из статусов:

Status Значение not_applicable Для текущего стека/масштаба/изменения не нужен. applicable_missing Нужен, но не найден; требуется staged proposal или explicit gap. present_unverified Найден, но команда проверки неизвестна или не запускалась. present_verified Найден и есть актуальная проверка/артефакт evidence. proposal_staged Подготовлено предложение, но оно не применено к проекту. approval_required Требуется approval: external write, CI activation, hosted docs, DB access, secrets-sensitive operation. explicit_gap_accepted Gap зафиксирован и принят владельцем как временное решение.

docs.title: Usage mode model
docs.text:
usage_mode должен быть составным, потому что реальная задача часто пересекает несколько сценариев: например, bug rescue внутри complex system или security-sensitive API migration.

Field Meaning primary Главный режим, определяющий first response and minimum artifacts. secondary Дополнительные режимы, которые добавляют gates без смены основного workflow. confidence low, medium, high; при low plugin должен задавать короткий уточняющий вопрос или выбирать safe fallback. reasons 2-5 фактов из workspace/user prompt, почему выбран режим. fallback Безопасный режим, если classification спорная, обычно standard_feature или maintenance. first_response_contract Что plugin сообщает или спрашивает на первом ходе: выбранный режим, evidence gap, approval boundary и next smallest action. minimum_artifacts Минимальный staged artifact set для режима; advanced proposals появляются только после необходимости или approval. behavioral_eval_cases Prompt/session fixtures, которые доказывают правильный route, stop condition и отсутствие forbidden behavior.

Minimum initial modes:

bug_rescue
greenfield_idea
complex_system_acceleration
pr_review
legacy_onboarding
api_migration
ai_eval_regression
native_mobile_feature
desktop_local_first
data_migration
security_sensitive_change
ci_stabilization
release_packaging
standard_feature
docs_only
maintenance

docs.title: T8-0. Test-first implementation scaffold
docs.text: Task Files Acceptance Verification Написать failing tests на новые artifact templates. tests/product_agent_os/test_infrastructure_templates.py Tests ожидают acceptance-scenarios.md, ai-eval-spec.md, docs-tooling-decision.md или выбранный финальный набор. Focused unittest сначала падает до реализации. Написать failing tests на новые discovery signals. tests/product_agent_os/test_discovery.py Tests покрывают positive/negative cases для domain_model, fsd_structure, docs_tooling, code_reference_docs. Focused unittest сначала падает до реализации. Написать failing tests на readiness gates. tests/product_agent_os/test_infrastructure_templates.py project-readiness.json ожидает conditional gates для acceptance scenarios, domain model, FSD boundary, docs tooling decision, AI eval spec. Focused unittest сначала падает до реализации. Написать failing tests на scenario workflows. tests/product_agent_os/test_infrastructure_templates.py, tests/product_agent_os/test_discovery.py Tests ожидают usage mode classification и workflow templates для bug rescue, greenfield idea и complex integration acceleration. Focused unittest сначала падает до реализации. Написать failing tests на behavioral routing. tests/product_agent_os/test_behavioral_workflow_evals.py или расширение test_codex_runtime_runner_state_routes.py Prompt-like fixtures ожидают usage_mode, next skill, first response contract, stop condition и forbidden actions. Focused unittest сначала падает до реализации и фиксирует ложные маршруты. Написать failing tests на transcript/session evals. tests/product_agent_os/test_behavioral_workflow_evals.py, plugins/product-agent-os/assets/templates/evals/behavioral-workflows.json Synthetic session cases проверяют route -> staged artifacts -> evidence gaps -> no forbidden external activation. Fixture eval показывает expected pass/fail без обращения к внешним системам. Написать failing tests на no-placeholder plan quality. tests/product_agent_os/test_lifecycle_skills.py, tests/product_agent_os/test_infrastructure_templates.py Plan/template checks отклоняют placeholder tokens, vague steps, commands без expected result и slices без exact files. Focused unittest сначала падает на текущих слабых формулировках. Написать failing tests на two-stage review. tests/product_agent_os/test_lifecycle_skills.py, tests/product_agent_os/test_infrastructure_templates.py Review workflow требует сначала spec/acceptance compliance verdict, затем code quality/risk verdict. Skill/template tests видят оба review этапа и stop condition при missing evidence. Написать failing tests на Codex-only compatibility. tests/product_agent_os/test_plugin_structure.py, tests/product_agent_os/test_codex_compatibility.py Plugin checks покрывают .codex-plugin, Codex skills, Context7 MCP, Codex hook template staging и отсутствие required non-Codex manifests. Focused unittest подтверждает, что Track 8 не требует Claude/Cursor/OpenCode/Gemini adapters. Обновить fixture eval expectations. plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/run_fixture_eval.py или существующие fixture tests, если count/assertions закреплены там. Renderer включает новые staged artifacts без direct project mutation. Fixture eval после реализации возвращает all fixtures ok: true.

docs.title: T8-A. Methodology gates
docs.text: ID Методология Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-A1 Agentic / AI-native development Уточнить task packet: ownership, forbidden files, approvals, run evidence, stop conditions, promotion path. development-standards.md, lifecycle skills. Каждый agent task packet содержит evidence expectations и promotion rule manual -> skill -> plugin -> automation. Template tests или skill text checks. Не превращать в бюрократию для mechanical edits. T8-A2 TDD Добавить evidence contract для Red-Green-Refactor. RUNLOG.md, TEST.md, build-slice.md. Есть поля: failing test evidence, green evidence, refactor evidence или explicit accepted gap. Template tests for required fields. Не всегда применимо к docs-only или config-only изменениям. T8-A3 ATDD Добавить acceptance-scenarios.md. .codex/artifact-templates/acceptance-scenarios.md. Связка requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner. Registry/template tests, fixture eval. Не дублировать REQUIREMENTS.md; template должен быть traceability artifact. T8-A4 BDD Добавить behavior scenario format без догматического forcing. acceptance-scenarios.md, development-standards.md. Есть Given/When/Then или эквивалент, business rule, edge case, non-goal, evidence. Template tests. BDD не заменяет unit, integration и contract tests. T8-A5 DDD Ввести conditional domain modeling gate. domain-modeling.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner skill. Для complex backend/workflow/data-heavy проекта требуется bounded context, ubiquitous language, invariant или accepted gap. Eval gate + discovery test. Не навязывать DDD простому CRUD/MVP. T8-A6 Bounded Context Добавить domain_model signal и traceability к architecture boundary. discovery.py, domain-modeling.md, architecture-overview.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner, fixture eval. Discovery видит domain docs/glossary/context map; planner связывает context с boundary или accepted gap. Discovery/template/lifecycle/fixture tests. Папка domain/ сама по себе не доказывает DDD maturity; mapping still needs human architecture/domain review. T8-A7 Ubiquitous Language Усилить domain template traceability. domain-modeling.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner, fixture eval. Term maps to requirement/source, API/event/contract, UI label, code module or owner, or accepted gap. Template/lifecycle/fixture tests. Требуется human review domain expert. T8-A8 FSD Добавить optional fsd_structure signal и FSD boundary prompt. discovery.py, component-card.md, development-standards.md, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills. Detection понимает app/pages/widgets/features/entities/shared; planner требует public API/import boundary для растущего UI only when applicable. Focused T8-A8 discovery/template/lifecycle tests. Не применять к backend/native/simple CRUD/simple MVP без UI architecture need. T8-A9 Data-informed development Усилить metric spec. metric-spec.md, release-packet.md, generated control-plane templates, lifecycle skills, fixture eval. Есть metric_hardening_when_product_behavior_changes, North Star or primary value metric, input/counter metrics, guardrails, qualitative review, privacy classification, retention period, data minimization, owner signoff and post-release review evidence. Focused T8-A9 template/lifecycle/fixture tests. Metrics can still be wrong; нужна product owner and post-release review. T8-A10 Eval-driven AI development Добавить AI/RAG eval spec. .codex/artifact-templates/ai-eval-spec.md, EVALS.md, TEST.md. Есть baseline, fixtures policy, no-secrets rule, task rubric, thresholds, rerun command, regression handling. Template tests, fixture eval. Eval quality зависит от dataset and judge calibration. T8-A11 Docs-as-code Close inside T8-C: introduce docs impact gate with applicability status. documentation-system.md, docs-tooling-decision.md, project-readiness.json, generated PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, lifecycle skills. Docs impact can be not_applicable, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted, or approval_required; status must name evidence owner, commands, accepted gap or approval boundary. Template/readiness/fixture tests inside T8-C. Do not activate CI/CODEOWNERS, hosted docs, external sharing, DB introspection or docs publication without approval. T8-A12 Systematic debugging Усилить bug rescue через root-cause workflow. bug-rescue.md, bug-rescue-report.md, risk-reviewer skill. До fix есть symptom, expected/actual, reproduction evidence, boundary trace, hypotheses, eliminated causes и stop condition при no-repro. Behavioral eval + template tests for root cause phases. Можно перегрузить маленькие баги; lightweight path должен принимать one-command repro. T8-A13 No-placeholder implementation planning Запретить vague implementation steps в plan packets. implementation-planner skill, PLAN.md, build-slice.md. Каждый slice имеет exact files, explicit commands, expected result, rollback и evidence owner; no placeholder tokens, repeated-by-reference steps or vague validation. Skill text tests + plan-quality behavioral fixture. Слишком детальный plan может тормозить trivial docs edits; нужен mechanical_change exception with reason. T8-A14 Two-stage review Разделить review на spec compliance и quality/risk. review-slice.md, risk-reviewer skill, RUNLOG.md. Review packet сначала сверяет acceptance criteria/source constraints, затем проверяет code quality, tests, security, docs, release impact. Template tests check two verdicts. Удваивает review overhead; применять к risky/parallel/public changes. T8-A15 Fresh-context subagent handoff Уточнить task packet для subagents. agent-team-designer skill, handoff-contract.md, worktree-ownership.md. Каждый subagent получает complete task context, owned files, forbidden files, verification evidence expected и handoff output schema. Skill text tests + scenario fixture for complex acceleration. Parallel work без ownership все равно рискован; default должен быть sequential when conflict exists. T8-A16 Evidence-before-completion Зафиксировать финальный verification gate. release-packet.md, development-standards.md, generated control-plane templates, lifecycle skills, readiness eval, behavioral eval, fixture eval. Release/ready/completed/fixed/works claims допустимы только с current command evidence, current eval evidence, current runtime evidence или explicit inspection-only gap. Focused T8-A16 tests, fixture eval completion_evidence_contract_present. Быстрое мнение должно маркироваться как inspection-only; evidence sufficiency still needs human review.

docs.title: T8-B. Standards and specifications
docs.text: ID Standard/spec Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-B1 ADR/MADR Добавить ADR trigger policy. adr.md, documentation-system.md, risk-reviewer skill. ADR required/proposed for architecture boundary, storage, API contract, auth/security, irreversible migration, automation activation. Template/skill text tests. Не каждый decision требует ADR; нужен not_applicable. T8-B2 C4 Уточнить minimum diagrams by complexity. architecture-overview.md, docs tooling decision. Small: context/container optional Mermaid; larger: context/container expected; component/code only when useful. Template tests. Diagram render в target repo зависит от tooling. T8-B3 arc42 Добавить architecture quality rubric. EVALS.md, architecture-overview.md. Architecture review включает goals, constraints, context, decisions, quality attributes, risks. Eval/template tests. Rubric subjective; нужен reviewer evidence. T8-B4 OpenAPI Уточнить OpenAPI vs Swagger. api-contract-review.md, docs tooling selector. OpenAPI is source of truth; Swagger UI/tooling is optional renderer/editor/lint ecosystem. Template tests. Tool versions differ; no forced install. T8-B5 AsyncAPI Добавить producer/consumer compatibility fields. api-contract-review.md. Event contract includes channel, message, payload schema, producer, consumer, ordering/idempotency, compatibility check. Template tests. Event semantics часто не выражаются полностью схемой. T8-B6 SemVer Добавить version impact gate. release-packet.md, pr-release-operator skill. For plugin/package/API: major/minor/patch/not applicable with rationale. Template tests. SemVer applies only when public API/version contract exists. T8-B7 Keep a Changelog Добавить human-readable release categories. release-packet.md. Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security используются when relevant. Template tests. Не превращать в raw git log. T8-B8 CODEOWNERS Добавить governance proposal status. documentation-system.md, staged infrastructure notes. CODEOWNERS status can be present_verified, proposal_staged, approval_required, not_applicable. Discovery and template tests. Requiring owners can slow small teams. T8-B9 GitHub Actions Добавить least-privilege CI proposal fields. CI/governance workflow section, docs tooling selector. Proposed workflow names commands, permissions, triggers, owners, no external activation without approval. Template tests. External system side effects require approval.

docs.title: T8-C. Documentation tooling selector
docs.text:
T8-C includes closure of T8-A11. The slice is not only a tool recommendation matrix; it must make docs-as-code impact evaluable through explicit applicability statuses and evidence. A workspace can select a lightweight/no-portal path when docs tooling is not justified, but the reason, owner and residual gap must be recorded.

Required status vocabulary for docs_as_code_impact: not_applicable, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted, approval_required.

ID Tool group Task Plugin artifact Selection rule Check proposal T8-C1 Docs portal Add docs-tooling-decision.md. .codex/artifact-templates/docs-tooling-decision.md. Choose MkDocs, Docusaurus, Sphinx, Antora, Read the Docs, or none based on stack, repo topology, public docs, versioning need. mkdocs build, docusaurus build, sphinx-build, antora, hosted approval note where applicable. T8-C2 MkDocs Keep as simple Markdown default. Docs tooling selector. Small/medium repo, Markdown docs, simple static site, Python-friendly tooling. Strict build if installed. T8-C3 Docusaurus Recommend for React/MDX/product docs. Docs tooling selector. React/MDX-heavy docs, interactive pages, public docs, i18n/versioning needs. Build command only if package script/tool exists. T8-C4 Sphinx Recommend for Python reference docs. Docs tooling selector, code reference docs routing. Python package/library, public Python API, docstrings, API reference. sphinx-build proposal, import-safety warning. T8-C5 Antora Recommend for enterprise/multirepo AsciiDoc. Docs tooling selector. Multirepo/multiversion docs, AsciiDoc governance, larger org. Antora build proposal only if tooling exists or approved. T8-C6 Read the Docs Keep hosted docs as approval-bound option. Docs tooling selector. Public/open docs needing hosted builds/versioning. approval_required for external hosting/sharing. T8-C7 OpenAPI/Swagger Route HTTP API docs. api-contract-review.md, selector. HTTP API or SDK consumers. Swagger is UI/tooling around OpenAPI, not source of truth. OpenAPI lint/build command slot. T8-C8 AsyncAPI Route event/message docs. api-contract-review.md, selector. Queues, event bus, message-driven APIs. AsyncAPI lint/docs build slot. T8-C9 Storybook Route UI component docs. component-card.md, selector, discovery. Reusable UI components, design system, component states. Storybook build, a11y/visual check if present. T8-C10 Mermaid Default text diagrams. architecture-overview.md, selector. Markdown docs, simple diagrams, no heavy architecture-as-code need. Docs build/render check. T8-C11 PlantUML Optional UML/sequence diagrams. Selector. Team already uses PlantUML/UML or needs complex sequence/component diagrams. PlantUML render proposal only if tool exists/approved. T8-C12 Structurizr DSL Optional C4 architecture-as-code. Selector. Larger/multiservice systems needing C4 model, views, ADR/docs as code. Structurizr validate/export proposal. T8-C13 DBML/dbdocs Database docs lightweight path. database-dictionary.md, selector. Relational DB schema docs, readable schema dictionary. DBML validation/docs proposal; no connection strings. T8-C14 SchemaSpy Existing DB introspection path. Selector/database docs workflow. Existing relational DB where introspection is approved. approval_required if DB access needed; no secrets in artifacts. T8-C15 TypeDoc/JSDoc JS/TS reference docs. Selector/code reference docs section. Public TS/JS packages, SDKs, libraries. TypeDoc/JSDoc build proposal if scripts exist. T8-C16 Sphinx/Javadoc/C# XML docs Language-native reference docs. Selector/code reference docs section. Public Python/Java/.NET APIs. Stack-specific docs build proposal. T8-C17 Vale/markdownlint Optional docs quality lint. Selector/docs governance section. Public docs, regulated terminology, existing docs lint culture. Proposal staged; no CI enablement without approval.

docs.title: T8-CY. Codex-only compatibility contract
docs.text:
Track 8 borrows the idea of explicit runtime compatibility checks, but scopes it only to Codex. Product-Agent OS must not add or require Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Droid or generic multi-harness adapters.

ID Surface Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-CY1 Codex plugin manifest Harden .codex-plugin/plugin.json checks. .codex-plugin/plugin.json, test_plugin_structure.py. Manifest includes valid name/version/description, skills, optional MCP config, interface metadata and Codex-safe links. Plugin structure tests. Marketplace requirements may evolve; official Codex docs stay source of truth. T8-CY2 Codex App / CLI / IDE extension Document supported Codex surfaces only. plugins/product-agent-os/README.md, docs update. README states Product-Agent OS supports Codex App, CLI and IDE extension workflows; no non-Codex install promises. Docs check + keyword tests. Different Codex surfaces may expose skills/tools differently; behavior must be framed by available capabilities. T8-CY3 Skills routing Validate bundled Product-Agent OS skills. skills/*/SKILL.md, test_lifecycle_skills.py. Skill descriptions, triggers, boundaries, inputs, outputs, verification and failure modes are present. Skill structure tests. Trigger quality still needs behavioral prompt evals, not only text checks. T8-CY4 Context7 MCP Keep Context7 as optional Codex MCP config. .mcp.json, README.md. MCP config remains secret-free and uses project/user configuration for any API key. Plugin structure tests and source-policy validation. Network and package availability vary; plugin cannot assume Context7 startup. T8-CY5 Staged hooks Keep hook templates inactive by default. assets/templates/hooks/*, merge_infrastructure.py. Hooks can be staged and approved, but plugin does not silently activate session-start behavior. Hook activation gate tests. Users may manually activate hooks incorrectly; docs must state approval and rollback path. T8-CY6 Non-Codex adapter exclusion Make absence of non-Codex manifests intentional. test_codex_compatibility.py, README. Tests fail if Track 8 requires .claude-plugin, .cursor-plugin, .opencode, Gemini extension or non-Codex install path. Focused compatibility test. Repo may contain unrelated docs about other ecosystems; test should target Product-Agent OS package only.

docs.title: T8-CX. Usage scenario workflows
docs.text: ID Scenario Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-S1 Bug rescue Add workflow for users who are stuck in bugs after exploratory or vibe-coded work. .codex/workflows/bug-rescue.md, optional .codex/artifact-templates/bug-rescue-report.md. Workflow requires symptom, expected/actual behavior, reproduction command or manual repro, failing evidence, suspect boundary, files in/out of scope, regression test path, rollback notes. Template tests check reproduction/evidence/rollback fields; discovery test can classify bug_rescue from failed tests/logs/user prompt context. If no reproduction exists, plugin must stop at diagnosis packet, not pretend to fix. T8-S2 Greenfield idea Add workflow for empty folder or idea-stage work before scaffold. .codex/workflows/greenfield-idea-to-plan.md, optional .codex/artifact-templates/greenfield-idea-brief.md. Workflow creates staged requirements, options, non-goals, first vertical slice, acceptance scenarios, metric spec, docs/tooling decision and approval gate before any scaffold. Template tests check no-scaffold-before-approval language and first-slice fields. Over-planning can slow small ideas; workflow must support lightweight mode. T8-S3 Complex system acceleration Add workflow for experienced developers scaling web/API/integration-heavy systems. .codex/workflows/complex-system-acceleration.md, .codex/artifact-templates/integration-catalog.md. Workflow maps web/API/integration/DB/docs/eval slices, ownership boundaries, parallelization rules, external system contracts, integration risks and release gates. Template tests check integration catalog, ownership, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, DB/docs, release gates. Risk of over-parallelization and conflicting file ownership. T8-S4 Usage mode classifier Add explicit route before methodology gates. discovery.py, runner route packet, workspace-discovery-auditor skill. Audit returns usage_mode for base and extended modes, plus route_inputs separating intent hints, workspace signals and control-plane state. Unit tests with synthetic workspaces, prompt-like inputs and fixture eval expectations. Mode can be ambiguous; output must include confidence and fallback path. T8-S5 Scenario handoff packet Standardize what each scenario hands to the next role. lifecycle skills and workflow templates. Handoff includes sources/context, assumptions, files touched/proposed, verification evidence, open risks, recommended next role. Skill text tests or fixture eval checks for handoff contract. Handoff packets can become verbose; keep scenario-specific minimums. T8-S6 PR review Add workflow for reviewing changed files before merge. .codex/workflows/pr-review-readiness.md, optional .codex/artifact-templates/pr-risk-review.md. Workflow maps diff to behavior/API/DB/UI/security/docs/release risks, missing checks and review evidence. Template tests for diff risk map, contract docs, release impact and commands. Requires git/diff context; if absent, route to maintenance or standard feature. T8-S7 Legacy onboarding Add workflow for old or undocumented repos. .codex/workflows/legacy-onboarding.md, .codex/artifact-templates/onboarding-map.md. Workflow creates source map, run commands, architecture/doc gaps and safe first documentation slice without refactor. Template tests check runbook, docs debt map and present_unverified wording. Discovery may infer too much from stale docs; mark unverified until commands run. T8-S8 API migration Add workflow for changing HTTP/event contracts. .codex/workflows/api-migration.md, .codex/artifact-templates/migration-plan.md. Workflow covers OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, consumers, generated clients, backwards compatibility, deprecation, examples, release impact. Template tests for contract/versioning/deprecation fields. Internal APIs may still have external consumers; require owner review. T8-S9 AI eval regression Add workflow for AI/RAG quality regression. .codex/workflows/ai-eval-regression.md, ai-eval-spec.md. Workflow requires baseline, dataset, rubric, thresholds, one-factor-at-a-time change and no-secrets fixtures. Template/eval tests for baseline and dataset policy. Eval judgments can be noisy; record confidence and residual risk. T8-S10 Native mobile feature Add workflow for iOS/Android/native mobile changes. .codex/workflows/native-mobile-feature.md. Workflow covers permissions, offline states, simulator/emulator assumptions, screenshots/logs and platform build commands. Template tests for runtime verification fields. Tooling varies heavily; plugin should propose commands from detected project only. T8-S11 Desktop local-first Add workflow for desktop apps with filesystem/local DB/background work. .codex/workflows/desktop-local-first.md. Workflow covers local data, filesystem permissions, indexing/background jobs, privacy, app logs and recovery path. Template tests for local data/rollback/log fields. Runtime verification is OS-specific; avoid claiming behavior from inspection only. T8-S12 Data migration Add workflow for schema, backfill and retention changes. .codex/workflows/data-migration.md, migration-plan.md, database-dictionary.md. Workflow covers migration, rollback, data quality, PII/sensitive fields, retention and DB docs. Template tests for migration/rollback/privacy fields. Production DB access requires approval and secret-safe handling. T8-S13 Security-sensitive change Add workflow for auth, permissions, payments, secrets or personal data. .codex/workflows/security-sensitive-change.md, .codex/artifact-templates/security-risk-review.md. Workflow covers threat surface, authn/authz, sensitive fields, abuse controls, approval needs and rollback. Template tests for approval and no-secrets wording. May require dedicated security scan outside Track 8 scope. T8-S14 CI stabilization Add workflow for failing or flaky CI. .codex/workflows/ci-stabilization.md, .codex/artifact-templates/ci-stabilization-report.md. Workflow separates deterministic failure from flake, captures job/command/log/environment evidence and proposes smallest isolation. Template tests for flake evidence and no external CI mutation. Remote CI logs may need approval or connector access. T8-S15 Release packaging Add workflow for package, SDK, plugin, app or open-source release readiness. .codex/workflows/release-packaging.md, .codex/artifact-templates/release-readiness.md. Workflow covers public API, SemVer, changelog, docs, examples, package metadata, license/security notes, publish approval and rollback. Template tests for release gates and no-publish-without-approval wording. Publishing/tagging is external/irreversible and must remain approval-bound. T8-S16 First-run route and intake Add first response contract for initial plugin use. project-lifecycle-orchestrator skill, .codex/workflows/first-run-intake.md. First response states detected/assumed usage_mode, confidence, missing context, next smallest artifact and approval boundary instead of dumping all gates. Behavioral prompt evals for empty, broken, existing and complex repos. Too many questions can stall; plugin should ask only when confidence is low or write approval is needed.

docs.title: T8-D. Discovery model
docs.text: Task Files Acceptance Verification Add usage_mode classification. plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/discovery.py Returns primary mode, secondary modes, confidence, reasons and fallback for all minimum modes. Unit tests for empty workspace, failing-test workspace, monorepo/integration-heavy workspace, docs-only workspace, PR/diff-like workspace, native/mobile, desktop, data migration, CI and release packaging fixtures. Add methodology_applicability map. plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/discovery.py Done for T8-D: returns status packets per methodology/tooling gate, not only boolean signals. Focused discovery tests for packet shape/status transitions and fixture eval check methodology_applicability_contract_present. Add domain_model signal. discovery.py Done for T8-A5: detects domain modeling docs/templates/glossary/context map without treating any domain/ folder as proof. Positive/negative tests pass in focused T8-A5 suite. Add fsd_structure signal. discovery.py Detects FSD-like UI folders and avoids false positive in backend-only repos. Positive/negative tests. docs.title: T8-F. Readiness eval
docs.text: Gate Applies when Pass condition Accepted gap acceptance_scenarios_when_behavior_changes User-facing behavior or business rule changes. Scenario maps to test/eval/manual check. Explicit gap in RUNLOG with owner. domain_model_when_complex_domain Complex backend, workflow, enterprise, data-heavy or multi-context domain. Domain model exists or proposal staged. Complexity judged low or gap accepted. fsd_boundary_when_ui_grows Growing UI with reusable features/components. Feature/slice/layer boundary or stack-appropriate alternative is named. Small MVP or non-UI project. ai_eval_spec_when_ai_behavior_changes Prompt/model/RAG/tool/agent behavior changes. Baseline, dataset, threshold and rerun command exist. Explicit accepted eval gap. docs_tooling_decision New docs system, public docs, generated docs, API/UI/DB/code reference changes. Tooling decision exists with applicability statuses. Not applicable documented. contract_docs_when_api_or_event_changes HTTP/event contract changes. OpenAPI/AsyncAPI updated or proposal/gap recorded. Internal-only prototype with accepted risk. db_docs_when_schema_changes Schema/migration/data model changes. Database dictionary/DBML/schema docs updated or proposal/gap recorded. No persistent schema touched. release_version_impact_when_public_contract_changes Plugin/package/API/SDK release or public contract changes. SemVer/changelog impact named. No public contract. reproduction_evidence_when_bug_rescue Bug rescue mode or user reports broken behavior. Failing command, log excerpt, test, screenshot, manual repro or explicit no-repro stop condition. No reproduction available; stop at diagnosis packet. approval_before_greenfield_scaffold Empty folder or idea-stage project. Selected direction and first slice approved before scaffold/write proposal is applied. User explicitly requests no scaffold and only wants research/spec. integration_catalog_when_external_systems_exist Multiple integrations, webhooks, queues, external APIs or generated clients. Integration catalog exists or proposal/gap recorded with secrets policy. Simple local-only project or no integration touched. ownership_split_when_parallel_agents_used Complex system acceleration or parallel build requested. File/subsystem ownership is explicit and non-overlapping, or work stays sequential. Parallelism not used. pr_risk_review_when_review_mode PR review mode or diff-focused request. Changed areas, risks, missing checks and release/docs impact are named. No diff/change context available. onboarding_map_when_legacy_repo Legacy repo onboarding or undocumented existing project. Entry points, run commands, docs debt and verification status are recorded. User only requested a narrow code change. migration_plan_when_contract_or_data_changes API contract, schema, backfill, retention or breaking change. Migration plan includes compatibility, rollout, validation and rollback. Prototype with no persisted data/public consumers. security_review_when_sensitive_surface Auth, permissions, payments, secrets, personal data or external writes. Security risk review exists and approval needs are explicit. No sensitive surface touched. platform_runtime_check_when_native_or_desktop Mobile/native or desktop/local-first changes. Platform build/run/log/screenshot or simulator/manual check is named. Docs-only or non-runtime change. ci_failure_evidence_when_ci_stabilization CI stabilization mode. Failing job/command/log evidence and deterministic/flaky classification exist. CI context unavailable; stop at local reproduction plan. release_readiness_when_distribution_changes Package, SDK, plugin, public app or open-source release. Release readiness covers SemVer/changelog/docs/build/security/publish approval. Internal-only unreleased work. plugin_success_metric_for_major_workflow New scenario workflow or major Product-Agent OS behavior. Metric exists for time-to-first-useful-artifact, false positive gate rate or scenario success rate. Experimental workflow explicitly marked. root_cause_before_bug_fix Bug rescue mode, repeated failed fixes or user reports unclear failure. Reproduction, trace, hypotheses and eliminated causes exist before broad code edits. One-line typo with obvious failing test can use lightweight path. no_placeholder_plan_when_plan_ready Implementation plan is produced for non-trivial work. Plan has exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected outputs and no placeholder language. Mechanical docs/config edits can record a reduced plan. two_stage_review_when_risky_or_parallel Parallel work, public contract, migration, security-sensitive or release-bound slice. Review includes spec compliance verdict and quality/risk verdict. Narrow low-risk slice can use single reviewer note with reason. fresh_context_handoff_when_subagents_used Any subagent or parallel worker is assigned. Task packet includes full context, owned files, forbidden files, expected evidence and handoff schema. Sequential inline execution can skip subagent packet. behavioral_eval_when_new_route_added New usage_mode, workflow, skill route or first response behavior is added. Prompt/session fixture proves expected route, minimum artifacts and forbidden actions. Experimental workflow can be marked manual_eval_required for one iteration. codex_only_compatibility_when_plugin_packaging_changes Plugin manifest, skills, MCP config, hook templates or README install docs change. Compatibility report covers Codex App, CLI, IDE extension and .codex-plugin; non-Codex adapters remain out of scope. Official Codex platform changes may require follow-up research. finish_options_when_release_ready PR/release packet is produced. User sees options with evidence state: keep branch, create PR packet, approved apply/merge path, rollback, cleanup. External publish/tag/PR still requires explicit approval.

docs.title: T8-GY. Behavioral workflow eval coverage
docs.text:
Structural template tests prove files exist. Behavioral evals prove the plugin acts correctly when a user prompt creates pressure, ambiguity or shortcuts.

Eval Purpose Inputs Ожидаемое поведение Запрещенное поведение Route selection prompt eval Check first route before work starts. Prompt, optional workspace fixture, control-plane state. Returns usage_mode, confidence, reasons, fallback and next skill. Start editing before route/safety decision. First-run response eval Check first launch UX. Empty, broken, mature and complex repo prompts. Asks at most one necessary question or proposes next smallest staged artifact. Dump full methodology matrix or scaffold without approval. Explicit invocation eval Check direct user requests. Prompt naming a skill/workflow/mode. Honors explicit route when safe and records why. Let prompt override sandbox/source/approval guards. Adversarial shortcut eval Check pressure to skip gates. Prompts like "just fix it", "no tests", "skip docs", "apply now". Keeps minimal required evidence or records accepted gap. Claim readiness or mutate external systems without evidence/approval. Bug rescue behavior eval Check root-cause discipline. Failing tests/logs or user bug narrative. Requires reproduction or stops at diagnosis; after repeated failures escalates to root-cause review. Keep patching without reproduction or hypotheses. Data migration behavior eval Check database migration safety. Schema/backfill/PII/retention prompt or workspace fixture. Produces migration plan, database dictionary, dry-run/backup/rollback/validation gates and owner review before production DB access. Access production data, run migration, expose PII or claim data safety without evidence. Security-sensitive behavior eval Check security-sensitive change safety. Auth/payment/permission/PII prompt or workspace fixture. Produces security risk review with threat surface, authn/authz, payment, secrets, PII, abuse controls, audit logging, tests, rollback, owner review and approval before implementation. Change auth/payment/permission behavior without risk review, store secrets or PII, imply Codex Security scan without explicit request, or claim security safety without evidence. Plan quality eval Check no-placeholder planning. Requirements and workspace audit packet. Plan includes exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected outputs, rollback and evidence owner. Placeholder tokens, vague validation, repeated-by-reference steps, command without expected result. Two-stage review eval Check review order. Slice summary, diff summary, evidence packet. Produces spec-compliance verdict first, then quality/risk verdict. Treat generic code review as enough for risky work. Fresh-context handoff eval Check subagent task packets. Complex/parallel plan. Each worker gets full context, owned files, forbidden files, expected evidence and handoff schema. Shared ownership ambiguity or missing stop conditions. Finish options eval Check release end state. Ready release packet with evidence. Offers keep/PR/apply/rollback/cleanup options and approval requirements. Publish, tag, open PR or activate automation automatically. Codex-only compatibility eval Check packaging scope. Product-Agent OS package. Validates Codex App/CLI/IDE extension docs, .codex-plugin, skills, MCP and staged hooks. Require or generate Claude/Cursor/OpenCode/Gemini adapters. Cost/model budget eval Check agent workflow cost discipline. Agent team packet and risk profile. Records model/reasoning choice, escalation/downgrade rule and budget note. Default every role to maximum reasoning without rationale.

docs.title: Rollback
docs.text:
• Template rollback: remove template file, template registry entry, generated fixture expectation and related tests.
  • Discovery rollback: revert the specific signal/status logic and corresponding unit tests.
  • Eval rollback: remove only new gates from project-readiness.json and tests that assert them.
  • Scenario workflow rollback: remove workflow/template registry entries and scenario-specific tests without removing generic methodology gates.
  • Behavioral eval rollback: remove prompt/session fixtures and expected-route assertions without weakening source, approval, redaction or no-secrets guards.
  • Codex compatibility rollback: revert Codex-only compatibility report/tests while preserving .codex-plugin manifest and existing plugin packaging.
  • Docs rollback: remove Track 8 sections and links without touching source registry entries that remain valid.
  • No rollback path may use destructive git commands; preserve user-authored files and staged proposals.

docs.title: T9-D2 Requirements and Domain Integration
docs.text:
Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/requirements-domain.md

Deep-audit deltas to implement:

  • Extend Track 8 acceptance scenarios, conditional DDD, bounded-context traceability, ubiquitous-language traceability and false-positive protection instead of duplicating them.
  • Represent requirement taxonomy when relevant: functional, non-functional, compliance, operational, AI behavior, data/privacy and release/rollback.
  • Add requirement quality criteria as a first-class gate: atomicity, clarity, testability, feasibility, traceability, source and owner.
  • Require stable requirement IDs for multi-slice, regulatory, risky, long-lived or public-contract work.
  • Add a requirement registry with status, owner, source and linked artifacts.
  • Treat stakeholder/owner mapping as a first-class artifact for source-backed domain meaning and business rules.
  • Preserve story slicing evidence: value slice, risk slice, MVP boundary, deferred slices, non-goals and acceptance scenario links.
  • Record business rules with source, owner, enforcement layer, exceptions, failure mode and tests/evals.
  • Use Example Mapping for unclear, large or disputed stories: story -> rules -> examples -> questions.
  • Require domain discovery workshop evidence for complex workflow, cross-silo process or overloaded domain language.
  • Track constraints across compliance, privacy, security, operational, performance, platform, accessibility, data retention, localization, cost, rollout and rollback.
  • Require declarative acceptance scenarios with no UI selectors, database internals, function names or test harness details.
  • Record invariants and failure modes when domain state transitions matter.
  • Require domain event contract evidence when events cross boundaries: meaning, producer, consumers, schema link, ordering/idempotency and privacy classification.
  • Add API/UI/data traceability distinct from DDD traceability: requirement/domain term -> API/event/schema/UI/data/code/test/eval.
  • Require domain expert or owner review for business-critical, compliance, finance/legal and AI-generated domain claims.
  • Require requirement change impact review after planning changes: tests/evals, API, DB, UI, docs, rollout and rollback.
  • Allow accepted gaps only with owner, reason, scope, review date, downstream risk and follow-up condition.
  • Route docs-maintainer to maintain requirement IDs, source registry, glossary/ubiquitous-language docs and traceability docs after the requirements packet exists.
  • Reject unsupported claims as evidence: BDD replaces testing, Gherkin is mandatory, a user-story template is complete requirements, a glossary is ubiquitous language, and OpenAPI is requirements source of truth.

Implemented scope:

  • Added requirements_domain catalog coverage for requirements scope/owner, requirement quality, stable IDs, acceptance scenarios, declarative scenario quality, requirements traceability, business rules, non-goals/constraints, open questions, Example Mapping, domain discovery, conditional DDD, invariants/failure modes, domain events, API/UI/data traceability, domain expert review, change impact, accepted gaps and evidence-before-implementation.
  • Added staged artifact templates: requirement-registry.md, stakeholder-owner-map.md, story-slice-map.md, requirements-traceability-matrix.md, business-rules.md, example-map.md, requirement-change-impact.md, and domain-review-record.md.
  • Strengthened acceptance-scenarios.md, domain-modeling.md, generated REQUIREMENTS/PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, Product-Agent OS README and lifecycle skills with Requirements & Domain gates.
  • Added a docs-maintainer lifecycle skill for requirement IDs, source registry, glossary/ubiquitous-language and traceability docs after the requirements packet exists.
  • Added read-only audit recommendations and false-positive coverage for behavior changes, risky/public-contract work, unclear stories, business rules, domain events, owner review, change impact, accepted gaps, declarative scenarios, unsupported methodology claims and typo/format/dependency-only work.
  • Added fixture eval check requirements_domain_contract_present; renderer file count is now 88 after adding eight Requirements & Domain artifact templates.

Severity and false-positive resolution:

  • Behavior-changing work without acceptance scenarios is a P0_blocker.
  • Requirement quality, stable requirement IDs for risky/public-contract work, constraints traceability, API/UI/data traceability, business rules, domain event contracts, domain expert review, change impact, accepted gaps and declarative scenario quality are P1_high_risk when applicable.
  • Stakeholder/owner map, story-slice map, Example Mapping and domain discovery workshop evidence are P2_recommended unless other risk gates raise severity.
  • Typo-only docs edits, formatting-only edits and dependency metadata without behavior impact keep requirements_domain not applicable for README-only work.
  • Unsupported claims are rejected as evidence: BDD replaces testing, Gherkin is mandatory, user story template is complete requirements, glossary is ubiquitous language, and OpenAPI is requirements source of truth.

docs.title: T9-D4 Quality, Testing and Evals Integration
docs.text:
Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/quality-testing-evals.md

Deep-audit deltas implemented:

  • Treat quality as current evidence: command, eval, runtime, manual or explicit inspection-only gap evidence with owner, freshness, environment, expected result, actual result and residual risk.
  • Do not treat generic "tests exist", old CI status, line coverage, screenshots without criteria or inspection-only review as quality proof.
  • Add discovery signals for quality directories, test/eval config files, CI workflows, coverage reports, Playwright/Cypress/Storybook/Pact/Promptfoo/Ragas/Stryker/Hypothesis/Codecov/GitHub Actions signals and flaky-test evidence; detection remains present_unverified.
  • Add stable eval fields for every quality gate: quality_strategy_contract_present, risk_based_scope_contract_present, test_first_or_gap_contract_present, acceptance_traceability_contract_present, contract_check_contract_present, runtime_evidence_contract_present, manual_qa_evidence_contract_present, visual_a11y_evidence_contract_present, eval_spec_contract_present, eval_rerun_evidence_contract_present, current_evidence_before_completion_contract_present, ci_quality_gate_contract_present, flaky_test_policy_contract_present, coverage_policy_contract_present, test_data_privacy_contract_present, bug_reproduction_evidence_contract_present, regression_impact_contract_present and unsupported_quality_claims_rejected_contract_present.
  • Map recommendations with exact gate, priority and artifact: missing local test command/evidence -> quality_strategy_present P0_blocker -> quality-strategy.md; risky/broad/constrained scope -> risk_based_scope_present P1_high_risk -> quality-strategy.md; acceptance traceability -> acceptance_traceability_present P1_high_risk -> test-eval-matrix.md; deterministic bugfix/business rule without test-first or gap -> test_first_or_gap_present P1_high_risk -> test-eval-matrix.md; API/event/schema contract gap -> contract_check_present P1_high_risk -> api-contract-review.md; runtime claim without evidence -> runtime_evidence_present P1_high_risk -> manual-qa-evidence.md; visual/a11y gap -> visual_a11y_evidence_present P1_high_risk for public UI and P2_recommended for internal UI -> manual-qa-evidence.md; AI/subjective eval spec or rerun gap -> eval_spec_present or eval_rerun_evidence_present P1_high_risk -> ai-eval-spec.md or EVALS.md; CI quality gate gap -> ci_quality_gate_present P1_high_risk for release/shared branch and P2_recommended otherwise -> ci-evidence-record.md; flaky/retry without owner/expiry -> flaky_test_policy_present P2_recommended -> flaky-test-policy.md; coverage-as-proof claim -> unsupported_quality_claims_rejected P1_high_risk and coverage policy gap -> coverage_policy_present P2_recommended -> quality-strategy.md; test data privacy gap -> test_data_privacy_present P1_high_risk -> quality-strategy.md; bugfix without reproduction -> bug_reproduction_evidence_present P0_blocker or accepted gap -> bug-rescue-report.md/RUNLOG.md; regression impact missing -> regression_impact_present P1_high_risk -> test-eval-matrix.md; completion claim without current evidence -> current_evidence_before_completion P0_blocker -> RUNLOG.md; unsupported quality claims -> unsupported_quality_claims_rejected P1_high_risk -> quality-strategy.md.
  • Create five staged artifact templates in this slice: test-eval-matrix.md, quality-strategy.md, ci-evidence-record.md, flaky-test-policy.md and manual-qa-evidence.md.
  • Strengthen generated TEST.md, EVALS.md, RUNLOG.md, project-readiness.json and behavioral-workflows.json with quality strategy, risk scope, acceptance traceability, contract/runtime/manual/visual evidence, eval baseline/rerun, CI evidence, flaky policy, coverage policy, test data privacy and current evidence before completion.
  • Map source candidate artifacts into the five templates or existing artifacts: red-green-refactor-log.md, bug-reproduction.md, risk-based-test-plan.md, regression-impact-map.md, contract-test-map.md, runtime-evidence.md, visual-a11y-evidence.md, coverage-policy.md, manual-qa-charter.md and evidence-packet.md are covered by the five templates plus TEST.md, EVALS.md, RUNLOG.md, ai-eval-spec.md, api-contract-review.md, bug-rescue-report.md and ci-stabilization-report.md. Standalone mutation-test-report.md, property-test-spec.md, flaky-test-ledger.md, ci-quality-gates.md and eval-run-report.md are deferred until a later domain or stack-specific slice proves separate ownership.
  • Route Quality, Testing and Evals through workspace-discovery-auditor, requirements-author, implementation-planner, test-eval-designer, risk-reviewer, docs-maintainer and pr-release-operator.
  • Reject unsupported claims as evidence: more tests always means better quality, 100 percent line coverage proves correctness, E2E tests should dominate because they are most realistic, manual QA is not evidence and AI evals are optional for AI behavior changes.
  • Preserve lightweight false-positive behavior for typo-only docs edits, formatting-only changes, docs-only source cleanup and dependency metadata changes without behavior impact.

Implemented scope:

  • Added quality_testing_evals catalog coverage for quality strategy, risk based scope, test-first evidence or accepted gap, acceptance traceability, contract checks, runtime evidence, manual QA evidence, visual/a11y evidence, eval spec, eval rerun evidence, current evidence before completion, CI quality gate, flaky-test policy, coverage policy, test data privacy, bug reproduction, regression impact and unsupported-claim rejection.

docs.title: T9-D5 Codex / Agentic Workflow Integration
docs.text:
Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/codex-agentic-workflow.md

Deep-audit deltas implemented:

  • Represented Codex / Agentic Workflow as durable control-plane and capability governance, not chat memory or broad agent orchestration.
  • Used the full gate set: agentic_scope_classified, source_of_truth_present, control_plane_present, read_only_discovery_complete, approval_boundary_present, fresh_context_handoff_present, ownership_split_present, subagent_parallelism_safe, skill_promotion_evidence_present, plugin_boundary_present, mcp_permission_review_present, hook_activation_approval_present, automation_manual_stability_present, model_reasoning_policy_present, memory_policy_present, agent_eval_workflow_present and agentic_evidence_before_completion.
  • Added severity policy so control-plane/source-of-truth gaps, side-effecting MCP, hook activation, external writes, production data, overlapping subagent edits, active automation and completion claims without evidence are blocker or high-risk when applicable, while lightweight docs/local work remains warning or not applicable.
  • Added runtime routing shape for Codex App, IDE extension, CLI, codex exec, GitHub Action, MCP, Agents SDK and automation, with no default escalation to MCP, Agents SDK or automation.
  • Added lifecycle test policy for skills: trigger tests, negative trigger tests, missing-input behavior, verification-failure behavior and failure-log evidence.
  • Set automation promotion threshold to at least two successful manual runs or an explicit owner-approved accepted gap.
  • Distinguished staged hook templates, read-only validation hooks and blocking/side-effecting hooks; hook activation requires trust review, event/matcher/command, failure behavior, disable path and explicit approval.
  • Required MCP review for new MCP config, changed trust boundary, auth/secrets, remote servers, side-effecting tools, production/customer data or external writes; read-only local docs MCP can be lower severity but still records capability/data boundary.
  • Required worktrees or explicit ownership for parallel subagents when edits can overlap, generated files are shared, migrations/contracts/public APIs/schemas are touched, or merge/rollback risk is high; read-only research can use packets without worktrees.
  • Clarified Codex-native subagents vs Agents SDK: Codex-native subagents are default for Codex App/CLI/IDE engineering delegation; Agents SDK is for code-owned agent apps with application-owned orchestration, tools, guardrails, sessions, tracing and evals.
  • Expanded agent eval workflow with baseline, trace-derived dataset, tool-call correctness, handoff correctness, expected/forbidden behavior, grader or deterministic assertion, threshold, rerun command, regression label, latency/cost and privacy/no-secrets handling.

Implemented scope:

  • Added codex_agentic_workflow catalog coverage for control plane, source of truth, read-only discovery, approval boundaries, model/reasoning policy, memory policy, handoffs, ownership split, subagent safety, MCP review, hook governance, plugin boundary, skill promotion, automation stability, agent eval workflow, evidence before completion and unsupported-claim rejection.
  • Added read-only audit recommendations with deterministic gate, priority and artifact mapping for missing control plane, missing source of truth, missing read-only discovery, missing approval boundary, subagent/parallel work without ownership, MCP side effects, hook activation, plugin packaging, repeated workflow promotion, automation schedules, model/reasoning policy gaps, memory-as-source-of-truth claims, agent behavior without eval workflow and completion claims without evidence.
  • Added staged artifact templates: model-reasoning-policy.md, mcp-permission-review.md, hook-governance.md, skill-promotion-record.md and agent-eval-workflow.md.
  • Strengthened generated AGENTS.md, .codex/config.toml, PLAN.md, TEST.md, EVALS.md, RUNLOG.md, project-readiness.json, behavioral-workflows.json, agent-task-packet.md, worktree-ownership.md, automation-candidate.md and handoff-contract.md with Codex workflow gates, runtime routing, approval boundaries and no silent activation.
  • Added Codex workflow discovery signals for .codex/, agents, workflows, artifact templates, skills, plugins, subagents, MCP, hooks, automation, task packets, handoff/worktree artifacts, source-of-truth terms, approval-boundary terms and side-effect risks. Detection remains present_unverified.
  • Routed Codex / Agentic Workflow into all 11 lifecycle skills while keeping hooks, MCP, automation, external writes and Agents SDK orchestration approval-bound.
  • Added fixture eval check codex_agentic_workflow_contract_present; renderer file count is now 102 after adding five Codex workflow artifact templates.

Candidate artifact mapping:

  • context-memory-policy.md is covered by AGENTS.md, .codex/config.toml, model-reasoning-policy.md and generated PLAN/EVALS/RUNLOG memory-policy fields until a later slice proves separate ownership.
  • agentic-workflow-readiness.md is covered by project-readiness.json, generated PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG and the codex_agentic_workflow_contract_present fixture check.
  • agent-eval-case.md is covered by agent-eval-workflow.md plus behavioral-workflows.json; standalone cases can be added when a real agent app needs separate ownership.
  • skill-candidate.md and skill-failure-log.md are covered by skill-promotion-record.md.
  • hook-activation-record.md is covered by hook-governance.md.
  • docs/sources/registry.md was checked for T9-D5 source impact; no new registry entry was added because this slice operationalizes already checked-in methodology/research files and existing official Codex references rather than introducing new external source-backed platform claims. The existing Track 9 internal source entry was refreshed to mention T9-D5 coverage.

Severity and false-positive resolution:

  • Missing control plane, source of truth, approval boundary, side-effecting MCP review, hook activation approval, overlapping subagent ownership, active automation stability and evidence-before-completion are blocker or high-risk when applicable.
  • Skill promotion evidence, plugin boundary, model/reasoning policy, memory policy and agent eval workflow are high-risk or recommended depending on scope and side-effect risk.
  • Simple docs/local work does not force subagents, worktrees, MCP review, hooks, plugin packaging, automation, Agents SDK orchestration or agent eval workflow unless explicit signals, user intent or side-effect boundaries make them applicable.
  • Unsupported agentic workflow claims are rejected as evidence: memory is project source of truth, subagents are automatically faster, MCP tools are safe because they are tools, hooks are harmless convenience scripts, repeated workflows should become automation immediately, Agents SDK and Codex runtime are the same layer, and inspection proves completion.

docs.title: T9-D6 Frontend Integration
docs.text:
Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/frontend.md

Deep-audit deltas implemented:

  • Represented frontend as user-observable UI behavior and browser/runtime evidence, not component hierarchy or code inspection.
  • Used the full gate set: frontend_user_flow_acceptance_present, frontend_component_docs_present, frontend_component_state_matrix_present, frontend_design_system_boundary_present, frontend_fsd_boundary_reviewed, frontend_api_contract_alignment_present, frontend_accessibility_review_present, frontend_keyboard_focus_contract_present, frontend_responsive_viewport_matrix_present, frontend_visual_evidence_present, frontend_runtime_console_evidence_present, frontend_performance_budget_present, frontend_browser_support_present, frontend_content_i18n_boundary_present and frontend_interaction_test_evidence_present.
  • Kept Storybook and Feature-Sliced Design conditional: Storybook is documentation and verification surface, not proof by itself; FSD applies only when UI scale/coupling or owner decision justifies layer/slice/segment/public API/import-rule review.
  • Set public UI default accessibility target to WCAG 2.2 AA unless an owner records an accepted exception.
  • Required browser/runtime evidence, console status, Playwright trace or accepted gap before UI completion claims.
  • Added visual baseline stability, responsive/input/theme coverage, API/data state alignment, route/page inventory and performance budget policies.
  • Rejected unsupported frontend claims as evidence: FSD is mandatory for every frontend project, Storybook proves UI quality, automated accessibility addon output is enough, a desktop screenshot proves responsive UI, lab Web Vitals always represent production UX and code inspection proves UI completion.

Implemented scope:

  • Added frontend catalog coverage for user flows, component docs, state matrices, design-system governance, FSD boundaries, API/data alignment, accessibility, keyboard/focus, responsive/visual/runtime evidence, interaction tests, performance, browser support, content/i18n and unsupported-claim rejection.
  • Added frontend discovery signals for UI framework/package/filesystem evidence, routes/pages/components, Storybook, Playwright, Testing Library, axe, Chromatic, tokens/themes/components metadata and UI terms. Detection remains present_unverified.
  • Added read-only audit recommendations with deterministic priority, gate, artifact, evidence, approval, accepted-gap and residual-risk fields for frontend gaps.
  • Added staged artifact templates: frontend-flow-spec.md, frontend-state-matrix.md, frontend-visual-qa.md, frontend-accessibility-review.md and frontend-performance-budget.md.
  • Strengthened component-card.md with the full Track 9 template contract plus user flow, component state, Storybook, FSD, API, accessibility and design-system ownership fields.
  • Strengthened generated PLAN.md, TEST.md, EVALS.md, RUNLOG.md, project-readiness.json and behavioral-workflows.json with frontend readiness, evidence and shortcut-resistance fields.
  • Routed Frontend methodology into workspace-discovery-auditor, requirements-author, implementation-planner, test-eval-designer, risk-reviewer, docs-maintainer and pr-release-operator.
  • Added synthetic frontend-ui-app fixture with React/Vite, Storybook, Playwright, Testing Library/a11y, design token/component metadata and no secrets/private data.
  • Added fixture eval check frontend_contract_present; renderer file count is now 107 after adding five Frontend artifact templates.

Candidate artifact mapping:

  • ui-flow-spec.md is covered by frontend-flow-spec.md.
  • component-state-matrix.md is covered by frontend-state-matrix.md.
  • accessibility-review.md is covered by frontend-accessibility-review.md.
  • route-page-inventory.md, frontend-api-dependency-map.md and frontend-content-i18n-record.md are covered by frontend-flow-spec.md until a later slice proves separate ownership.
  • storybook-story-map.md, design-system-inventory.md, design-tokens-reference.md, frontend-boundary-map.md and fsd-boundary-record.md are covered by component-card.md and frontend-state-matrix.md.
  • responsive-viewport-matrix.md, keyboard-focus-map.md, visual-evidence-packet.md and frontend-browser-support-matrix.md are covered by frontend-visual-qa.md and frontend-accessibility-review.md.
  • frontend-interaction-test-matrix.md is covered by test-eval-matrix.md, manual-qa-evidence.md and the frontend interaction evidence gate.

docs.title: T9-D8 API and Integrations Integration
docs.text:
Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/api-integrations.md

Deep-audit deltas implemented:

  • Treat API methodology as a contract-source discipline, not a rendered-docs discipline: OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL/protobuf/JSON Schema/Pact sources count as evidence, while Swagger UI is not source of truth.
  • Split schema validation from contract testing: contract-test evidence records provider verification, consumer-driven checks, negative cases, compatibility rules and missing-tool gaps.
  • Add explicit consumer and compatibility gates for public and internal APIs; internal APIs can still have consumers and breaking-change risk.
  • Add security and error depth: contract-linked security schemes, scopes, token claims, object-level authorization, rate limits, abuse cases, sensitive fields, RFC 9457 Problem Details or an explicit error-model compatibility gap.
  • Add event/webhook delivery evidence: schema, headers, signature verification, correlation ID, idempotency key, retry policy, ordering guarantee, replay, dead-letter behavior and CloudEvents applicability or non-applicability.
  • Add generated SDK reproducibility: generator, version, config, target languages, regeneration command, reviewable diff, SemVer impact and release process.
  • Keep API style choices conditional: GraphQL, gRPC, event-driven APIs, Spectral, Redocly and framework-native linting are not universal defaults.
  • Preserve API-only/backend false-positive protection: API-only contract fixtures do not force Backend blockers unless runtime/server/service/worker evidence exists.
  • Keep external writes approval-bound: provider mutation, generated client publication, webhook registration and other external actions require approval_required.

Implemented scope:

  • Added api_integrations catalog coverage with applies/not-applicable rules, maturity/complexity impact, decision horizons, artifacts, gates, eval fields and overlaps.
  • Added read-only API discovery signals for OpenAPI, Swagger source files, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, protobuf, JSON Schema, Pact, webhooks/events, generated clients and external providers.
  • Added audit recommendations for api_contract_source_present, api_consumer_map_present, api_breaking_change_reviewed, api_security_reviewed, api_error_contract_present, api_contract_test_matrix_present, event_delivery_contract_present, generated_client_manifest_present, external_write_approval_present, api_observability_contract_present, api_style_choice_recorded and unsupported API claims.

  • Strengthened api-contract-review.md, migration-plan.md, integration-catalog.md, generated control-plane templates, project-readiness.json, behavioral-workflows.json, lifecycle skills, Product-Agent OS README and operator docs.

Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/llm-ai-rag.md

Execution policy:

  • Implement T9-D10 in batches of up to 10 matrix rows and report after each batch: M0..M9, M10..M19, M20..M29, then M30..M36.
  • Commit, push and PR actions remain deferred until explicitly requested.

Deep-audit deltas to implement:

  • Treat LLM / AI / RAG as a full methodology domain, not only the existing ai_eval_regression usage-mode workflow.
  • Separate gates for user-visible AI behavior, baseline eval, eval rerun report, dataset governance, prompt contract, model decision, structured output, tool/function/MCP contract, human approval boundary, RAG source inventory, retrieval config, grounding eval, agent workflow trace, safety review, cost/latency budget, no private data in fixtures and unsupported-claim rejection.
  • Preserve existing Track 8 ai_eval_regression route and ai_eval_signals, while adding a stable read-only llm_ai_rag_signals packet.
  • Detection remains present_unverified; no model calls, eval runs, vector DB access, external writes or owner approvals are performed during discovery.
  • Keep eval tooling conditional. Promptfoo, OpenAI Evals, pytest/Jest app-backed evals, Ragas and LangSmith are candidate tools, not universal defaults.
  • Record template naming compatibility: source names such as prompt-contract.md, model-decision-record.md and rag-eval-report.md are canonical unless aliases are explicitly mapped.
  • RAG quality must split retrieval quality and answer quality; citations alone are not proof.
  • Tool/function calling is product capability: schema, permissions, side effects, idempotency, retries, errors and approvals are part of the contract.
  • Agent workflows start with the smallest useful single-agent or manager pattern; multi-agent handoffs need owner and trace evidence.
  • Datasets, prompts, fixtures, traces and screenshots must exclude secrets, credentials, raw private chats and private customer data.

Batch M0..M9 implementation scope:

  • Add RED tests for llm_ai_rag catalog, audit recommendations, discovery packet, false positives, readiness gate and ai-eval-spec.md rerun evidence.
  • Fill llm_ai_rag catalog metadata and cross-domain overlaps.
  • Add read-only llm_ai_rag_signals and llm_ai_rag_readiness_when_ai_behavior_changes.
  • Add baseline eval and eval rerun/report recommendations with stable priority/artifact mapping.
  • Strengthen ai-eval-spec.md for user-visible behavior promise, current result, baseline/current comparison, failed cases, current-run evidence, inspection-only gap and dataset privacy terms.

Batch M0..M9 completed scope:

docs.title: T9-D11 Security, Privacy & Compliance Integration
docs.text:
Status: done

Source audited: docs/methodologies/security-privacy-compliance.md

Deep-audit deltas to implement:

  • Treat Security, Privacy & Compliance as a planning-first methodology domain for authn, authz, permissions, secrets, PII, sensitive data, payments, billing, abuse/rate limits, audit logging, supply chain, CI permissions, AI/agent security, external writes and compliance overlays.
  • Use the full gate set from the methodology source: security-sensitive classification, threat surface, security risk review, ASVS mapping, API security scheme, authz negative tests, secrets policy, data classification, privacy impact, external-write approval, abuse/rate-limit review, audit logging, supply chain, CI permissions, AI security, compliance overlay and evidence before completion.
  • Record source references as methodology evidence and platform/security guidance, not legal advice. Compliance output must record applicability, owner, evidence, non-goals, gaps and review cadence without claiming GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2 or enterprise compliance certification.
  • Resolve artifact-name compatibility before renderer registration: source-era names such as threat-model.md, asvs-mapping.md, secrets-inventory.md, authz-matrix.md, audit-log-policy.md and compliance-applicability-matrix.md must map to canonical Product-Agent OS templates or aliases without duplicate conflicting contracts.
  • Map or explicitly defer the full source artifact set: data-classification-register.md, api-security-review.md, abuse-rate-limit-plan.md, sbom-manifest.md, ci-permissions-review.md, ai-security-review.md, vulnerability-response-record.md and approval-record.md must not be silently dropped.
  • Represent Secure SDLC/SSDF and OWASP SAMM as lifecycle/maturity vocabulary. ASVS Level 1/2/3 selection must record applicability, project risk, owner, evidence and gaps without claiming compliance.
  • API authorization negative tests must cover allowed and forbidden behavior, BOLA, BFLA, object property authorization, role/scope/resource ownership, rate limits and unsafe consumption. OAuth or API docs alone are not accepted as security evidence.
  • Data classification and redaction lifecycle must cover prompts, docs, fixtures, eval datasets, logs, traces and screenshots. Raw secrets, credentials, payment data, raw PII, raw private chats and private customer data are blocked.
  • SBOM/provenance policy must distinguish internal apps, packages, plugins, containers and release artifacts, and must connect SBOM to vulnerability status, update path, license status, provenance, action pinning, release signing or an explicit accepted gap.
  • Vulnerability/security incident workflow must cover security bugs, advisories, leaked secrets, abuse incidents, dependency alerts and data exposure with triage, severity, containment, fix evidence, verification, disclosure, release/patch plan and post-incident lessons.
  • Compliance overlays must separate legal/regulatory obligations, customer contractual obligations and internal policy, with conditional overlays for finance, healthcare, minors, enterprise, public sector, marketplace and AI agent tooling.
  • Codex Security scan remains explicit opt-in. Security-sensitive routing can recommend a scan or record not requested, but must not imply that a scan ran from security terminology alone.
  • False-positive policy: security docs mention without code path remains present_unverified; docs-only repositories with security articles do not become regulated automatically; keyword-only compliance claims do not prove compliance; no-secrets-in-code does not prove artifact safety.
  • Unsupported claims must be rejected as high-risk evidence gaps: security review after coding, no-secrets-in-code means safe, ASVS/OWASP proves compliance, SBOM once is enough, Codex Security scan is implied, OAuth proves API security and privacy compliance is universal.

Implemented scope:

  • Added security_privacy_compliance catalog coverage for security-sensitive classification, threat surface, security risk review, ASVS/SSDF/SAMM mapping, ASVS level selection, API security scheme, authorization negative tests, secrets policy, data classification, redaction lifecycle, privacy impact, external-write approval, abuse/rate-limit review, audit logging, supply chain, SBOM/provenance, CI permissions, AI security, compliance overlay taxonomy, vulnerability response workflow, explicit Codex Security scan status, security evidence before completion and unsupported-claim rejection.
  • Added read-only discovery/audit coverage for authn/authz, permissions, secrets, PII/sensitive data, payment/billing, abuse/rate limits, audit logging, supply chain, SBOM/provenance, CI permissions, compliance terms, AI/agent security and Codex approval-bound signals. Detection remains present_unverified; no scan, security mutation, external write or compliance certification is implied.
  • Resolved source-era artifact naming through canonical templates and aliases for threat surface/model, ASVS/SSDF mapping, secrets policy/inventory, authz negative tests, audit logging and compliance overlay/applicability.
  • Added or strengthened Security, Privacy & Compliance artifact templates: security-risk-review.md, threat-surface.md, asvs-ssdf-mapping.md, authz-negative-test-matrix.md, secrets-policy.md, data-classification-register.md, privacy-impact-record.md, api-security-review.md, abuse-rate-limit-plan.md, supply-chain-review.md, sbom-manifest.md, ci-permissions-review.md, audit-logging-review.md, ai-security-review.md, compliance-overlay.md, vulnerability-response-record.md and approval-record.md.
  • Registered the 16 new security templates in the staged renderer; renderer file count increased from 157 to 173 and security_privacy_compliance_contract_present is true for python-app.
  • Strengthened source policy to block raw PII/private data/payment data markers in docs/templates/fixtures in addition to secret-like literals.
  • Added readiness and behavioral eval coverage for security_privacy_compliance_when_sensitive_surface, false-positive handling, approval boundaries and unsupported security/compliance claims.
  • Added synthetic fixtures for payment/billing high risk, docs-only security article false positive, unsupported compliance claim rejection, CI permissions and SBOM/provenance present_unverified behavior, all without raw secrets or private data.
  • Routed the methodology through lifecycle skills with planning-first classification, threat surface, data classification, owner review, tests/evidence, rollback, approval boundary, compliance owner and explicit Codex Security scan status.
  • Added methodology report coverage for security/privacy recommendations, approval boundaries, accepted gaps, residual risks and redaction of secrets, payment data, raw PII and private customer data.

Verification policy:

  • RED catalog check: python -m unittest tests.product_agent_os.test_methodology_catalog -v should fail before catalog implementation on missing security_privacy_compliance gates.
  • Focused security slice check: python -m unittest tests.product_agent_os.test_methodology_catalog tests.product_agent_os.test_methodology_audit tests.product_agent_os.test_source_policy tests.product_agent_os.test_fixture_eval_runner -v.

  • Commit, push and PR actions remain deferred until explicitly requested.

docs.text:
Status: in_progress

Source audited: docs/methodologies/delivery-release-operations.md

Deep-audit deltas to implement:

  • Treat Delivery, Release & Operations as a planning-first methodology domain for release readiness, versioning, changelog/release notes, artifact manifests, rollout, rollback/recovery, CI/CD governance, environments, operations runbooks, incident/postmortem learning, DORA and automation promotion.
  • Use the full gate set from the methodology source and second-pass plan audit: release scope, version impact, changelog/release notes, artifact manifest, current release evidence, rollout, rollback, environment and external approval boundaries, CI/CD governance, observability/SLO, operations runbook, incident response, post-release measurement, automation manual stability, release mode, build-release-run, platform distribution, release communication, versioning tooling, GitHub environment controls, DORA five-metric design, blameless postmortem, observability/on-call tooling, security handoff and owner-reviewed evidence sufficiency.
  • Resolve artifact-name compatibility before broad renderer registration. Plan-era names such as release-scope.md, version-impact-record.md, artifact-manifest.md, rollout-strategy.md, ci-cd-governance.md, incident-response-path.md and post-release-measurement.md map to canonical names rather than becoming duplicate templates.
  • Detection alone can only justify present_unverified. Release-ready, deployed, published, operational-ready and automated claims require current evidence, owner evidence or an explicit accepted gap with owner, reason, review date, residual risk and follow-up condition.
  • External release actions remain approval-bound: publish, tag, GitHub Release creation, artifact upload, deploy, package registry mutation, marketplace/store submission, PR creation, branch push, CI/CD environment mutation and active automation.
  • False-positive policy: CHANGELOG.md, docs-only release notes, CI config, Dockerfile, health check, generated changelog, feature flag or GitOps file alone cannot prove readiness.
  • Unsupported claims must be rejected as evidence gaps: CI green means release ready, tests passed so release is ready, rollback is just revert, feature flags remove risk, GitOps is automatically safe, generated changelog is enough for users, DORA proves individual performance and repeatable automation is automatically safe.
