FORBIDDEN_TEXT = [
    "sk-",
    "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY",
    "PASSWORD=",
    "API_KEY=",
    "TOKEN=",
    "recurring schedule is active",
    "checks passed",
    "tests pass",
    "global ~/.codex/config.toml",
]


class InfrastructureTemplateTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_required_template_targets_are_registered_once(self):
        templates = required_templates()
        targets = [item.target_path for item in templates]

        self.assertEqual(set(targets), REQUIRED_TARGETS)
        self.assertEqual(len(targets), len(set(targets)))

    def test_template_source_files_exist(self):
        for item in required_templates():
            with self.subTest(key=item.key):
                self.assertTrue(item.source_path.exists(), item.source_path)
                self.assertTrue(item.source_path.is_file(), item.source_path)
                self.assertTrue(item.source_path.resolve().is_relative_to(TEMPLATE_ROOT.resolve()))

    def test_template_text_has_no_unsafe_literals(self):
        for item in required_templates():
            text = item.source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            with self.subTest(key=item.key):
                for forbidden in FORBIDDEN_TEXT:
                    self.assertNotIn(forbidden, text)
                self.assertNotRegex(text, re.compile(r"(?i)secret-value|private-customer|raw chat log"))

    def test_rendered_templates_have_no_unresolved_substitutions(self):
        context = {
            "project_name": "Synthetic Project",
            "workspace_path": "C:/workspace/synthetic-project",
            "profile_name": "standard-product",
            "detected_stack": ["python", "docs"],
            "detected_stack_text": "python, docs",
            "existing_control_plane": ["AGENTS.md"],
            "missing_control_plane": ["PLAN.md"],
            "existing_codex_assets": [".codex/config.toml"],
            "risk_text": "no detected test files or test configuration",
            "generated_at": "2026-05-14",
        }

        for item in required_templates():
            rendered = render_template(item, context)
            with self.subTest(key=item.key):
                self.assertNotRegex(rendered, re.compile(r"\{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\}"))
                self.assertNotIn("None", rendered)

    def test_agent_templates_validate_after_render(self):
        context = self._context()
        for item in required_templates():
            if item.validation_kind != "agent":
                continue
            with self.subTest(key=item.key):
                path = self._render_temp_file(item, context)
                self.assertEqual(validate_agent_file(path), [])

    def test_hook_templates_validate_after_render(self):
        context = self._context()
        for item in required_templates():
            if item.validation_kind != "hook":
                continue
            with self.subTest(key=item.key):
                path = self._render_temp_file(item, context)
                self.assertEqual(validate_hook_file(path), [])

    def test_hook_lifecycle_config_is_template_only(self):
        self.assertFalse((PLUGIN_ROOT / "hooks" / "hooks.json").exists())
        hooks_template = TEMPLATE_ROOT / "hooks" / "hooks.json"
        data = json.loads(hooks_template.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

        self.assertIn("SessionStart", data)
        self.assertIn("PreToolUse", data)
        self.assertIn("PermissionRequest", data)
        self.assertIn("PostToolUse", data)
        self.assertIn("Stop", data)

    def test_eval_templates_are_valid_json(self):
        for item in required_templates():
            if item.validation_kind != "eval_json":
                continue
            with self.subTest(key=item.key):
                data = json.loads(item.source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                self.assertIn("name", data)
                self.assertIn("cases", data)
                self.assertIsInstance(data["cases"], list)

    def test_config_template_is_valid_toml(self):
        config = TEMPLATE_ROOT / "config" / "config.toml"
        data = tomllib.loads(config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

        self.assertIn("agents", data)
        self.assertNotIn("network_access", data)
        self.assertNotIn("secrets", data)

    def test_automation_template_is_candidate_only(self):
        text = (TEMPLATE_ROOT / "automations" / "automation-candidate.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        self.assertIn("candidate_only", text)
        self.assertIn("manual stability evidence", text)
        self.assertIn("explicit approval", text)
        self.assertNotIn("RRULE", text)
        self.assertNotIn("schedule:", text)

    def test_workflow_inventory_covers_context_and_ownership(self):
        names = {item.source_path.name for item in required_templates() if item.category == "workflows"}

        self.assertEqual(
            names,
            {
                "source-context-pack.md",
                "worktree-ownership.md",
                "build-slice.md",
                "review-slice.md",
                "release-packet.md",
                "runlog-compaction.md",
            },
        )

    def _context(self):
        return {
            "project_name": "Synthetic Project",
            "workspace_path": "C:/workspace/synthetic-project",
            "profile_name": "standard-product",
            "detected_stack": ["python"],
            "detected_stack_text": "python",
            "existing_control_plane": [],
            "missing_control_plane": ["AGENTS.md"],
            "existing_codex_assets": [],
            "risk_text": "no detected test files or test configuration",
            "generated_at": "2026-05-14",
        }

    def _render_temp_file(self, item, context):
        import tempfile

        root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        path = root / item.target_path
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(render_template(item, context), encoding="utf-8")
        return path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    InfrastructureError,

)


class InfrastructureRendererTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dry_run_returns_json_shape_without_writes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            workspace = Path(tmp) / "workspace"
            shutil.copytree(FIXTURES / "node-app", workspace)
            before = self._relative_files(workspace)

            result = render_infrastructure_plan(workspace)
            after = self._relative_files(workspace)

        self.assertEqual(before, after)
        self.assertEqual(result["infrastructure_plan"]["status"], "ready")
        self.assertEqual(result["infrastructure_plan"]["profile"], "guided-small")
        self.assertIn("rendered_artifacts", result)
        self.assertTrue(result["rendered_artifacts"]["validation"]["ok"])

    def test_greenfield_plan_creates_control_plane_and_codex_assets(self):
        result = render_infrastructure_plan(FIXTURES / "empty-repo")
        files = result["rendered_artifacts"]["files"]
        by_target = {item["target_path"]: item for item in files}

        self.assertEqual(by_target["AGENTS.md"]["action"], "create")
        self.assertEqual(by_target["REQUIREMENTS.md"]["action"], "create")
        self.assertEqual(by_target[".codex/config.toml"]["action"], "create")
        self.assertEqual(by_target[".codex/hooks/hooks.json"]["write_policy"], "staged_only")
        self.assertIn("explicit approval", " ".join(result["infrastructure_plan"]["approval_required"]))

    def test_stage_mode_writes_only_inside_output_directory(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            workspace = Path(tmp) / "workspace"
            stage_root = Path(tmp) / "stage"
            shutil.copytree(FIXTURES / "python-app", workspace)

            result = stage_infrastructure(workspace, stage_root)

            staged_paths = [Path(item["staged_path"]).resolve() for item in result["rendered_artifacts"]["files"]]
            self.assertTrue(staged_paths)
            for path in staged_paths:
                self.assertTrue(path.is_relative_to(stage_root.resolve()), path)
                self.assertTrue(path.exists(), path)
            self.assertFalse((workspace / "AGENTS.md").exists())
            self.assertFalse((workspace / ".codex").exists())

    def test_existing_agents_file_without_marker_is_preserved(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            workspace = Path(tmp) / "workspace"
            stage_root = Path(tmp) / "stage"
            shutil.copytree(FIXTURES / "existing-codex-config", workspace)

            result = stage_infrastructure(workspace, stage_root)

            agents = by_target["AGENTS.md"]

            self.assertIn("_proposals", agents["staged_path"])
            self.assertIn("preserved user-authored file", " ".join(result["infrastructure_plan"]["warnings"]))
            self.assertEqual((workspace / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "Existing project instructions.\n")

    def test_existing_project_config_without_marker_is_preserved(self):
        result = render_infrastructure_plan(FIXTURES / "existing-codex-config")
        by_target = {item["target_path"]: item for item in result["rendered_artifacts"]["files"]}

        self.assertEqual(by_target[".codex/config.toml"]["action"], "leave_unchanged")
        self.assertEqual(by_target[".codex/config.toml"]["write_policy"], "approved_write_required")
        self.assertIn(".codex/config.toml", " ".join(result["infrastructure_plan"]["warnings"]))

        result = render_infrastructure_plan(FIXTURES / "duplicate-managed-section")
        by_target = {item["target_path"]: item for item in result["rendered_artifacts"]["files"]}

        self.assertEqual(result["infrastructure_plan"]["status"], "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(by_target["AGENTS.md"]["action"], "blocked")

            with self.assertRaises(InfrastructureError) as error:

    def _relative_files(self, root):
        return sorted(path.relative_to(root).as_posix() for path in root.rglob("*") if path.is_file())

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from string import Formatter
from typing import Any


PLUGIN_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TEMPLATE_ROOT = PLUGIN_ROOT / "assets" / "templates"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TemplateSpec:
    key: str
    category: str
    source_path: Path
    target_path: str
    validation_kind: str = "text"
    managed_section: str = ""


def _template(category: str, name: str, target: str, validation_kind: str = "text", managed_section: str = "") -> TemplateSpec:
    key = f"{category}/{name}"
    return TemplateSpec(
        key=key,
        category=category,
        source_path=TEMPLATE_ROOT / category / name,
        target_path=target,
        validation_kind=validation_kind,
        managed_section=managed_section,
    )


TEMPLATES = [
    _template("control-plane", "AGENTS.md", "AGENTS.md", managed_section="project-rules"),
    _template("control-plane", "REQUIREMENTS.md", "REQUIREMENTS.md", managed_section="requirements"),
    _template("control-plane", "PLAN.md", "PLAN.md", managed_section="plan"),
    _template("control-plane", "TEST.md", "TEST.md", managed_section="test-plan"),
    _template("control-plane", "EVALS.md", "EVALS.md", managed_section="evals"),
    _template("control-plane", "RUNLOG.md", "RUNLOG.md", managed_section="runlog"),
    _template("config", "config.toml", ".codex/config.toml", validation_kind="toml"),
    _template("agents", "product-manager.toml", ".codex/agents/product-manager.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "architect.toml", ".codex/agents/architect.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "explorer.toml", ".codex/agents/explorer.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "builder.toml", ".codex/agents/builder.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "tester.toml", ".codex/agents/tester.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "reviewer.toml", ".codex/agents/reviewer.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "docs-maintainer.toml", ".codex/agents/docs-maintainer.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("agents", "release-operator.toml", ".codex/agents/release-operator.toml", validation_kind="agent"),
    _template("hooks", "hooks.json", ".codex/hooks/hooks.json", validation_kind="hook_json"),
    _template("hooks", "session_start_context.py", ".codex/hooks/session_start_context.py", validation_kind="hook"),
    _template("hooks", "pre_tool_use_policy.py", ".codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_policy.py", validation_kind="hook"),
    _template("hooks", "permission_request_summary.py", ".codex/hooks/permission_request_summary.py", validation_kind="hook"),
    _template("hooks", "post_tool_use_evidence.py", ".codex/hooks/post_tool_use_evidence.py", validation_kind="hook"),
    _template("hooks", "stop_runlog_reminder.py", ".codex/hooks/stop_runlog_reminder.py", validation_kind="hook"),
    _template("workflows", "source-context-pack.md", ".codex/workflows/source-context-pack.md"),
    _template("workflows", "worktree-ownership.md", ".codex/workflows/worktree-ownership.md"),
    _template("workflows", "build-slice.md", ".codex/workflows/build-slice.md"),
    _template("workflows", "review-slice.md", ".codex/workflows/review-slice.md"),
    _template("workflows", "release-packet.md", ".codex/workflows/release-packet.md"),
    _template("workflows", "runlog-compaction.md", ".codex/workflows/runlog-compaction.md"),
    _template("evals", "project-readiness.json", ".codex/evals/project-readiness.json", validation_kind="eval_json"),
    _template("evals", "handoff-completeness.json", ".codex/evals/handoff-completeness.json", validation_kind="eval_json"),
    _template("evals", "renderer-fixtures.json", ".codex/evals/renderer-fixtures.json", validation_kind="eval_json"),
    _template("automations", "automation-candidate.md", ".codex/automation-candidates/automation-candidate.md"),
    _template("pr", "pr-body.md", ".codex/pr/pr-body.md"),
    _template("pr", "release-notes.md", ".codex/pr/release-notes.md"),
]


class StrictFormatDict(dict[str, Any]):
    def __missing__(self, key: str) -> str:
        raise KeyError(f"missing template context key: {key}")


def required_templates() -> list[TemplateSpec]:
    return list(TEMPLATES)


def template_by_target(target_path: str) -> TemplateSpec:
    for item in TEMPLATES:
        if item.target_path == target_path:
            return item
    raise KeyError(f"unknown template target: {target_path}")


def template_fields(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {field_name for _, field_name, _, _ in Formatter().parse(text) if field_name}


def render_template(item: TemplateSpec, context: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    text = item.source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    fields = template_fields(text)
    missing = sorted(field for field in fields if field not in context)
    if missing:
        raise KeyError("missing template context keys: " + ", ".join(missing))
    return text.format_map(StrictFormatDict(context))

Each control-plane template must start with a title, include the managed section markers, and use only deterministic substitution keys from the contract.

Use these section ids:

  • AGENTS.md: project-rules
  • REQUIREMENTS.md: requirements

Create plugins/product-agent-os/assets/templates/control-plane/AGENTS.md:

# AGENTS.md

<!-- product-agent-os:start project-rules -->
Project: {project_name}
Profile: {profile_name}
Detected stack: {detected_stack_text}

## Durable Rules

- Treat official project docs and checked-in files as source of truth.
- Preserve user-authored content outside managed sections.
- Do not store secrets, credentials, private keys, customer data, or raw private chat logs.
- Do not write outside the current workspace.
- Use staged drafts before direct project writes.
- Record commands and observed results in `RUNLOG.md` before claiming readiness.

## Verification Policy

- Run deterministic tests, builds, linters, docs checks, or evals that match the current slice.
- If verification cannot run, record the gap and stop before readiness claims.
- External systems, network access, permission changes, and publishing require explicit approval.

## Agent Handoff

Every handoff must include sources, assumptions, files touched or proposed, commands run, evidence, risks, stop reason, and recommended next role.
<!-- product-agent-os:end project-rules -->

Create the other control-plane templates with the same marker pattern and these required headings:

  • REQUIREMENTS.md: Goal, Users, Scope, Non-Goals, Constraints, Критерии приемки, Assumptions, Open Questions.
  • PLAN.md: Lifecycle State, Implementation Slices, Ownership, Dependencies, Risks, Rollback, Verification Gates, Approval Needs.
  • TEST.md: Deterministic Checks, Manual Checks, Runtime Or Visual Checks, Known Gaps, Evidence Format.
  • EVALS.md: Rubrics, Thresholds, Artifacts, Regression Notes, Unsupported Claims.
  • RUNLOG.md: Current State, Decisions, Commands, Verification Evidence, Failures, Risks, Handoff Summary.

For each file include these generated context lines inside the managed section:

Project: {project_name}
Workspace: {workspace_path}
Profile: {profile_name}
Detected stack: {detected_stack_text}
Generated at: {generated_at}

  • worktree-ownership.md: workspace root, branch or worktree assumption, file ownership map, parallel write conflict rules.
  • build-slice.md: one approved slice, inputs, owner, files, commands, evidence, rollback.
  • review-slice.md: findings-first review format, missing tests, regressions, security risk, verdict.
  • release-packet.md: PR summary, checks, user impact, rollback, residual risks, approval requirements.
  • runlog-compaction.md: hot context, warm context, cold archive proposal, evidence preservation, privacy boundaries.

Example baseline for build-slice.md:

# Build Slice Workflow

Project: {project_name}
Profile: {profile_name}

## Inputs

- Approved requirement or issue.
- Current `PLAN.md` slice.
- Ownership boundary.
- Verification command or documented gap.

## Process

1. Confirm scope and files.
2. Run or inspect the baseline before changing code when feasible.
3. Make one focused change.
4. Run relevant checks.
5. Record evidence and risks.

## Outputs

- Changed files summary.
- Commands run with observed results.
- Remaining risks.
- Next role recommendation.

## Verification

Do not mark the slice ready without current evidence.

## Stop Conditions

- Scope is unclear.
- Required approval is missing.
- Verification fails and no safe fix is available in the slice.

Hook scripts must be deterministic Python, accept JSON on stdin when available, avoid network calls, avoid secret storage, and print concise JSON or text. Use this safety baseline in pre_tool_use_policy.py:

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys


DESTRUCTIVE_PATTERNS = [
    r"\brm\s+-rf\b",
    r"\bgit\s+reset\s+--hard\b",
    r"\bgit\s+checkout\s+--\b",
    r"\bRemove-Item\b.*\b-Recurse\b",
]

FORBIDDEN_PATHS = [
    r"\.\.[/\\]",
    r"~[/\\]\.codex[/\\]config\.toml",
]


def main() -> int:
    payload = sys.stdin.read()
    command = payload
    try:
        data = json.loads(payload) if payload.strip() else {}
        command = str(data.get("command", payload))
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        command = payload

    findings = []
    for pattern in DESTRUCTIVE_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, command, re.IGNORECASE):
            findings.append("destructive command requires explicit approval")
    for pattern in FORBIDDEN_PATHS:
        if re.search(pattern, command):
            findings.append("path outside approved project boundary requires explicit approval")

    print(json.dumps({"ok": not findings, "findings": findings}, sort_keys=True))
    return 1 if findings else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

Other hook scripts:

  • [ ] Step 1: Implement renderer module

Create plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/infrastructure.py with these public functions:

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import tomllib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from product_agent_os.discovery import analyze_workspace
from product_agent_os.merge_markdown import merge_section
from product_agent_os.templates import TemplateSpec, required_templates, render_template
from product_agent_os.validators import validate_agent_file, validate_hook_file


OWNER = "product-agent-os"


class InfrastructureError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlannedFile:
    target_path: str
    staged_path: str
    action: str
    write_policy: str
    template_key: str


def render_infrastructure_plan(workspace: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    workspace_path = _workspace(workspace)
    audit = analyze_workspace(workspace_path)
    return _plan(workspace_path, audit, stage_root=None)


def stage_infrastructure(workspace: str | Path, output_dir: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    workspace_path = _workspace(workspace)
    stage_root = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if _is_relative_to(stage_root, workspace_path):
        raise InfrastructureError("stage output directory must be outside workspace for Track 3 staged review")
    audit = analyze_workspace(workspace_path)
    result = _plan(workspace_path, audit, stage_root=stage_root)
    if result["infrastructure_plan"]["status"] == "blocked":
        return result
    _write_staged_files(result, stage_root)
    return result

Implement private helpers:

  • _workspace(workspace): resolve path, raise InfrastructureError for missing or non-directory workspace.
  • _context(workspace, audit): build deterministic template substitution context.
  • _plan(workspace, audit, stage_root): iterate required_templates(), compute action, staged path, warnings, blocked entries, approval requirements, and validation result.
  • _action_for_target(workspace, item): inspect existing target file and return create, update, leave_unchanged, or blocked.
  • _managed_count(text, section_id): count matching start and end markers.
  • _staged_path(stage_root, item, action): mirror target path or use _proposals/<target>.product-agent-os-proposal.
  • _render_body(item, context, existing_text, action): render template; for control-plane files use merge_section when action is update; for unmarked existing files stage the full generated proposal without touching original.
  • _validate_rendered_files(files): validate agent TOML, hook scripts, hook JSON, eval JSON, staged config TOML, and unresolved substitutions.
  • _write_staged_files(result, stage_root): create parent dirs and write internal file content only inside stage_root.

Public JSON must not include internal file contents. Keep content in an internal structure and strip it before printing.

Validation details:

def _validate_content(item: TemplateSpec, path: Path, content: str) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    if "{" in content and "}" in content:
        errors.append("rendered output contains unresolved substitution marker")
    if item.validation_kind == "agent":
        errors.extend(validate_agent_file(path))
    elif item.validation_kind == "hook":
        errors.extend(validate_hook_file(path))
    elif item.validation_kind == "hook_json":
        data = json.loads(content)
        for event in ["SessionStart", "PreToolUse", "PermissionRequest", "PostToolUse", "Stop"]:
            if event not in data:
                errors.append(f"hook config missing event: {event}")
    elif item.validation_kind == "eval_json":
        data = json.loads(content)
        if not isinstance(data.get("cases"), list):
            errors.append("eval JSON must include cases list")
    elif item.validation_kind == "toml":
        tomllib.loads(content)
    return errors

Write validation temp files under the stage root when staging and under a temporary directory for dry-run. Do not write into the workspace.

Create plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/render_infrastructure.py:

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

from product_agent_os.infrastructure import (  # noqa: E402
    InfrastructureError,
    render_infrastructure_plan,
    stage_infrastructure,
)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Render Product-Agent OS project infrastructure.")
    parser.add_argument("workspace", help="Workspace directory to inspect.")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Print infrastructure plan JSON without writing files.")
    mode.add_argument("--stage", metavar="OUTPUT_DIR", help="Write staged artifacts under OUTPUT_DIR.")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.dry_run and not args.stage:
        print("error: choose --dry-run or --stage", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    try:
        if args.dry_run:
            result = render_infrastructure_plan(args.workspace)
        else:

Source status: official + experiment

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Build packaged lifecycle skills for the product-agent-os Codex plugin without generating project infrastructure yet.

Architecture: This plan implements Track 2 from the Product-Agent OS lifecycle skills design. It adds concise SKILL.md packages, shared lifecycle references, UI metadata, and static validation tests that enforce routing, boundaries, source policy, and safety language.

Tech Stack: Codex skill package layout, Markdown, YAML-like metadata files, Python 3 standard library, unittest, pathlib, re.

import re
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPTS = ROOT / "plugins" / "product-agent-os" / "scripts"
SKILLS = ROOT / "plugins" / "product-agent-os" / "skills"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))

from product_agent_os.contracts import LIFECYCLE_STATES  # noqa: E402


SKILL_NAMES = [
    "project-lifecycle-orchestrator",
    "workspace-discovery-auditor",
    "requirements-author",
    "implementation-planner",
    "agent-team-designer",
    "test-eval-designer",
    "risk-reviewer",
    "pr-release-operator",
    "learning-loop-maintainer",
    "automation-promoter",
]

REQUIRED_HEADINGS = [
    "## Trigger",
    "## Boundaries",
    "## Inputs",
    "## Process",
    "## Outputs",
    "## Verification",
    "## Failure Modes",
    "## Final Response Contract",
]

REFERENCES = [
    "lifecycle-states.md",
    "handoff-contract.md",
    "source-policy.md",
    "complexity-routing.md",
]

REFERENCE_TERMS = {
    "lifecycle-states.md": ["uninitialized", "maintenance", "Do not skip"],
    "handoff-contract.md": ["verification_evidence", "unsupported_claims", "stop_reason"],
    "source-policy.md": ["Official OpenAI documentation", "Context7", "Do not store secrets"],
    "complexity-routing.md": ["guided-small", "enterprise-governed", "autonomous-maintenance"],
}

REQUIRED_SKILL_LINKS = [
    "../references/lifecycle-states.md",
    "../references/handoff-contract.md",
    "../references/source-policy.md",
    "../references/complexity-routing.md",
]

ROUTING = {
    "uninitialized": "workspace-discovery-auditor",
    "infrastructure_planned": "requirements-author",
    "requirements_ready": "implementation-planner",
    "plan_ready": "agent-team-designer",
    "team_ready": "test-eval-designer",
    "build_active": "risk-reviewer",
    "quality_gate": "risk-reviewer",
    "review_ready": "pr-release-operator",
    "release_ready": "learning-loop-maintainer",
    "learning_ready": "automation-promoter",
    "maintenance": "project-lifecycle-orchestrator",
}

MARKDOWN_LINK_RE = re.compile(r"\[[^\]]+\]\((?:<)?([^)>]+)(?:>)?\)")
REFERENCE_LINK_RE = re.compile(r"^\.\./references/[^/]+\.md$")

PERMISSIVE_PREFIX = r"(?:can|may|should|allowed to|is permitted to|will|must)"
FORBIDDEN_PERMISSIVE_PATTERNS = [
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|write)\s+\.codex/agents\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:install|enable)\s+hooks\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|activate|start)\s+(?:active\s+)?automation\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|activate|start)\s+recurring\s+automation\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:mutate|change|modify|edit)\s+(?:global\s+)?(?:codex\s+)?config\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+store\s+secrets\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|write|generate|modify)\s+project\s+templates\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|write|generate|modify)\s+workflow\s+files\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|run|call|connect to|use)\s+mcp\s+servers\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|run|use)\s+(?:an?\s+)?agents\s+sdk\s+runner\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:run|execute|perform)\s+destructive\s+commands\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:write|store|modify|use)\s+user-level\s+memory\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:call|modify|write to|connect to|use)\s+external\s+systems\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:perform|make|do)\s+external\s+writes\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+install\s+external\s+dependencies\b",
    rf"\b{PERMISSIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:use\s+)?network\s+access\b",
]

NEGATIVE_PREFIX = r"(?:do not|never|must not|cannot|forbidden to|not permitted to)"

SECRET_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS = [rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+store\s+secrets\b"]
AUTOMATION_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS = [
    rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:create|activate|start)\s+(?:active\s+)?automation\b",
]
CONFIG_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS = [
    rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+(?:mutate|change)\s+global\s+config\b",
    rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+modify\s+config\b",
    rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+edit\s+project\s+config\b",
    rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+change\s+global\s+codex\s+config\b",
]
EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS = [
    rf"\b{NEGATIVE_PREFIX}\s+claim\b",
    r"\bwithout\s+evidence\b",
]


class LifecycleSkillsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_required_skill_packages_exist(self):
        for name in SKILL_NAMES:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self.assertTrue((SKILLS / name / "SKILL.md").exists(), f"{name} must include SKILL.md")
                self.assertTrue((SKILLS / name / "agents" / "openai.yaml").exists(), f"{name} must include agents/openai.yaml")

    def test_skill_frontmatter_and_required_headings(self):
        for name in SKILL_NAMES:
            text = self._skill_text(name)
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self._assert_frontmatter_has_only_name_and_description(name, text)
                self.assertRegex(text, r"^---\nname: " + re.escape(name) + r"\ndescription: .+\n---")
                self.assertRegex(text, r"(?m)^# .+")
                for heading in REQUIRED_HEADINGS:
                    self.assertIn(heading, text)

    def test_skill_metadata_disables_implicit_invocation(self):
        for name in SKILL_NAMES:
            metadata = (SKILLS / name / "agents" / "openai.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self.assertIn("interface:", metadata)
                self.assertIn("display_name:", metadata)
                self.assertIn("short_description:", metadata)
                self.assertIn("default_prompt:", metadata)
                self.assertIn(f"Use ${name}", metadata)
                self.assertIn("allow_implicit_invocation: false", metadata)

    def test_reference_files_exist_and_are_linked(self):
        for reference in REFERENCES:
            with self.subTest(reference=reference):
                path = SKILLS / "references" / reference
                self.assertTrue(path.exists(), f"{reference} must exist")
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertIn("Product-Agent OS", text)
                for term in REFERENCE_TERMS[reference]:
                    self.assertIn(term, text)

        for name in SKILL_NAMES:
            text = self._skill_text(name)
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                for link in REQUIRED_SKILL_LINKS:
                    self.assertIn(link, text)
                self._assert_reference_links_resolve(name, text)

    def test_orchestrator_routing_covers_all_lifecycle_states(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(ROUTING), set(LIFECYCLE_STATES))
        text = self._skill_text("project-lifecycle-orchestrator")
        for state, skill in ROUTING.items():
            with self.subTest(state=state):
                self.assertIn(state, text)
                self.assertIn(skill, text)

    def test_skills_state_track_two_boundaries(self):
        for name in SKILL_NAMES:
            text = self._skill_text(name).lower()
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self.assertIn("track 2", text)
                self.assertIn("staged", text)
                self._assert_negative_boundary(name, text, SECRET_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS, "secret storage")
                self._assert_negative_boundary(name, text, AUTOMATION_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS, "active automation creation")
                self._assert_negative_boundary(name, text, CONFIG_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS, "config mutation")
                self._assert_negative_boundary(name, text, EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS, "verification evidence claims")
                self.assertIn("approval", text)
                for pattern in FORBIDDEN_PERMISSIVE_PATTERNS:
                    self.assertNotRegex(text, pattern)

    def test_automation_skill_is_candidate_only(self):
        text = self._skill_text("automation-promoter").lower()
        self.assertIn("candidate_only", text)
        self.assertIn("manual stability evidence", text)

    def _skill_text(self, name: str) -> str:
        path = SKILLS / name / "SKILL.md"
        self.assertTrue(path.exists(), f"{name} must include SKILL.md")
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def _assert_frontmatter_has_only_name_and_description(self, name: str, text: str) -> None:
        match = re.match(r"^---\n(?P<frontmatter>.*?)\n---", text, re.DOTALL)
        self.assertIsNotNone(match, f"{name} must start with frontmatter")
        lines = [line.strip() for line in match.group("frontmatter").splitlines() if line.strip()]
        self.assertEqual(2, len(lines), f"{name} frontmatter must have only two keys")
        self.assertEqual(f"name: {name}", lines[0])
        self.assertRegex(lines[1], r"^description: .+$")

    def _assert_negative_boundary(self, name: str, text: str, patterns: list[str], boundary: str) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(
            any(re.search(pattern, text) for pattern in patterns),
            f"{name} must include a negative boundary for {boundary}",
        )

    def _assert_reference_links_resolve(self, name: str, text: str) -> None:
        links = {
            match.group(1).strip()
            for match in MARKDOWN_LINK_RE.finditer(text)
            if REFERENCE_LINK_RE.match(match.group(1).strip())
        }
        self.assertEqual(set(REQUIRED_SKILL_LINKS), links)

        reference_root = (SKILLS / "references").resolve()
        for link in sorted(links):
            path = (SKILLS / name / link).resolve()
            self.assertTrue(
                path.is_relative_to(reference_root),
                f"{name} reference link escapes shared references: {link}",
            )
            self.assertTrue(path.exists(), f"{name} reference link must resolve: {link}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Create plugins/product-agent-os/skills/references/lifecycle-states.md:

# Product-Agent OS Lifecycle States

Use this reference when a lifecycle skill needs state order, routing, or stop conditions.

State order:

1. `uninitialized`
2. `infrastructure_planned`
3. `requirements_ready`
4. `plan_ready`
5. `team_ready`
6. `build_active`
7. `quality_gate`
8. `review_ready`
9. `release_ready`
10. `learning_ready`
11. `maintenance`

Rules:

- Do not skip from `uninitialized` to `build_active`.
- Do not enter `requirements_ready` without a requirements packet.
- Do not enter `plan_ready` without acceptance criteria and verification strategy.
- Do not enter `team_ready` without ownership boundaries when work is parallel.
- Do not enter `release_ready` without verification evidence or documented failures.
- Do not enter `learning_ready` until delivery is complete or explicitly stopped.
- Treat `maintenance` as a routing state, not permission to create active automation.
  • [ ] Step 2: Add handoff contract reference

Create plugins/product-agent-os/skills/references/handoff-contract.md:

# Product-Agent OS Handoff Contract

Use this reference when a skill hands work to the next lifecycle role or reports a stop condition.

Required fields:

- `lifecycle_state`
- `goal`
- `constraints`
- `allowed_sources`
- `inputs_used`
- `verified_claims`
- `unsupported_claims`
- `files_touched`
- `files_proposed`
- `commands_run`
- `verification_evidence`
- `risks`
- `next_agent_task`
- `stop_reason`

Rules:

- `goal`, `constraints`, and `verification_evidence` must not be empty when a skill claims readiness.
- At least one of `files_touched` or `files_proposed` must be non-empty.
- `unsupported_claims` must be explicit when sources or runtime checks are missing.
- `commands_run` records command strings, not invented outcomes.
- `verification_evidence` records observed results from the current run.
- `stop_reason` is required when the skill cannot advance the lifecycle.
  • [ ] Step 3: Add source policy reference

Create plugins/product-agent-os/skills/references/source-policy.md:

# Product-Agent OS Source Policy

Use this reference when a skill depends on current facts, external documentation, security claims, or product behavior.

Rules:

- Official OpenAI documentation is source of truth for Codex, plugins, skills, subagents, hooks, approvals, MCP, Agents SDK, and models.
- Context7 is official only when the underlying source is official.
- Community claims are intake material until marked with `trust_level` and `verification_status`.
- Memory and chat history are recall layers, not source of truth.
- Do not store secrets, tokens, credentials, private keys, private customer data, or raw private chat logs.
- Separate supported facts, assumptions, unsupported claims, and missing context.
- For source drift risk, refresh the source before making durable rules.

# Project Lifecycle Orchestrator

## Trigger

Use this skill when the user invokes Product-Agent OS, asks to guide a project end to end, asks for the next lifecycle step, or resumes a partially configured project.

## Boundaries

This is a Track 2 skill. Produce staged route packets and questions. Do not write project infrastructure directly, do not mutate global config, do not create active automation, and do not store secrets.

Read shared references when needed: [lifecycle states](<../references/lifecycle-states.md>), [handoff contract](<../references/handoff-contract.md>), [source policy](<../references/source-policy.md>), and [complexity routing](<../references/complexity-routing.md>).

## Inputs

- User goal or latest project request.
- Workspace path and visible project files.
- Existing `AGENTS.md`, `REQUIREMENTS.md`, `PLAN.md`, `TEST.md`, `EVALS.md`, `RUNLOG.md` when present.
- Discovery output from `plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/detect_project.py` when available.
- Current constraints, approvals, sandbox mode, and known blockers.

## Process

1. Read project rules before proposing action.
2. Determine the current lifecycle state.
3. Use this routing map:
   - `uninitialized` -> `workspace-discovery-auditor`
   - `infrastructure_planned` -> `requirements-author`
   - `requirements_ready` -> `implementation-planner`
   - `plan_ready` -> `agent-team-designer`
   - `team_ready` -> `test-eval-designer`
   - `build_active` -> `risk-reviewer`
   - `quality_gate` -> `risk-reviewer`
   - `review_ready` -> `pr-release-operator`
   - `release_ready` -> `learning-loop-maintainer`
   - `learning_ready` -> `automation-promoter`
   - `maintenance` -> `project-lifecycle-orchestrator`
4. Ask only blocking questions.
5. Return one recommended next skill or a stop condition.
6. Keep complexity profile as depth guidance, not permission to skip states.

## Outputs

Return a lifecycle route packet:

```yaml
lifecycle_route:
  current_state: ""
  next_state: ""
  recommended_skill: ""
  complexity_profile: ""
  blockers: []
  questions: []
  proposed_files: []
  approval_required: []
  stop_reason: ""

docs.title: Verification

docs.title: Failure Modes
docs.text:
• If state cannot be inferred, choose uninitialized and route to workspace-discovery-auditor.
  • If user goal is absent, ask one blocking goal question.
  • If project rules conflict with requested action, stop and show the conflict.
  • If verification evidence is missing, do not claim readiness.

docs.title: Final Response Contract
docs.text:
Lead with the recommended next action. Include current state, next skill, blockers, questions, proposed files, approval requirements, and stop reason when blocked.

description: Evaluate whether a stable Product-Agent OS workflow is ready to become an automation candidate. Use only after manual stability evidence exists and the user asks about recurring or repeated workflow promotion.
---

# Automation Promoter

## Trigger

Use this skill when a recurring workflow may be promoted from manual process to automation candidate.

## Boundaries

This is a Track 2 skill. Produce a candidate_only packet. Do not activate recurring jobs, do not schedule jobs, do not modify external systems, do not create active automation, and do not store secrets.

Read shared references when needed: [lifecycle states](<../references/lifecycle-states.md>), [handoff contract](<../references/handoff-contract.md>), [source policy](<../references/source-policy.md>), and [complexity routing](<../references/complexity-routing.md>).

## Inputs

- Manual stability evidence.
- Workflow purpose.
- Inputs, outputs, cadence, owner, verification, failure modes, and rollback or disable path.
- Write policy and approval requirements.

## Process

1. Confirm manual stability evidence exists.
2. Identify required inputs and stable outputs.
3. Define write policy as read_only, draft_only, or approved_write.
4. Name verification and failure modes.
5. Name owner, cadence, and rollback or disable path.
6. Return candidate_only readiness.

## Outputs

Return an automation candidate packet:

```yaml
automation_candidate:
  name: ""
  purpose: ""
  trigger_or_cadence: ""
  required_inputs: []
  write_policy: "read_only | draft_only | approved_write"
  verification: []
  failure_modes: []
  owner: ""
  rollback_or_disable: ""
  readiness: "candidate_only"

docs.title: Verification
docs.text: Check that manual stability evidence exists and failure modes are named. If not, candidate readiness is blocked.

docs.title: Failure Modes
docs.text:
• If manual stability evidence is missing, stop and request it.
  • If inputs or outputs are unstable, keep workflow manual.
  • If external writes are involved, require approved_write policy and explicit approval.
  • If owner is missing, block candidate readiness.

docs.title: Final Response Contract
docs.text:
Return candidate name, purpose, cadence, inputs, write policy, verification, failure modes, owner, rollback or disable path, readiness, and next lifecycle action.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS Plugin Core Implementation Plan
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Build the core package, contracts, validators, fixture harness and safe merge utilities for the product-agent-os Codex plugin.

Architecture: This plan implements Track 1 from the Product-Agent OS plugin spec. It creates a repo-local plugin under plugins/product-agent-os/, keeps runtime logic in small Python stdlib modules under plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/, and proves behavior with unittest fixture tests before lifecycle skills are written.

Tech Stack: Codex plugin manifest, Python 3 standard library, unittest, json, pathlib, tomllib, Markdown fixture files.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
This plan covers only Plugin core and contracts:

  • plugin package skeleton;
  • plugin.json manifest;
  • core schemas and lifecycle constants;
  • fixture projects;
  • workspace discovery;
  • control-plane, agent and hook validators;
  • managed Markdown section merge utility;
  • fixture eval runner;
  • docs navigation for the plan.

It intentionally does not create lifecycle skill bodies, project infrastructure templates, active hooks, automations or Agents SDK runner code. Those belong to the next implementation plans.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


LIFECYCLE_STATES = [
    "uninitialized",
    "infrastructure_planned",
    "requirements_ready",
    "plan_ready",
    "team_ready",
    "build_active",
    "quality_gate",
    "review_ready",
    "release_ready",
    "learning_ready",
    "maintenance",
]

COMPLEXITY_PROFILES = [
    "guided-small",
    "standard-product",
    "production-team",
    "ai-product",
    "enterprise-governed",
    "autonomous-maintenance",
]

CONTROL_PLANE_FILES = [
    "AGENTS.md",
    "REQUIREMENTS.md",
    "PLAN.md",
    "TEST.md",
    "EVALS.md",
    "RUNLOG.md",
]

REQUIRED_HANDOFF_FIELDS = [
    "lifecycle_state",
    "goal",
    "constraints",
    "allowed_sources",
    "inputs_used",
    "verified_claims",
    "unsupported_claims",
    "files_touched",
    "files_proposed",
    "commands_run",
    "verification_evidence",
    "risks",
    "next_agent_task",
    "stop_reason",
]


def validate_handoff(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    """Return missing or invalid handoff fields."""
    missing: list[str] = []
    for field in REQUIRED_HANDOFF_FIELDS:
        if field not in payload:
            missing.append(field)

    state = payload.get("lifecycle_state")
    if state is not None and (not isinstance(state, str) or not state.strip()):
        missing.append("lifecycle_state:empty")
    elif state is not None and state not in LIFECYCLE_STATES:
        missing.append("lifecycle_state:unknown")

    goal = payload.get("goal")
    if goal is not None and (not isinstance(goal, str) or not goal.strip()):
        missing.append("goal:empty")

    for field in [
        "allowed_sources",
        "inputs_used",
        "verified_claims",
        "unsupported_claims",
        "commands_run",
        "risks",
    ]:
        value = payload.get(field)
        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, list):
            missing.append(f"{field}:invalid")

    for field in ["constraints", "verification_evidence"]:
        value = payload.get(field)
        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, list):
            missing.append(f"{field}:invalid")
        elif value is not None and not value:
            missing.append(f"{field}:empty")

    files_touched = payload.get("files_touched")
    files_proposed = payload.get("files_proposed")
    for field, value in [
        ("files_touched", files_touched),
        ("files_proposed", files_proposed),
    ]:
        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, list):
            missing.append(f"{field}:invalid")

    if (
        isinstance(files_touched, list)
        and isinstance(files_proposed, list)
        and not files_touched
        and not files_proposed
    ):
        missing.append("files:empty")

    for field in ["next_agent_task", "stop_reason"]:
        value = payload.get(field)
        if value is not None and not isinstance(value, str):
            missing.append(f"{field}:invalid")

    return missing

        self.assertIn("node", audit["detected_stack"])

        self.assertIn(".codex/config.toml", audit["existing_codex_assets"])

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from product_agent_os.contracts import CONTROL_PLANE_FILES


STACK_MARKERS = {
    "package.json": "node",
    "pyproject.toml": "python",
    "requirements.txt": "python",
    "mkdocs.yml": "docs",
    "Cargo.toml": "rust",
    "go.mod": "go",
}

IGNORED_DIR_NAMES = {
    ".git",
    "node_modules",
    "site",
    "dist",
    "build",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "__pycache__",
    ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache",
    ".ruff_cache",
    ".codex-cache",
}


def _relative_files(root: Path) -> set[str]:
    files: set[str] = set()
    for current_root, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames[:] = [name for name in dirnames if name not in IGNORED_DIR_NAMES]
        current_path = Path(current_root)
        for filename in filenames:
            try:
                files.add((current_path / filename).relative_to(root).as_posix())
            except ValueError:
                continue
    return files


def _detect_stack(files: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    stack: list[str] = []
    for marker, name in STACK_MARKERS.items():
        if marker in files and name not in stack:
            stack.append(name)
    if any(path.startswith("packages/") for path in files):
        stack.append("monorepo")
    return stack


def _profile_for(files: set[str], stack: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    service_count = len({path.split("/")[1] for path in files if path.startswith("packages/") and "/" in path})
    ci_present = any(path.startswith(".github/workflows/") for path in files)
    test_maturity = "partial" if any("test" in path.lower() for path in files) else "none"
    if "monorepo" in stack or service_count > 1:
        name = "production-team"
    elif "docs" in stack and len(stack) == 1:
        name = "guided-small"
    elif ci_present:
        name = "standard-product"
    else:
        name = "guided-small"
    return {
        "name": name,
        "confidence": "medium",
        "drivers": {
            "repo_size": "small" if len(files) < 200 else "medium",
            "stack_count": len([item for item in stack if item != "monorepo"]),
            "service_count": max(service_count, 1),
            "test_maturity": test_maturity,
            "ci_present": ci_present,
        },
    }


def analyze_workspace(root: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    workspace = Path(root).resolve()
    if not workspace.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"workspace does not exist: {workspace}")
    if not workspace.is_dir():
        raise NotADirectoryError(f"workspace is not a directory: {workspace}")
    files = _relative_files(workspace)
    stack = _detect_stack(files)
    existing_control_plane = [name for name in CONTROL_PLANE_FILES if name in files]
    missing_control_plane = [name for name in CONTROL_PLANE_FILES if name not in files]
    existing_codex_assets = sorted(path for path in files if path.startswith(".codex/"))
    risks: list[str] = []
    if "AGENTS.md" not in files:
        risks.append("missing durable project instructions")
    if not any("test" in path.lower() for path in files):
        risks.append("no detected test files or test configuration")
    return {
        "workspace": str(workspace),
        "detected_files": sorted(files),
        "detected_stack": stack,
        "existing_control_plane": existing_control_plane,
        "missing_control_plane": missing_control_plane,
        "existing_codex_assets": existing_codex_assets,
        "git": {
            "present": (workspace / ".git").exists(),
        },
        "risks": risks,
        "complexity_profile": _profile_for(files, stack),
    }


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    root = Path(argv[0]) if argv else Path.cwd()
    try:
        audit = analyze_workspace(root)
    except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(json.dumps(audit, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

try:
    import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    tomllib = None

from product_agent_os.contracts import CONTROL_PLANE_FILES


AGENT_REQUIRED_FIELDS = ["name", "description", "developer_instructions"]
SECRET_MARKERS = ["secret", "token", "private_key", "password"]


def validate_control_plane(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    missing = [name for name in CONTROL_PLANE_FILES if not (root / name).exists()]
    return {
        "ok": not missing,
        "missing": missing,
    }


def validate_agent_file(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    if tomllib is None:
        return ["tomllib unavailable"]
    try:
        data = tomllib.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as exc:
        return [f"invalid toml: {exc}"]
    return [field for field in AGENT_REQUIRED_FIELDS if field not in data]


def validate_hook_file(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
    errors: list[str] = []
    if any(marker in text for marker in SECRET_MARKERS):
        errors.append("contains forbidden secret-like literal")
    if "exit(2)" not in text and "sys.exit(2)" not in text:
        errors.append("no blocking exit path")
    return errors


def print_json(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if payload.get("ok") else 1


def main_control_plane(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    root = Path(argv[0]) if argv else Path.cwd()
    return print_json(validate_control_plane(root))


def main_agents(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    root = Path(argv[0]) if argv else Path(".codex/agents")
    files = sorted(root.glob("*.toml")) if root.exists() else []
    errors = {str(path): validate_agent_file(path) for path in files}
    ok = bool(files) and all(not item for item in errors.values())
    return print_json({"ok": ok, "files": [str(path) for path in files], "errors": errors})


def main_hooks(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    root = Path(argv[0]) if argv else Path(".codex/hooks")
    files = sorted(root.glob("*.py")) if root.exists() else []
    errors = {str(path): validate_hook_file(path) for path in files}
    ok = bool(files) and all(not item for item in errors.values())
    return print_json({"ok": ok, "files": [str(path) for path in files], "errors": errors})

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def merge_section(text: str, owner: str, section_id: str, body: str) -> str:
    start = f"<!-- {owner}:start {section_id} -->"
    end = f"<!-- {owner}:end {section_id} -->"
    block = f"{start}\n{body.rstrip()}\n{end}\n"
    pattern = re.compile(
        re.escape(start) + r".*?" + re.escape(end) + r"\n?",
        flags=re.DOTALL,
    )
    if pattern.search(text):
        return pattern.sub(block, text)
    separator = "" if text.endswith("\n") else "\n"
    return f"{text}{separator}\n{block}"


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) != 4:
        print("usage: merge_markdown.py <file> <owner> <section-id> <body-file>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    target = Path(argv[0])
    owner = argv[1]
    section_id = argv[2]
    body = Path(argv[3]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if target.exists() else ""
    target.write_text(merge_section(original, owner, section_id, body), encoding="utf-8")
    return 0

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from product_agent_os.discovery import analyze_workspace


PLUGIN_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def evaluate_fixture(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    audit = analyze_workspace(path)
    ok = bool(audit["workspace"]) and "complexity_profile" in audit
    return {
        "fixture": path.name,
        "ok": ok,
        "profile": audit["complexity_profile"]["name"],
        "risks": audit["risks"],
    }


def evaluate_all() -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [evaluate_fixture(path) for path in sorted(FIXTURES.iterdir()) if path.is_dir()]


def main() -> int:
    results = evaluate_all()
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if results and all(item["ok"] for item in results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":

docs.title: Product-Agent OS Production Hardening Implementation Plan
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Implement Track 4 production hardening for product-agent-os: staged manifest, explicit approval records, safe approved merge, rollback, hook activation gate, stronger fixture evals, source-policy validation, automation promotion validation, and optional Agents SDK runner design.

Architecture: Keep Track 3 rendering as the only template generation layer. Add a hardening layer that consumes staged artifacts, validates provenance and approval, plans safe writes, applies only approved changes inside the workspace, records rollback evidence, and extends fixture eval with merge/source/automation statuses. Source-policy, automation-policy, and optional Agents SDK runner design remain separate modules so default renderer behavior stays staged-first.

Tech Stack: Python 3 standard library, unittest, pathlib, json, hashlib, tempfile, shutil, subprocess, Markdown/TOML/JSON fixtures, MkDocs.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
This plan implements Product-Agent OS Production Hardening Design.

In scope:

  • staged manifest contract for Track 3 stage output;
  • explicit approval record contract separate from merge plan id;
  • read-only merge planner;
  • approved apply mode;
  • rollback manifest and rollback mode;
  • hook activation gate;
  • hardening fixtures and fixture eval expansion;
  • deterministic source-policy validator;
  • deterministic automation candidate validator;
  • optional Agents SDK runner design document;
  • docs navigation and full verification.

Out of scope:

  • active Codex App automations, GitHub Actions, schedules, or recurring jobs;
  • default Agents SDK runner implementation;
  • dependency installation;
  • network access in tests or fixture evals;
  • global Codex config changes;
  • plugin-root hook activation;
  • replacing user-authored files without managed-section boundaries and explicit approval.

docs.title: Contract Decisions
docs.text:
Use JSON for implementation artifacts even when the design shows YAML-like shape. JSON keeps Track 4 dependency-free.

Artifact names:

  • product-agent-os-stage-manifest.json
  • product-agent-os-approval-template.json
  • product-agent-os-approval.json
  • product-agent-os-rollback-manifest.json

Allowed merge actions:

  • create_file
  • append_managed_section
  • replace_managed_section
  • companion_only
  • blocked

Status values:

  • merge plan: needs_approval, blocked, applied
  • source policy: ok, needs_review, blocked
  • automation promotion: candidate_only, ready_for_manual_approval, blocked

Safety invariants:

  • Plan mode writes no files.
  • Apply mode writes only inside the workspace.
  • Rollback mode writes only inside the workspace.
  • Stage root must not be inside the target workspace.
  • Target paths and staged paths must be relative and must not contain ...
  • Symlinked targets, target parents, stage files, and stage parents are blocked.
  • Bare merge plan id is never treated as approval.
  • Hook lifecycle config is not applied unless enable_hooks is true in the approval record.

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


MANIFEST_NAME = "product-agent-os-stage-manifest.json"
APPROVAL_TEMPLATE_NAME = "product-agent-os-approval-template.json"
APPROVAL_RECORD_NAME = "product-agent-os-approval.json"


def canonical_json(payload: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def content_digest(text: str) -> str:
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def file_digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def plan_digest(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    public_plan = json.loads(canonical_json(plan))
    return content_digest(canonical_json(public_plan))


def build_stage_manifest(
    *,
    workspace: Path,
    stage_root: Path,
    renderer_result: dict[str, Any],
    renderer_version: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    files: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    managed = {
        item["target_path"]: item.get("section_id", "")
        for item in renderer_result["rendered_artifacts"].get("managed_sections", [])
        if isinstance(item, dict)
    }
    for item in renderer_result["rendered_artifacts"]["files"]:
        if item["action"] == "blocked" or not item.get("staged_path"):
            digest = ""
        else:
            staged_path = Path(item["staged_path"])
            digest = file_digest(staged_path)
        files.append(
            {
                "target_path": item["target_path"],
                "staged_path": str(Path(item["staged_path"]).relative_to(stage_root))
                if item.get("staged_path")
                else "",
                "action": item["action"],
                "write_policy": item["write_policy"],
                "digest": digest,
                "managed_section": managed.get(item["target_path"], ""),
            }
        )

    manifest = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "renderer": "product-agent-os",
        "renderer_version": renderer_version,
        "workspace": str(workspace.resolve()),
        "workspace_audit_digest": content_digest(str(workspace.resolve())),
        "infrastructure_plan_digest": plan_digest(renderer_result["infrastructure_plan"]),
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat(),
        "validation": renderer_result["rendered_artifacts"]["validation"],
        "files": files,
    }
    return manifest


def write_stage_manifest(stage_root: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
    errors = validate_stage_manifest(manifest)
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
    path = stage_root / MANIFEST_NAME
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def load_stage_manifest(stage_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = stage_root / MANIFEST_NAME
    if not path.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"stage manifest does not exist: {path}")
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid stage manifest json: {exc}") from exc
    errors = validate_stage_manifest(manifest)
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
    return manifest


def validate_stage_manifest(manifest: Any) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        return ["stage manifest must be an object"]
    errors: list[str] = []
    if manifest.get("schema_version") != 1:
        errors.append("schema_version must be 1")
    if manifest.get("renderer") != "product-agent-os":
        errors.append("renderer must be product-agent-os")
    if not isinstance(manifest.get("files"), list):
        errors.append("files must be a list")
        return errors
    for item in manifest["files"]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            errors.append("file entry must be an object")
            continue
        target = str(item.get("target_path", ""))
        staged = str(item.get("staged_path", ""))
        if _unsafe_relative_path(target):
            errors.append(f"target path escapes workspace: {target}")
        if staged and _unsafe_relative_path(staged):
            errors.append(f"staged path escapes stage root: {staged}")
        digest = str(item.get("digest", ""))
        if item.get("action") != "blocked" and not digest.startswith("sha256:"):
            errors.append(f"missing digest for staged file: {target}")
    return errors


def build_approval_template(merge_plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    decisions = [
        item
        for item in merge_plan.get("decisions", [])
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("approval_required")
    ]
    return {
        "approval": {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "merge_plan_id": merge_plan["id"],
            "approved_by": "",
            "approved_at": "",
            "approved_targets": [item["target_path"] for item in decisions],
            "approved_actions": sorted({item["action"] for item in decisions}),
            "accepted_risks": [],
            "denied_targets": [],
            "notes": "",
            "enable_hooks": False,
            "approved_hook_events": [],
            "blocking_hooks": [],
            "hook_rollback": "",
        }
    }


def validate_approval_record(
    approval_payload: Any,
    merge_plan_id: str,
    required_targets: list[str],
    required_actions: list[str],
) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(approval_payload, dict):
        return ["approval record must be an object"]
    approval = approval_payload.get("approval")
    if not isinstance(approval, dict):
        return ["approval field must be an object"]
    errors: list[str] = []
    if approval.get("schema_version") != 1:
        errors.append("approval schema_version must be 1")
    if approval.get("merge_plan_id") != merge_plan_id:
        errors.append("approval merge_plan_id does not match current merge plan")
    if not str(approval.get("approved_by", "")).strip():
        errors.append("approved_by is required")
    if not str(approval.get("approved_at", "")).strip():
        errors.append("approved_at is required")
    approved_targets = approval.get("approved_targets")
    approved_actions = approval.get("approved_actions")
    if not isinstance(approved_targets, list):
        errors.append("approved_targets must be a list")
    elif sorted(approved_targets) != sorted(required_targets):
        errors.append("approved_targets do not match merge plan write targets")
    if not isinstance(approved_actions, list):
        errors.append("approved_actions must be a list")
    elif sorted(approved_actions) != sorted(required_actions):
        errors.append("approved_actions do not match merge plan write actions")
    if not isinstance(approval.get("accepted_risks"), list):
        errors.append("accepted_risks must be a list")
    return errors


def _unsafe_relative_path(value: str) -> bool:
    path = Path(value)
    return not value or path.is_absolute() or path.drive != "" or ".." in path.parts

def build_merge_plan(workspace: str | Path, stage_root: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    workspace_path = Path(workspace).resolve()

    _validate_directory(workspace_path, "workspace")

    manifest = _load_manifest(stage_path)
    decisions = [_decision_for_entry(workspace_path, stage_path, entry) for entry in manifest["files"]]
    blocked = [item for item in decisions if item["action"] == "blocked"]
    plan = {

        "status": "blocked" if blocked else "needs_approval",
        "workspace": str(workspace_path),
        "stage_root": str(stage_path),

        "decisions": decisions,

        "warnings": [],

                "symlink paths blocked",

Add helper functions in the same file:

def _load_manifest(stage_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return load_stage_manifest(stage_root)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(str(exc)) from exc


def _validate_directory(path: Path, label: str) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"{label} does not exist: {path}")
    if not path.is_dir():
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"{label} is not a directory: {path}")


def _decision_for_entry(workspace: Path, stage_root: Path, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    target_rel = str(entry["target_path"])
    staged_rel = str(entry.get("staged_path", ""))
    try:
        target = _safe_child(workspace, target_rel, "target path")
        staged = _safe_child(stage_root, staged_rel, "staged path") if staged_rel else None
    except MergeInfrastructureError as exc:
        return _blocked(target_rel, str(exc))
    if _has_symlink_in_path(target) or (staged is not None and _has_symlink_in_path(staged)):
        return _blocked(target_rel, "symlink path is not allowed")
    if entry.get("action") == "blocked":
        return _blocked(target_rel, "renderer marked artifact as blocked")
    if staged is None or not staged.exists():
        return _blocked(target_rel, "staged file does not exist")
    if file_digest(staged) != entry.get("digest"):
        return _blocked(target_rel, "staged digest does not match manifest")
    action = _merge_action(target, target_rel, entry)
    digest_before = file_digest(target) if target.exists() and target.is_file() else ""
    return {
        "target_path": target_rel,
        "staged_path": str(staged),
        "action": action,
        "reason": _reason_for_action(action, entry),
        "target_digest_before": digest_before,
        "staged_digest": entry["digest"],
        "approval_required": action in {"create_file", "append_managed_section", "replace_managed_section"},
        "rollback_entry": target_rel if action in {"create_file", "append_managed_section", "replace_managed_section"} else "",
        "managed_section": entry.get("managed_section", ""),
    }


def _merge_action(target: Path, target_rel: str, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if target_rel == ".codex/hooks/hooks.json":
        return "companion_only"
    if not target.exists():
        return "create_file"
    if target.suffix.lower() == ".md" and entry.get("managed_section"):
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        start = f"<!-- {OWNER}:start {entry['managed_section']} -->"
        end = f"<!-- {OWNER}:end {entry['managed_section']} -->"
        if text.count(start) == 1 and text.count(end) == 1:
            return "replace_managed_section"
        if text.count(start) == 0 and text.count(end) == 0:
            return "append_managed_section"
        return "blocked"
    return "companion_only"


def _safe_child(root: Path, relative: str, label: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(relative)
    if not relative or path.is_absolute() or path.drive or ".." in path.parts:
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"{label} escapes workspace: {relative}")
    resolved = (root / path).resolve()
    if not resolved.is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"{label} escapes workspace: {relative}")
    return resolved


def _has_symlink_in_path(path: Path) -> bool:
    current = path.anchor
    probe = Path(current) if current else Path()
    parts = path.parts[1:] if current else path.parts
    for part in parts:
        probe = probe / part
        if probe.exists() and probe.is_symlink():
            return True
    return False


def _merge_plan_id(workspace: Path, stage_root: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any], decisions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    payload = {
        "workspace": str(workspace),
        "stage_root": str(stage_root),
        "manifest": manifest,
        "decisions": decisions,
    }
    return "merge-" + content_digest(canonical_json(payload)).split(":", 1)[1]


def _blocked(target_path: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "target_path": target_path,
        "staged_path": "",
        "action": "blocked",
        "reason": reason,
        "target_digest_before": "",
        "staged_digest": "",
        "approval_required": False,
        "rollback_entry": "",
        "managed_section": "",
    }


def _reason_for_action(action: str, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if action == "create_file":
        return "target does not exist and can be created after approval"
    if action == "append_managed_section":
        return "markdown target has no managed section and requires explicit append approval"
    if action == "replace_managed_section":
        return "markdown target has exactly one managed section"
    if action == "companion_only":
        return "target remains a staged companion proposal"
    return "merge action is blocked"

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Plan or apply Product-Agent OS staged infrastructure.")
    parser.add_argument("workspace")
    parser.add_argument("stage_dir")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--rollback", metavar="ROLLBACK_MANIFEST")
    parser.add_argument("--approval-file", default="")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.plan:
            result = build_merge_plan(args.workspace, args.stage_dir)
        elif args.apply:
            raise MergeInfrastructureError("apply mode is added in the approved apply task")
        else:
            raise MergeInfrastructureError("rollback mode is added in the rollback task")
    except MergeInfrastructureError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if result.get("verification", {}).get("ok") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import shutil
from product_agent_os.stage_manifest import validate_approval_record


ROLLBACK_MANIFEST_NAME = "product-agent-os-rollback-manifest.json"


def apply_merge_plan(workspace: str | Path, stage_root: str | Path, approval_file: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    workspace_path = Path(workspace).resolve()
    stage_path = Path(stage_root).resolve()
    approval_path = Path(approval_file).resolve()
    if not approval_path.exists():
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"approval file does not exist: {approval_path}")
    plan = build_merge_plan(workspace_path, stage_path)
    approval_payload = json.loads(approval_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    write_decisions = [
        item
        for item in plan["decisions"]
        if item["approval_required"] and item["target_path"] != ".codex/hooks/hooks.json"
    ]
    errors = validate_approval_record(
        approval_payload,
        plan["id"],
        [item["target_path"] for item in write_decisions],
        sorted({item["action"] for item in write_decisions}),
    )
    if errors:
        raise MergeInfrastructureError("; ".join(errors))

    applied: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    backups_root = stage_path / "_rollback" / plan["id"] / "backups"
    backups_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for decision in plan["decisions"]:
        if decision["action"] in {"blocked", "companion_only"}:
            applied.append(decision)
            continue
        _assert_target_is_not_stale(workspace_path, decision)
        target = _safe_child(workspace_path, decision["target_path"], "target path")
        staged = Path(decision["staged_path"]).resolve()
        backup = _backup_target(workspace_path, backups_root, target, decision["target_path"])
        if decision["action"] == "create_file":
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(staged, target)
        elif decision["action"] in {"append_managed_section", "replace_managed_section"}:
            _apply_markdown_managed_section(target, staged, decision["managed_section"])
        else:
            raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"unsupported apply action: {decision['action']}")
        applied.append({**decision, "backup_path": str(backup), "digest_after": file_digest(target)})

    rollback_manifest = _write_rollback_manifest(stage_path, plan, applied)
    return {
        "status": "applied",
        "merge_plan_id": plan["id"],
        "decisions": applied,
        "rollback_manifest": str(rollback_manifest),
        "verification": {"ok": True, "checks": ["approval validated", "writes applied", "rollback manifest written"]},
    }

Add helpers:

def _assert_target_is_not_stale(workspace: Path, decision: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    target = _safe_child(workspace, decision["target_path"], "target path")
    expected = decision.get("target_digest_before", "")
    actual = file_digest(target) if target.exists() and target.is_file() else ""
    if actual != expected:
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"merge plan is stale for {decision['target_path']}")


def _backup_target(workspace: Path, backup_root: Path, target: Path, target_rel: str) -> Path:
    safe_name = target_rel.replace("/", "__").replace("\\", "__")
    backup = backup_root / f"{safe_name}.backup"
    backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        shutil.copyfile(target, backup)
    else:
        backup.write_text("__PRODUCT_AGENT_OS_ABSENT__\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return backup


def _apply_markdown_managed_section(target: Path, staged: Path, section_id: str) -> None:
    from product_agent_os.merge_markdown import merge_section

    staged_text = staged.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    body = _extract_managed_body(staged_text, section_id)
    current = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if target.exists() else ""
    updated = merge_section(current, OWNER, section_id, body)
    target.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")


def _extract_managed_body(text: str, section_id: str) -> str:
    start = f"<!-- {OWNER}:start {section_id} -->"
    end = f"<!-- {OWNER}:end {section_id} -->"
    start_index = text.find(start)
    end_index = text.find(end)
    if start_index == -1 or end_index == -1 or end_index < start_index:
        raise MergeInfrastructureError(f"staged markdown missing managed section: {section_id}")
    return text[start_index + len(start) : end_index].strip()


def _write_rollback_manifest(stage_root: Path, plan: dict[str, Any], decisions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Path:
    entries = []
    for item in decisions:
        if item["action"] not in {"create_file", "append_managed_section", "replace_managed_section"}:
            continue
        entries.append(
            {
                "target_path": item["target_path"],
                "action": "created" if item["action"] == "create_file" else "updated",
                "existed_before": bool(item.get("target_digest_before")),
                "digest_before": item.get("target_digest_before", ""),
                "digest_after": item["digest_after"],
                "backup_path": item["backup_path"],
            }
        )
    manifest = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "merge_plan_id": plan["id"],
        "applied_at": datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat(),
        "workspace": plan["workspace"],
        "entries": entries,
        "verification": {"ok": True, "checks": ["rollback entries recorded"]},
    }
    path = stage_root / ROLLBACK_MANIFEST_NAME
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
